jobs.title: Software Quality Engineer I (UK Remote)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.


Experience a remote\-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well\-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.


Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.

 **Job Description**  

The Software Quality Engineer I (SQE1\) is an integral part of the Quality Engineering department, dedicated to assuring application quality, adherence to requirements, and an exceptional user experience by testing company applications. The main purpose of this role is to design, write, execute, and maintain automated and manual tests, as well as contribute to the overall test automation framework and continuous testing (CT) pipelines.  

This role will primarily interact with product development teams. The SQE1 works cross\-functionally with Software Developers, Product Managers, and fellow Quality Engineers within an Agile scrum environment to provide rapid, in\-process testing results, identify risks, and drive continuous improvement.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Test Strategy \& Planning:** Partner with the Scrum team to define, develop, and implement quality assurance best practices and procedures, including test strategies, plans, cases, and other related assets.
* **Test Execution:** Design, write, execute, and maintain both automated and manual test cases, ensuring high quality across functional, regression, integration, and scale testing.
* **Development Collaboration:** Work closely with development teams to support code releases with functional test validations on multiple platforms and environments.
* **Defect Management:** Investigate, record, triage, and track defects to verification and closure.
* **Risk Mitigation:** Identify potential quality risks and dependencies early in the Agile cycle; collaborate on mitigation and eradication plans.
* **Modern QA \& AI Capabilities:** Proactively research, evaluate, and integrate modern QA tools and AI\-driven testing capabilities (such as AI\-assisted test generation, predictive analysis, and smart automation tools) to improve efficiency and testing coverage.
* **Professional Development (Goal):** Commit to continuous professional and technical growth, developing deeper expertise in framework architecture, advanced CI/CD pipelines, and broad\-scope test strategy design.

  

**Qualifications**  

* **Education \& Experience:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience, combined with 4\+ years of experience in software quality engineering.
* **Automation \& Scripting:** Proven hands\-on experience in UI Web Automation and API Automation using established frameworks. (Java, Python, Jenkins, docker, Maven, github).
* **QA Methodologies:** Strong, high\-level understanding of the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and QA concepts, methodologies, and test management.
* **CI/CD/CT:** competency with continuous integration and deployment tools (such as Jenkins, Git, etc.).
* **Agile Practices:** Practical experience working within Agile frameworks (Scrum \& Kanban), estimating work, and managing test data.
* **Modern QA \& AI Capabilities:** Proactively research, evaluate, and integrate modern QA tools and AI\-driven testing capabilities (such as AI\-assisted test generation, predictive analysis, and smart automation tools) to improve efficiency and testing coverage.
* **Nice to Have Skills:**


	+ UI Mobile Automation \& Functional/Manual testing.
	+ Performance testing experience (e.g., using JMeter).
	+ Familiarity with AWS services (S3, Lambda, EC2, CloudWatch) or security/accessibility testing.

**Tii Elements:**

* **Accountability:** Takes ownership of the quality of deliverables and works autonomously within standard guidelines to resolve issues.
* **Collaboration \& Influencing:** Builds productive working relationships with developers and product teams to resolve quality issues and collaborate on best practices.
* **Quality Focus:** Strongly committed to delivering exceptional user experiences and robust software quality.
* **Relationship Building:** Cultivates stable, productive working relationships across cross\-functional teams.
* **Curiosity:** Actively stays up\-to\-date with new testing tools, test strategies, and emerging technologies (including AI tools).

  

**Additional Information** **Total Rewards @ Turnitin**  

At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.


Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.


In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote\-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well\-being.

**Our Mission** is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.  

  

**Our Values** underpin everything we do.

* **Customer Centric:** Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
* **Passion for Learning:** We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
* **Integrity:** Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
* **Action \& Ownership:** We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
* **One Team:** We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
* **Global Mindset:** We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.

**Global Benefits**

* Remote First Culture
* Health Care Coverage\*
* Education Reimbursement\*
* Competitive Paid Time Off
* Self\-Care Days
* National Holidays\*
* 2 Founder Days \+ Juneteenth Observed
* Paid Volunteer Time\*
* Charitable contribution match\*
* Monthly Wellness or Home Office Reimbursement/\*
* Access to Modern Health (mental health platform)
* Parental Leave\*
* Retirement Plan with match/contribution\*
* varies by country

**Seeing Beyond the Job Ad**  

At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad. We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

The Software Quality Engineer I (SQE1\) is an integral part of the Quality Engineering department, dedicated to assuring application quality, adherence to requirements, and an exceptional user experience by testing company applications. The main purpose of this role is to design, write, execute, and maintain automated and manual tests, as well as contribute to the overall test automation framework and continuous testing (CT) pipelines.  

This role will primarily interact with product development teams. The SQE1 works cross\-functionally with Software Developers, Product Managers, and fellow Quality Engineers within an Agile scrum environment to provide rapid, in\-process testing results, identify risks, and drive continuous improvement.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Test Strategy \& Planning:** Partner with the Scrum team to define, develop, and implement quality assurance best practices and procedures, including test strategies, plans, cases, and other related assets.
* **Test Execution:** Design, write, execute, and maintain both automated and manual test cases, ensuring high quality across functional, regression, integration, and scale testing.
* **Development Collaboration:** Work closely with development teams to support code releases with functional test validations on multiple platforms and environments.
* **Defect Management:** Investigate, record, triage, and track defects to verification and closure.
* **Risk Mitigation:** Identify potential quality risks and dependencies early in the Agile cycle; collaborate on mitigation and eradication plans.
* **Modern QA \& AI Capabilities:** Proactively research, evaluate, and integrate modern QA tools and AI\-driven testing capabilities (such as AI\-assisted test generation, predictive analysis, and smart automation tools) to improve efficiency and testing coverage.
* **Professional Development (Goal):** Commit to continuous professional and technical growth, developing deeper expertise in framework architecture, advanced CI/CD pipelines, and broad\-scope test strategy design.

  

**Qualifications**  

* **Education \& Experience:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience, combined with 4\+ years of experience in software quality engineering.
* **Automation \& Scripting:** Proven hands\-on experience in UI Web Automation and API Automation using established frameworks. (Java, Python, Jenkins, docker, Maven, github).
* **QA Methodologies:** Strong, high\-level understanding of the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and QA concepts, methodologies, and test management.
* **CI/CD/CT:** competency with continuous integration and deployment tools (such as Jenkins, Git, etc.).
* **Agile Practices:** Practical experience working within Agile frameworks (Scrum \& Kanban), estimating work, and managing test data.
* **Modern QA \& AI Capabilities:** Proactively research, evaluate, and integrate modern QA tools and AI\-driven testing capabilities (such as AI\-assisted test generation, predictive analysis, and smart automation tools) to improve efficiency and testing coverage.
* **Nice to Have Skills:**


	+ UI Mobile Automation \& Functional/Manual testing.
	+ Performance testing experience (e.g., using JMeter).
	+ Familiarity with AWS services (S3, Lambda, EC2, CloudWatch) or security/accessibility testing.

**Tii Elements:**

* **Accountability:** Takes ownership of the quality of deliverables and works autonomously within standard guidelines to resolve issues.
* **Collaboration \& Influencing:** Builds productive working relationships with developers and product teams to resolve quality issues and collaborate on best practices.
* **Quality Focus:** Strongly committed to delivering exceptional user experiences and robust software quality.
* **Relationship Building:** Cultivates stable, productive working relationships across cross\-functional teams.
* **Curiosity:** Actively stays up\-to\-date with new testing tools, test strategies, and emerging technologies (including AI tools).

  

**Additional Information** **Total Rewards @ Turnitin**  

At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.


Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.


In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote\-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well\-being.

**Our Values** underpin everything we do.

* **Customer Centric:** Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
* **Passion for Learning:** We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
* **Integrity:** Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
* **Action \& Ownership:** We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
* **One Team:** We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
* **Global Mindset:** We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.

* Health Care Coverage\*

At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**A bit of background on Rotageek**
-----------------------------------


Rotageek helps businesses optimise staff scheduling through data\-driven technology. By combining machine learning and advanced algorithms, we help organisations forecast demand, improve workforce management and give employees greater control over their schedules.


Our solutions drive operational efficiency, improve customer experiences and help reduce staff turnover across the retail and healthcare sectors. Rotageek is now part of the ELMO Software group, strengthening our ability to deliver industry\-leading workforce management solutions as part of a broader HR technology ecosystem.


Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we’ll let you in on a secret: there’s no such thing as a “perfect” candidate.


Rotageek is a place where everyone can grow. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

**Our values: what we live by**
-------------------------------


**Start With People**: You champion the customer experience, create psychological safety and help the whole team deliver with confidence.


**Own It, Together**: You take responsibility for quality outcomes, collaborate across disciplines and help turn incidents into learning.


**Clear Is Kind**: You make defects, risks, coverage and quality decisions clear, actionable and respectful.

**Why this role is so important**
---------------------------------


Our customers rely on Rotageek to support important workforce decisions. As a Software Engineer, you’ll help build the services, APIs and integrations that make those experiences reliable, secure and easy to extend.


You’ll take ownership of well\-scoped features and components, turning clear requirements into simple, robust and maintainable C\# and .NET solutions. You’ll work closely with Engineering, QA, Product and Data colleagues from design through to production.


This is a role for an engineer who cares about the whole journey, not just the code. You’ll think about testability, security, performance, observability and the way application data moves into reliable customer\-facing experiences.


You’ll also use AI\-assisted engineering tools as part of your delivery workflow. You’ll use them to accelerate implementation, testing and refactoring, while applying your judgement to validate the output for correctness, security and architectural fit.

**️ What you’ll be doing**
--------------------------

* Break down well\-scoped features into deliverable tasks, identifying dependencies and communicating progress, risks and decisions.
* Design medium\-complexity components with clear responsibilities, well\-defined interfaces and sensible separation of concerns.
* Write automated tests covering core behaviour and common edge cases, working with QA to ensure the right coverage at the right level.
* Apply established security practices, including OWASP principles, secure handling of data and appropriate escalation of risks.
* Use logs, metrics and traces to monitor, troubleshoot and improve production behaviour.
* Participate in constructive code reviews that improve logic, style, performance and security while helping colleagues grow.
* Work with Data Engineering colleagues on interfaces, data contracts, data quality and operational failure modes.
* Contribute to incident response, post\-incident learning and continuous improvement of the services you support.
* Document technical decisions and operational knowledge so the team can understand, support and extend what you build.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* Professional experience building software with C\# and .NET.
* Strong fundamentals in object\-oriented design, APIs, SQL, automated testing and debugging.
* Experience delivering medium\-complexity features within an established architecture.
* A practical understanding of secure development, performance, reliability and observability.
* Confidence participating in code reviews and explaining technical decisions clearly.
* The ability to take ownership of work from a well\-scoped ticket through to production, including testing, documentation, monitoring and follow\-through.
* A collaborative, customer\-focused approach to agile delivery.
* The judgement to use AI productively while validating and owning everything it produces.

**Nice to have, but not essential**
-----------------------------------

* Experience working closely with Data Engineering, Data Architecture or analytics teams.
* Practical understanding of data modelling, data quality, lineage, data contracts or transformation pipelines.
* Experience building reliable ingestion or integration workflows, event\-driven services or messaging\-based systems.
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or Databricks, or with BI and semantic\-layer concepts.
* Experience working with multi\-tenant systems, row\-level access controls, PII or GDPR\-sensitive data.
* Experience supporting a migration from legacy reporting or BI technology to a governed, modern data platform.


You don’t need experience with every tool or concept listed above. We’re more interested in your engineering fundamentals, problem\-solving approach, curiosity and ability to learn.

**How you’ll work**
-------------------

* You use AI\-assisted delivery thoughtfully, validating generated code and tests before they become part of the product.
* You favour simple solutions, evaluate existing libraries and services before building new ones, and avoid unnecessary complexity.
* You take ownership from ticket to production, including documentation, testing, monitoring and follow\-through.
* You are comfortable explaining technical choices, listening to alternatives and collaborating across Engineering, QA, Product and Data.
* You connect implementation decisions to customer value, reliability, cost and the wider product experience.
* You share knowledge through pairing, reviews and clear documentation, while asking for help early when a problem needs wider input.

**The impact you’ll make**
--------------------------

* Customers receive reliable features that are easy for the team to understand and extend.
* Components have clear boundaries, sensible abstractions and automated coverage.
* Production issues are diagnosed quickly because the right signals and documentation are in place.
* The team can trust your delivery, your reviews and your communication.
* Application and data integrations have clear ownership, interfaces and failure behaviour.
* Data\-dependent features work coherently from source system through to analytics and customer experience.

**The tools and ways of working**
---------------------------------

* C\# and .NET for services, APIs and application development.
* Strong SQL and relational data stores, with an interest in how application data becomes reliable analytics data.
* Automated unit and integration testing, Git, CI/CD and environment\-aware delivery.
* Observability through logging, metrics, tracing and production diagnostics.
* Cloud\-hosted services, with AWS experience useful in our wider platform environment.
* AI\-assisted engineering tools such as Claude Code or Codex, used with disciplined review and validation.
* Agile planning, code review, incident response and collaborative technical documentation.

**Why you’ll love it here**
---------------------------

* Competitive salary, dependent on experience.
* Flexible, hybrid working, with collaboration across the team and time to focus when you need it.
* 25 days’ holiday, plus one extra day after three years, and your birthday off.
* UK bank holidays, plus Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve afternoons off.
* Private medical insurance with enhanced mental health, dental and optical coverage via AXA.
* Employee Assistance Programme, support when you need it.
* Life insurance at 2x salary and matched pension contributions of 5%.
* Two volunteer days per year, give back to causes that matter to you.
* Access to Mintago for financial wellbeing, discounts and expert advice.
* Retail discount scheme, perks and savings just for being part of our team.

**The hiring process: let’s make it personal!**
-----------------------------------------------

**Screening call:** A virtual chat with one of our team to learn more about your experience, what excites you about the role and how you align with our people\-first culture.

**Competency interview:** You’ll meet the hiring manager and talk through your approach to software design, development, testing, debugging, security and collaborating across Engineering, QA, Product and Data.

**Final stage interview:** You’ll meet members of the wider team and explore how you would build reliable services, make sound technical decisions and contribute to a strong engineering culture.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer in Test - Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
**About Scale Factory**


We are an AI enablement consultancy. Delivering quality\-led AI\-first foundations, embedding capability and excellence into the foundational fabric of the companies we work with. We give leaders the confidence to move faster, take smarter risks and pursue transformation.


Formerly Ten10, we have deep roots in Quality which means we don’t just build for the future, we ensure it actually works. We combine this engineering discipline with cutting\-edge AI expertise to deliver robust, scalable foundations that turn ambitious transformation into reliable reality.

**Here’s why you’ll love being part of our team:**

* Exciting Projects: Collaborate on challenging, impactful projects with a wide range of industries \- from finance to government and beyond
* Career Growth: Tailored training and development opportunities to help you reach your goals
* Team Culture: Join a supportive, inclusive team that values collaboration, creativity, and innovation
* Flexibility: Hybrid working lets you balance work and life

**About the Role**


This is more than just a job, it’s an opportunity to lead, innovate, and grow. As a **Senior Software Developer in Test**, you’ll:

* Work with our clients to design, build, and implement cutting\-edge automation frameworks and testing solutions.
* Lead and mentor small teams of automation testers, providing guidance and technical direction.
* Take ownership of QA strategies, influencing testing best practices.
* Play a client\-facing role, ensuring our solutions align with their business needs.

**What We’re Looking For**


We know great talent comes in many forms. If you’re excited about this role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you!

**Essential Skills \& Experience:**

* Eligibility for **SC clearance**
* Significant experience in **Agile environments** (e.g., SCRUM, Kanban).
* Solid technical development background with strong coding skills in **Java, C\#, TypeScript, JavaScript, or similar**
* Proven expertise in automation testing, with hands\-on experience using tools like **Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or RestAssured**
* Strong knowledge of integration testing and automation frameworks
* Experience leading small teams of testers and contributing to the overall **QA strategy**
* Knowledge of performance testing tools like **JMeter, Gatling, K6 or Neoload**
* Hands\-on experience with **CI/CD pipelines** and tools **(e.g., Jenkins, CircleCI, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps)**
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

**Bonus Points for:**

* Previous experience in a consultancy environment
* Hands\-on coding experience in additional languages like Python, Ruby, Scala, PHP, or C\+\+

**What’s in It for You?**


At Scale Factory, we believe in recognising and rewarding great work. Here’s what you can expect:

* 25 Days of Annual Leave: Plus 1 extra day every year for the first three years, with a holiday buying scheme.
* Pension Plan: Employer\-matched contributions up to 5%.
* Health Benefits: Comprehensive coverage for medical, dental, optical, and alternative therapies.
* Fitness Support: Subsidised gym memberships and a bike\-to\-work scheme.
* Commuter Benefits: Season ticket loans to make travel easier.
* Free Annual Rail Cards
* Electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme
* Flexible Work Model: Hybrid working that fits your lifestyle.
* Social Events: From annual kick\-offs and Christmas parties to team socials and sporting events, we love celebrating success together.
* Training \& Development: Tailored learning opportunities and full support for certifications to keep your skills sharp.

**Let’s Build the Future Together**


We’re on the lookout for passionate, talented individuals who are ready to make an impact. Whether you’re an experienced automation tester or a developer with a flair for QA, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
**Join our expanding engineering team! We're actively recruiting a Senior Backend Engineer to help scale M\-KOPA Mobility, our fast\-growing e\-mobility business.** **This is an initial 12\-month Fixed Term Contract, with the potential to extend or transition into a permanent role. Build the event\-driven microservices that power clean, affordable transport for riders and entrepreneurs across Africa.**

**The Impact** – Africa's transport sector is massive, underserved, and at an inflection point, and the transition to electric is accelerating, led by East Africa. Your code will directly power the technology behind Kenya's leading e\-mobility financing platform. We've already financed over 11,000 electric motorbikes, helping riders save more than $3 a day and cutting air pollution by 90%. It's your chance to build tech for a business that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent


**The Opportunity**

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer II - Java, React
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Build real, production\-grade software that powers our global banking businesses. At JPMorganChase, we believe great engineers are made through meaningful challenges, strong mentorship, and a culture that rewards curiosity and craftsmanship. Here, you'll work alongside experienced engineers who are passionate about clean code, scalable architecture, and continuous improvement — and you'll have the opportunity to explore emerging technologies like AI and GenAI from day one.


As a Software Engineer II at JPMorganChase within \[Insert Team Name / Line of Business], you will ship secure, full\-stack features, write clean Java code, and deepen your expertise in modern engineering practices — including microservices, event\-driven architecture, and CI/CD — while building the foundation for a serious, long\-term engineering career. You'll tackle real debugging and performance challenges, automate away recurring issues, and contribute to a team culture centered on fast feedback, strong code reviews, and scalable design. This role offers you the opportunity to grow quickly, make a visible impact, and help shape the technology that serves millions of customers worldwide.

**Job responsibilities**

* Design and deliver creative software solutions, contributing to the full development lifecycle — from design and development through to technical troubleshooting and problem resolution
* Build secure, high\-quality production code and review and debug code written by others to improve overall quality and maintainability
* Identify and implement automation and sustainable fixes for recurring issues to improve the operational stability and resiliency of applications and systems
* Partner in technical evaluations with external vendors, startups, and internal teams by contributing to outcomes\-oriented reviews of architecture, technical capabilities, and platform fit
* Contribute to communities of practice across software engineering by sharing knowledge, supporting adoption of modern technologies, and promoting engineering best practices
* Leverage enterprise\-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards
* Apply knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation
* Support a team culture that values diversity, opportunity, inclusion, and respect

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and expanding applied experience
* Hands\-on experience contributing to system design, application development, testing, and production support and operational stability
* Strong proficiency in Java and common frameworks such as Spring Boot, Hibernate, JPA, and Spring Kafka
* Working knowledge of microservices architectures and Kafka or other messaging and event\-driven architectures
* Experience with automation and continuous delivery practices, including build and test automation and CI/CD pipelines
* Proficiency across the Software Development Life Cycle including requirements, design, implementation, testing, release, and support
* Good understanding of Agile delivery, including CI/CD concepts, application resiliency, and secure engineering practices
* Demonstrated ability to develop within at least one technical discipline such as cloud, data, or mobile
* Hands\-on experience using enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, testing, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate and validate AI\-generated outputs
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience with additional languages and frameworks such as .NET (C\#) and Python
* Familiarity with modern front\-end technologies such as React and/or Angular
* Experience with container platforms and platform\-as\-a\-service environments, including Kubernetes and Cloud Foundry
* Familiarity with Generative AI tools and patterns such as prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector search and embeddings, and safe and secure adoption practices


**ABOUT US**
  

  

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first\-class business in a first\-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long\-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  

  

J.P. Morgan's Commercial \& Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

jobs.title: Senior Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Quality Assurance and Testing is an important part of the delivery of digital systems within the HRA. We have a team of skilled test professionals who make sure quality is delivered in the most effective way. We are looking to add automation engineering skills to our existing team as we value automating as much of the test effort as possible allowing our team of specialists to undertake better evaluations of the overall product set.
  
  

As a Senior Test Engineer, you will create and drive the automated test engineering approach within the RSP working closely with the Head of Test and others in the Agile development team. You will determine and implement automation approaches using Playwright(typescript) to assure, measure and build quality into every phase of the software life cycle. This involves developing or enhancing automation frameworks that help deliver scalable tests which are faster, frequent, and continuous. Job also involves performing manual testing where automation is not suitable.
  
  

The interview will contain a mandatory technical test for playwright/NFT coding skills where you will be expected to write and share code in the interview. You should demonstrate your knowledge of this on your CV.
  
  

PLEASE READ
  
  

Applicants should submit an anonymised CV for this role, removing any personal and identifiable information before uploading (name, email etc.).
  
  

We kindly ask that only those who have not previously applied to this post in the last 6 months submit their application.
  
  

Identify new and implement existing test automation frameworks
  
  

Work on both functional and non\-functional areas of complex system(s) built with multiple technologies (Microsoft, PEGA etc)
  
  

Identify and raise awareness of defects, issues, risks arising from the automation test results
  
  

Be proficient in a range of coding languages (C\#, .Net, Java, JavaScript, Node, React, typescript etc)
  
  

Work closely with members of Agile team
  
  

Collaborate with senior test analysts, business to make sure the required business scenarios are covered in the test scripts
  
  

Carry out system, integration and user acceptance testing using manual and automated techniques
  
  

Lead on change impact assessment of all changes ensuring that test coverage mitigates any impact to external stakeholders
  
  

Work with the HRA’s User Acceptance Team representatives and external users to perform acceptance testing of HRA software system changes
  
  

Manage own work within the timelines agreed
  
  

Duties above are not an exhaustive list. The applicant will be expected to perform their duties as per ISTQB best practices (automation \& manual)

We strive to promote a healthy workplace culture where wellbeing, collaboration, and professional growth are valued and encouraged.

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We know from experience that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger, more creative workplace that helps us to deliver the best services. Job responsibilities
  
  

Please refer to the attached job description and person specification documents for full details about this role.

**The HRA is made up of five directorates:** Approvals, Chief Executive, Digital, Policy and Partnerships and Resources.

jobs.title: Senior / Principal Electrical Engineer (Building Services)
jobs.description:
Electrical Engineering
UKIMEA Region

BRI0001XE Requisition \#  

**Joining Arup**


Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.


Around the globe, Arup’s electrical engineers bring specialist expertise to solutions for buildings, transport infrastructure and energy, water and waste utilities. Our comprehensive services include energy audits, demand assessment, supply and system resilience, utilities consultancy and sustainable electrical engineering design.


Whether in commercial property, retail, sport, mission\-critical facilities, the arts or any market, we meet the creative and commercial demands of designers and developers. We are trusted to bring inventive solutions to complex technical challenges for clients in the Midlands including: NHS, University of Warwick, University of Nottingham, Defra (Department for Environment Food and Rural Affairs) Rolls\-Royce Motor Cars and Rolls\-Royce PLC.


Whatever the role or specialism, our people are passionate about what they do, they believe in our values and are happy to come to work every day. And this is why people choose to work here and stay.

  

**The Opportunity**


As a Senior / Principal Electrical Building Services Engineer, you will be a key part of the Building Services Engineering team, working on multidisciplinary projects providing guidance to other engineers and working alongside building physicists, sustainability consultants, energy and carbon consultants and BIM modellers. This team forms part of the wider region which includes civil, structural, fire, acoustics, specialist lighting, and other engineering disciplines. We are open to talking to candidates who are Chartered or who could work towards Chartership within 12 months.  

  



Your engineering insight will help shape projects that move us closer to a net zero carbon future. You’ll contribute to the development of innovative, sustainable solutions that balance technical excellence with environmental responsibility.


Collaboration is key at Arup. You’ll work closely with both internal and external teams, using clear and effective communication to ensure successful project outcomes. This includes liaising directly with clients and leading meetings to understand their needs and deliver value.


You’ll be encouraged to take a holistic view of design challenges—considering the broader context and long\-term impact of your decisions to benefit the overall project.


Working in an interdisciplinary environment, you’ll help design buildings that maximise value for clients while minimising environmental impact. Your leadership will guide MEP teams across local, national, and international projects, ensuring technical quality and consistency throughout.


Project management will be a core part of your role. You’ll be responsible for the financial performance of your projects, including fee negotiations and commercial discussions with clients. You’ll also oversee project delivery, managing teams and delegating effectively to ensure timely and high\-quality outcomes, reporting to the Project Director.


Supporting and developing others is central to our culture. You’ll help nurture a team of engineers, maintaining oversight of design quality, resource planning, and mentoring less experienced colleagues to help them grow.


Finally, you’ll contribute to Arup’s digital transformation—exploring new ways to improve efficiency through automation and enhancing our service offering through integrated digital design approaches.


At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.


You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.

  

**Is this role right for you?**


**We are looking for people who:**


Is degree qualified in Electrical, Building Services or Architectural Engineering.


Holds Chartered Engineer status via an appropriate professional institution such as IET or CIBSE, however we will also consider candidates close to Chartership.


Has experience of winning and delivering a range of projects.


Has the ability to provide technical leadership of multi\-disciplinary design teams including external sub\-consultants.


Has strong awareness of appropriate sector\-specific legislation, regulatory requirements and design guidance and future trends.


Has knowledge and interest in sustainable building design in terms of both energy and carbon and satisfying associated regulatory requirements.

  

  

Not ready to apply just yet, or have a few questions? Contact Rebecca Davies on rebecca.davies@arup.com \- please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.  



  

**What we offer you**


At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.


Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.


We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.


Arup offer a hybrid working model and flexible working arrangements to support work\-life balance. We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.

  

**Different people, shared values**


Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.


Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross\-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ\+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your\-life\-at\-arup.


We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact Rebecca Davies to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

  

**Our Application Process**


To understand what to expect next, please visit https://www.arup.com/careers/recruitment\-process/
  

  

Stay safe online – Arup will never ask for your bank details as part of our recruitment process.  

  



Recruitment Agencies \- We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.

  

  

We will close the role once we have offered the position, so please ensure you apply now.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Graduate
jobs.description:
About the Role  

Ready to launch your engineering career while shaping the future of energy? At EDF power solutions, you'll gain hands\-on experience, learn from experts, and help deliver renewable energy projects that support the electrification of homes, businesses and communities across the UK.

**The Opportunity**


As an Electrical Engineering Graduate, you'll earn a salary of £37,500 per annum and begin your career at EDF power solutions in early September 2027\. You'll develop technical and professional skills while building a strong foundation for a long\-term engineering career.


Over this 16\-month programme, you'll rotate across Engineering teams and work on wind, solar PV and private wire projects. You'll gain experience from development through to commissioning while contributing to projects that support our ambition of powering an Electric UK and Ireland.

**What You’ll Experience**


As an Engineering Graduate at EDF power solutions, you'll gain exposure to a range of renewable energy technologies while supporting projects that help transform how energy is generated, stored and supplied across the UK.


You'll support engineering activities across solar PV, battery storage and private wire projects. From feasibility studies and design development to technical assessments and problem\-solving, you'll learn how projects are delivered safely, effectively and compliantly.


You'll also review technical documentation, collaborate with project teams and build practical industry knowledge. We'll support your development as you begin your journey towards chartership with the Institution of Engineering and Technology or another relevant professional body.

**Location**


You'll be based at one of our key sites in \#Edinburgh, \#London or \#Durham. During the programme, you'll have opportunities to complete placements across different locations, giving you valuable exposure to a range of teams, technologies and operational environments.


Most roles require between three and five days per week on site. Depending on your placement rotations, travel and relocation may be required during the programme. We'll provide practical and financial support to help make these transitions as smooth as possible.

**Why EDF power solutions?**


We're united by a shared ambition: to tackle climate change, shaping an Electric UK and Ireland. Our diverse team is growing fast, driven by innovation and a commitment to clean, green energy for all.


With technologies spanning onshore and offshore wind, solar, battery storage and green hydrogen, we're one of the UK's and Ireland's most diverse renewable energy generators. By 2035, we aim to deliver 10GW of low\-carbon energy capacity, and we'd love you to help us get there.

**Where This Programme Could Take You**


Ben completed EDF power solutions' Science and Engineering Graduate Programme, where he worked on a variety of projects that developed both his technical engineering expertise and broader professional skills. The programme gave him meaningful responsibility and exposure to different engineering environments.


Working alongside experienced colleagues, Ben strengthened his technical knowledge, built his confidence and developed skills that helped him transition successfully into a permanent engineering role within the business.


"During my time on the EDF power solutions graduate programme, I had the opportunity to work on a wide range of projects, which helped me develop both my technical engineering skills and broader professional capabilities. I was trusted with meaningful work that made a genuine contribution while always having support from experienced colleagues. It was an incredibly rewarding experience that gave me the skills, confidence and experience to progress into a permanent engineering role."

**Who You Are**


To be eligible for this EDF power solutions graduate programme, you need to have achieved, or be expecting to achieve, a bachelor's or postgraduate degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Control Systems, Control and Instrumentation, or a related subject.


To be appointed to this role, you will need to meet the criteria for Security Vetting, which will, ordinarily, require you to have been a resident of the UK for at least three of the past five years.


Please note that an Assessment Centre stage of the hiring process will take place online, on 11th November 2026\. Applicants must be able to attend on this date to be considered for the programme.

**Pay, Benefits and Culture**


If you’re looking to join a company where you can work hard, have fun, and help to create a net zero future – then you’re in the right place! If you’re passionate about tackling climate change to support a cleaner, greener future, we’d love you to come and join us.


Alongside a starting salary of at least £37,500 per annum, potential for an annual bonus, and a market\-leading pension scheme, your package will include customisable benefits such as electric vehicle leasing, discounted gym membership, life assurance, tech vouchers, experience days, and more.


Everyone is welcome at EDF power solutions; we’re committed to building a workforce that reflects gender balance, social mobility, and inclusion of minority ethnic backgrounds, LGBTQ\+ communities, and those with disabilities.


As a Disability Confident employer, we're committed to creating an accessible recruitment process and encourage candidates to tell us about any support they may need. Should you disclose a disability and meet the minimum criteria (which will include holding a relevant degree discipline/grade and achieving the required pass mark for Stage 1 Testing) for the role you’ll be progressed to the first stage of the selection process. Some of our roles at EDF attract large volumes of applications. When this happens, we’ll apply the Disability Confident scheme’s guidance on taking practical and appropriate steps selecting disabled candidates who best meet the minimum criteria for the job.

**Our Recruitment Process**


We'll guide you through every stage and keep you updated along the way. You'll be supported by real people, with opportunities to ask questions, learn more and receive feedback where possible.


For our Early Careers Programmes, we use a combination of automated decision\-making, assessment technology and human review. Find out more by referring to our EDF Recruitment – AI and Automated Decision\-making policy.

jobs.title: Asset Engineer
jobs.description:
Team
**Engineering**
Business Unit
**National Grid Ventures**
Requisition No.
**5404**
City
**Ashford, GB, TN25 6AF**
Date posted
**13 September 2026**  

**Asset Engineer**
==================


### **About the role**


National Grid Ventures Interconnectors is playing a critical role in connecting the UK's energy system with neighbouring countries, helping to deliver a more secure, resilient and low\-carbon energy future. Through our portfolio of High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) interconnectors, we enable the import and export of electricity, supporting the UK's transition to net zero while developing the infrastructure needed to meet future energy demands.


We're looking for an **Asset Engineer** to join our Asset \& Engineering team. In this role, you'll be responsible for the effective management, performance and maintenance of critical interconnector assets, helping to ensure exceptional levels of reliability, availability and operational resilience across our portfolio.


Working closely with site\-based and central teams, you'll use your technical expertise to develop asset strategies, drive maintenance excellence, improve asset health and support continuous improvement initiatives. You'll play a key role in ensuring our assets perform safely, efficiently and in line with all regulatory and operational requirements.


This position is based at our IFA1 site in Sellindge so candidates would be ideally be based within a hours commute.


### **What you'll do**


As an Asset Engineer, you will:


* Deliver asset health assessments and asset management activities in line with National Grid policies and standards.
* Develop and implement asset maintenance strategies to maximise asset performance, reliability and lifespan.
* Translate OEM technical guidance and engineering standards into practical maintenance plans, work instructions and Maximo task lists.
* Produce and manage maintenance plans and outage scopes to ensure maintenance activities are completed safely and effectively.
* Support the management of asset defects, equipment failures and technical investigations, identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions.
* Analyse asset performance data and provide recommendations to improve reliability and operational efficiency.
* Work collaboratively with site operations teams, engineering specialists and external partners to drive best practice across the interconnector portfolio.
* Coordinate with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) on warranty, performance and asset integrity matters.
* Maintain accurate asset records and support continual improvement of asset data within Maximo.
* Promote a strong culture of safety, compliance and continuous improvement across all engineering activities.
### **What you'll need**


* Experience in engineering and asset management, ideally within the utilities, energy, infrastructure or industrial sectors.
* Strong understanding of asset management principles and maintenance strategies.
* Knowledge of high\-voltage electrical systems or other critical infrastructure assets.
* Ability to interpret technical documentation, engineering drawings and OEM manuals.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to make informed technical decisions.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience using asset management systems such as Maximo or similar platforms.
* Understanding of risk management processes and regulatory compliance requirements.
* A proactive approach to continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* HNC in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent).
* Full UK Driving Licence.
### **What you'll get**


A competitive salary between **£47,442\.00 \- £56,173\.50 per annum**– dependent on capability.

  

  

As well as your base salary, you will receive a bonus based on personal and company performance and a competitive contributory pension scheme where we will double match your contribution to a maximum company contribution of 12%. You will also have access to a number of flexible benefits such as a share incentive plan, salary sacrifice car and technology schemes, support via employee assistance lines and matched charity giving to name a few.

  

This role closes on **28th September at 23:59**, however we encourage candidates to submit their application as early as possible and not wait until the published closing date as this can vary.


We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates – we make appointments purely on merit, assessed against objective selection criteria. We support flexible working and will make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process should you have any physical or mental impairment which may affect your ability to participate in the process.


Please note that in most cases, National Grid is unable to offer sponsorship for employment under the UK points\-based immigration system. As such, applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK without requiring sponsorship now or in the future under the UK points\-based immigration system. However, in exceptional circumstances where there is a clear and demonstrable need for specialist skills that cannot be sourced from the local labour market, National Grid may consider offering sponsorship. All applications are welcome from candidates who meet these requirements, regardless of race, nationality, or ethnic origin.

* Lead and support hardware/software integration and troubleshooting

Raytheon UK is a powerhouse in defence and aerospace, where innovation meets impact. jobs.description:
**About Marex**

Marex Group plc (NASDAQ: MRX) is a diversified global financial services platform providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients across energy, commodities and financial markets. The group provides comprehensive breadth and depth of coverage across four core services: clearing, agency and execution, market making, and hedging and investment solutions. It has a leading franchise in many major metals, energy and agricultural products, with access to 60 exchanges. The group provides access to the world's major commodity markets, covering a broad range of clients that include some of the largest commodity producers, consumers and traders, banks, hedge funds and asset managers. With more than 40 offices worldwide, the group has over 3,000 employees across Europe, Asia and the Americas.


For more information visit https://www.marex.com/


Vacancy Number: VN3065 \& VN3127


**Department description**

Marex has unique access across markets with significant share globally both on and off exchange. The depth of knowledge amongst its teams and divisions provides its customers with clear advantage, and its technology\-led service provides access to all major exchanges, order\-flow management via screen, voice and DMA, plus award\-winning data, insights, and analytics.


This role sits within the Technology department reporting to the Global IT Service Manager. Technology is central to the success of our organisation. The 290\+ strong global Technology Department and delivers differentiation, scalability and security for the business. Technology provides digital tools, software services and infrastructure globally to all business groups. Software development and application support teams work in agile ‘streams' aligned to specific business areas. Our other teams work enterprise\-wide to provide critical services including our global service desk, network and system infrastructure, IT operations, design, enterprise architecture and information security.


The Software Development function creates and maintains applications, frameworks and other software components to deliver to business requirements. Developers conceive, specify, design, engineer, document, test, and deliver bug fixes as needed to provide high quality software solutions. Each Development team is aligned to one of Marex's business divisions and works for that division under Head of Technology and corresponding Application Support team.


**Role Summary**


As a Software Developer specializing in C\# .NET or React, you will be a pivotal member of our Software Development team, contributing to the creation and enhancement of secure, responsive web applications tailored for front\-to\-back trading technology. Your expertise in C\# .NET or React and your strong emphasis on testing will be instrumental in delivering robust and reliable applications. In this role, you will use your architectural experience to help mature our existing software and efficiently migrate legacy platforms to the cloud, working closely with the platform engineering team to ensure seamless integration and deployment.


**Responsibilities**


***Role specific:***


* Design, code and test all components of modern web applications.
* Contribute to the overall architecture and design of the technology created/maintained by the development delivery team.
* Develop solutions to a high standard that is maintainable, testable and meets the requirement's acceptance criteria.
* Adhere to development best practices and processes.
* Communicate with team members, introduce ideas and keep abreast of the latest technologies.
* Liaise with business users to gather application requirements.
* Ensure delivered systems are of production quality. Ensure software is adequately documented for handover to the business.
* Follow coding standards and defined development process.
* Resolve third line support issues in a professional and timely manner.
* Be pragmatic \& delivery focused.
* Ensure solutions are not over engineered, always lean towards simplicity over unnecessary complexity


***All staff:***


* Ensuring compliance with the company's regulatory requirements under the FCA, NFA, AMF, AFM, MAS.
* Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company determined parameters are complied with.

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

To create revolutionary, story\-driven RPGs which go straight to the hearts of gamers — this is our mission. Want to dive deeper into our company’s culture? Explore our social media and check out our YouTube channel and Beyond the Game Blog where we share behind\-the\-scenes insights and stories direct from our team members!

 **Job Description**  

Join CD PROJEKT RED and help shape the future of QA Engineering across our projects and Shared Development Services initiatives. We’re looking for a **Senior QA Engineer** to help build and scale technical quality solutions, automation frameworks and testing infrastructure used across multiple Unreal Engine projects.


You will be part of the QA Engineering team within Shared Development Services (SDS) \- a shared technical group focused on improving quality, testability and development workflows through automation, reusable tooling and standardized testing platforms.


While the priority for this role will initially be supporting the development of Witcher 4 this is not a project\-dedicated position. Your work will contribute to long\-term cross\-project QA Engineering solutions and shared technical capabilities used across the studio.


This is an opportunity to join at the early stages of a highly innovative game and play a key role in shaping scalable QA engineering practices from the ground up. You will work closely with development teams to build and maintain automated testing solutions, testing environments and shared technical tooling supporting multiple teams and gameplay systems.

**Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with Engineering, Tech Art, Art, QA, DevOps, and central development services teams to support integration and deployment of automated testing solutions, shared tooling, and testing environments across projects.
* Design, develop, maintain, and extend automated test frameworks and testing infrastructure for Unreal Engine systems and reusable gameplay modules.
* Support migration, integration, and validation of shared automation solutions between different projects and development environments.
* Investigate, debug, and resolve technical issues related to automation, integrations, testing environments, CI/CD pipelines, and build infrastructure.
* Participate in the code review process and contribute to maintaining high engineering standards across QA automation codebases.
* Work closely with development teams to improve testability, reliability, scalability, and long\-term maintainability of shared systems.
* Proactively monitor and maintain CI/CD pipelines, ensuring rapid identification and resolution of build and test failures.

 **Qualifications*** 4\+ years of experience in QA Engineering, test automation, or software testing, preferably within the gaming industry.
* C\+\+ experience, especially within Unreal Engine environments.
* Knowledge of working with automated testing, tooling, and testing infrastructure in Unreal Engine environments.
* Experience developing and maintaining automated test frameworks and testing solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze, debug, and troubleshoot complex technical issues across systems, integrations, and development environments.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple disciplines and teams.
* Comfortable owning tasks and asking for input when needed with a strong sense of curiosity toward solving technical challenges.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience shipping an Unreal Engine\-based game for Xbox or PlayStation consoles.
* Prior experience with Unreal Engine, or a very strong understanding of Unreal from the development side, not limited to automated test work.
* Experience with containerization and cloud technologies (e.g., Docker, AWS, GCP).
* Experience with programming and scripting skills using languages such as Python, TypeScript or C\#.
* Experience with performance profiling, debugging or validation tooling within Unreal Engine environments.
* Experience with asset processing and validation pipelines, digital content authoring tools, or other proprietary game engine tools.
* Experience supporting shared tooling, reusable systems, or cross\-project technical initiatives.
* Experience working with CI/CD systems and automation pipelines.

 **Additional Information** **Working mode**


In\-office in a hybrid or full\-time capacity in Warsaw, Poland.

**Health \& Well\-Being**

* Private medical healthcare — a selection of medical plans with dental care and unlimited rehabilitation to choose from, which are also accessible for your partner and relatives.
* Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones.
* Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company.
* Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well\-being initiatives.
* Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city.
* Menstrual leave — employees who menstruate can take one extra day off when experiencing period pain.
* RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family\-friendly events.
* RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majoritively paid by the company.

**Perks \& Professional Growth**

* A welcome pack filled with goodies — to help you feel right at home once you join the team.
* Trainings, lectures, and courses — workshops and trainings for each employee, knowledge\-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e\-learning classes are all available. There’s always something to learn!
* REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement.

Gifts for newborn rebels and regular chances to nab some cool swag!  
* 

**Social Activities \& Life in the Office**

* Dog\-friendly office — dog owner? Bring your pooch with you and look after them while working! There’s always a furry friend or two to meet at the studio.
* Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together.
* Healthy selections — canteens.
* Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world.
* Sustainability is an ongoing commitment for us, and our campus has electric car charging points, green zones, and much more. Read all about it on our Beyond the Game Blog.
* A designated space for your bicycle, as well as bicycle repair equipment and showers available whenever you need them.
* An onsite, well\-equipped gym with a climbing wall, daily Gym Assistant support, and yoga and boxing classes.
* No dress\-code — we like to keep it casual.

jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

**Are you an experienced backend developer with a curious mindset?** Do you have a passion for building intuitive, cutting\-edge solutions with state\-of\-the\-art technology?


At LeoVegas, we’re on a mission to deliver the greatest iGaming experience to our customers and technology is at the heart of making that happen.


As part of our Retention domain, you’ll play a key role in developing the platforms and features that keep players engaged and coming back for more.


This is a great opportunity to join a fast\-moving, flat\-structured team as a Senior Backend Engineer, where your work will directly shape value\-generating features across our products.


The Retention team powers the organisation with communication capabilities, ranging from indirect and direct communication with the players to a custom\-built toolbox that enriches the player journey with bonuses, loyalty programs, and seamless cross\-channel experiences. As one of the most crucial parts of the player lifecycle, the Retention domain ensures our players return for new, exciting, and rewarding experiences.


We’re driven by excellence and fuelled by innovation now we’re looking for someone who wants to be part of that journey.

* Building scalable, robust and efficient solutions in our full\-stack team and ensure the continuous delivery in our microservice architecture.
* Being involved in technical discussions to challenge, propose, evaluate, and take a guiding and supportive approach to business needs.
* Working closely with our operational units and stakeholders.
* Driving your own initiatives with a high\-quality mindset.

* Collaborative work across the organisation with other domains.
* Making sure our IT ecology is scalable and ready for upcoming expansions.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS

* Minimum of 6\+ years of experience working as a back\-end developer with Java and/or Kotlin
* Experience with messaging tools (i.e. Kafka)
* Experience with microservice architecture
* You have experience with common Java frameworks such as Spring and JPA

* Experience with AI tools like Claude

* Experience with OpenAPI
* Experience with BigQuery
* Experience with Kubernetes

At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the iGaming industry. We’re a team of almost 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast\-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.

* Free gym in the building

In our pride, we like to empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait around for things to happen. We pounce and make it happen!


Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride \- give us a roar!

jobs.title: .NET Backend Developer — 6-Month Project (NXJ-204)
jobs.description:
**The Role**
------------

As a Backend Engineer at our client, you will contribute directly to the core index layer, processing video indexing based on signals from the algorithm team. Your work will power the auto\-tagging engine—the system that splits sports games into distinct events and accurately assigns start and end times to each action. You will balance deep feature development with critical problem\-solving in a highly collaborative, AI\-integrated environment.


**About the Product**
---------------------


The product is an AI\-powered sports media platform used by major sports organizations to transform live broadcasts into personalized digital content at scale. Every live stream is continuously ingested, analyzed, and enriched with AI\-generated metadata, enabling automatic detection of key moments, intelligent video indexing, and near real\-time content creation.


Behind the scenes, the platform processes massive volumes of live and archived video 24/7, powering personalized fan experiences across web, mobile, social, and broadcast channels. The backend infrastructure is built for extreme throughput, low\-latency processing, and elastic scaling, combining distributed microservices with production\-grade ML inference pipelines to deliver reliable performance under unpredictable traffic peaks.


**Team Structure \& Collaboration:**

You will join a focused backend squad consisting of four developers, one QA, and one PM, led by the engineering manager. This squad sits within a larger group of two backend teams and two algorithm teams. Because the index layer relies heavily on algorithm signals, you will work in close daily collaboration with the AI and algorithm teams.  



**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

* **Video Indexing \& Auto\-Tagging:** Build and maintain the C\#/.NET backend infrastructure that interprets algorithm signals to index videos and auto\-tag live sports events
* **Technical Leadership:** Elevate the team by actively participating in design discussions, driving code review standards, and mentoring fellow developers
* **On\-Call Rotation:** Participate in a shared on\-call pool (approximately one week every five weeks). While critical nighttime or weekend outages are rare, you must remain reachable and have access to a laptop to respond to operations team escalations
* **Proactivity:** Execute tasks independently, demonstrate strong problem\-solving skills, and maintain prompt, proactive communication via Slack with the Israel\-based team

**What We Expect**
------------------


* Strong proficiency in C\# and .NET, with **5\+ years** **of commercial .NET experience**
* Hands\-on experience developing within **Azure** cloud environments
* Familiarity with and daily use of **AI\-assisted engineering tools** (e.g., Claude, Cursor)
* Excellent interpersonal skills with a proven ability to mentor peers and lead design discussions
* **High autonomy**, independent task execution, and proactive communication habits for effective distributed collaboration
* Familiarity with event\-driven messaging services such as **Azure Service Bus** or **Kafka**
* Working knowledge of **SQL databases** (general proficiency; specific engines do not matter)
* Basic familiarity with **DevOps terminology** and **Kubernetes** (operational expertise is not required)
* Willingness to work in a hybrid mode, **3 days from the office in Warsaw**

**Why This Role Is Worth Your Time**
------------------------------------


* Direct ownership of pure backend compute at scale—no full\-stack dilution, focusing entirely on high\-load microservices, indexing engines, and real\-time processing
* High\-autonomy environment with modern workflows where AI tools (Claude, Cursor) are embraced to eliminate boilerplate and keep focus on architecture

  
### **Category**


.Net · Backend · SaaS


### **Type**


### **Location**


hybrid · Poland · Warsaw

jobs.title: System Architect
jobs.description:
**Location:** EU remote

#### **About the Role:**


As a member of Auditdata's Architecture Group, you will join a highly skilled engineering organization building enterprise\-grade solutions for audiology clinic chains worldwide. You will shape integrations, domain boundaries, system design, and platform evolution across our SaaS product portfolio.

**Our tech stack** includes .NET, React ecosystem, Azure Servises (AKS, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Azure SQL Database).


#### **What You Will Do:**

**Integration \& API Architecture:**

* Define and maintain Manage’s integration strategy (REST, Events, APIs, Data Feeds).
* Design standard integration patterns — real\-time (Event Hubs), on\-demand (REST), hybrid workflows.
* Lead technical workshops with customers and partners to gather requirements and define integration approaches.
* Align integrations with domain boundaries, data contracts, and platform security standards.
* Govern message contracts, event schemas, versioning strategy, and error\-handling models.
* Enforce security best practices (OAuth2, mTLS, Azure AD, Key Vault).
* Oversee monitoring, observability, and integration reliability (tracking, retries, DLQs).

**Domain \& System Architecture:**

* Serve as the technical consultant for assigned domains, ensuring architectural integrity and consistent domain boundaries.
* Shape domain models and identify bounded contexts, aggregates, and integration points.
* Define APIs and event contracts across microservices and cross\-domain workflows.
* Evaluate epics and initiatives for architectural feasibility and appropriate service ownership.
* Support teams with high\-level design, technology selection, and patterns.
* Participate in architecture reviews and platform governance.
* Coach teams on DDD, Clean Architecture, and best engineering practices.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, specifications, interface documentation, and ADRs.

**Platform \& Multi\-Tenancy:**

* Design and own the architecture of a secure, performant, and cost\-efficient multi\-tenancy model.
* Contribute to the long\-term architecture vision and support the evolution of the platform strategy.

**Customer \& Pre\-Sales Engagement:**

* Participate in pre\-sales work, technical scoping, and early\-stage solution shaping.
* Support troubleshooting and performance improvements for complex integrations or distributed system issues.

#### **What You Will Bring:**


Technical Skills \& Experience:
