jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Junior Software Developer who wants to grow in modern software development and help build digital solutions for restaurants and foodtech.
  
This role is for you if you have a solid foundation in programming and want hands\-on experience building, testing, and maintaining software with experienced developers and other team members.
  
You’ll work across multiple product areas and contribute to solutions used in everyday restaurant operations—such as POS, online ordering, kitchen screens, self\-service kiosks, payments, and integrations.
  
About the role
  
As a Junior Software Developer, you’ll be part of our development team—developing, improving, and maintaining our digital products.
  
You’ll participate in the full development lifecycle, from understanding requirements and planning solutions to writing code, testing, troubleshooting, and following up on deliveries.
  
You’ll work closely with senior developers, product owners, QA, and other team members to deliver solutions with high quality, great user experience, and stable operations.
  
What you’ll do
  
Develop and maintain features in our web and backend solutions.
  
Write clean, structured, and testable code.
  
Participate in planning, estimation, and technical discussions.
  
Troubleshoot and analyze bugs in development and production.
  
Write and update unit and integration tests.
  
Contribute to building AI solutions.
  
Work with APIs, databases, and system integrations.
  
Review code with colleagues and give/receive feedback constructively.
  
Continuously improve development practices, code quality, and documentation.
  
  

What we’re looking for
  
Post\-secondary education in software development, computer science, or equivalent knowledge.
  
Basic programming experience (e.g., JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, C\#, Python, or similar).
  
Understanding of object\-oriented programming, data structures, and core software architecture.
  
Basic knowledge of databases, REST APIs, and Git version control.
  
Understanding of testing, debugging, and agile development methods.
  
Ability to communicate in English, both written and spoken.
  
A drive to learn, take ownership, and grow with the team.
  
  

Nice to have
  
Experience with React, Node.js, Java, TypeScript, or other modern frameworks.
  
Experience with cloud services, CI/CD, or containers.
  
Experience with SQL, relational databases, or message\-based integrations.
  
Personal projects, open\-source contributions, or relevant internship/work experience.
  
Experience building web applications, SaaS solutions, payments, POS systems, or e\-commerce platforms.
  
Interest in AI tools and how they can be used for development, testing, and product innovation.
  
  

Who you are
  
You’re curious and solution\-oriented—you like understanding how things work. You take initiative, ask questions when something is unclear, and use feedback to improve.
  
You work in a structured way and care about code quality, testing, and documentation, while also enjoying collaboration and sharing knowledge.
  
You don’t need to know everything from day one. The key is a strong technical foundation, genuine interest in software development, and the desire to grow in the role.
  
About us
  
We build digital systems used every day by restaurants and foodtech companies—POS, online ordering, self\-service kiosks, payments, integrations, and customer\-facing tools.
  
Our products operate in environments where stability, performance, and usability are critical. That’s why we work closely with customers and product teams to create solutions that make restaurant operations easier and more efficient.
  
Here, you’ll develop as a developer, work on real products, and be part of a team building the future of the digital restaurant experience.

jobs.title: Systems Development Engineer II, Amazon Robotics Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Amazon Robotics Infrastructure Engineering team is looking for a Systems Development Engineer to join our team. We build and operate the network and services that enable Amazon Fulfillment Centers, Middle and Last Mile facilities, including Air hubs, and PrimeNow to deliver packages to Amazon retail customers. From two million square foot automated robotics fulfillment centers to small last\-mile delivery stations in emerging markets, these networks are the backbone of Amazon Operations. Hundreds of thousands of associates rely upon these networks at thousands of locations, and are critical to the delivery of shipments to Amazon retail customers.  

  

Our mission is to design, deploy, and enable networks that sets the global standard for performance, availability, security and cost, enabling Fulfillment and Logistic operations to deliver on time, every customer order. We are looking for a Systems Development Engineer to create next\-generation network products. The team is focused on creating in\-house networks from leveraging open source tools and projects. We partner closely with IT support teams to ensure that simplicity in our product designs translate to operational readiness in the field. Information security rigor is at the core of everything we do. You will tackle complex, novel situations every day and have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. You should be comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity and relish the idea of solving problems that haven't been solved at scale before. It is expected that you will be technically pioneering, while at the same time being balanced and pragmatic in your approach. Along the way, we guarantee that you will learn a lot and make a positive impact on millions of people.  

  

The right candidate will have demonstrated experience leading large projects and have an expert level technical background in current networking technologies. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or multiple priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high\-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in and get the job done. As a Systems Development Engineer, you will anticipate bottlenecks, influence external vendors and internal team roadmaps, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Systems Development Engineer you will be expected to:  

* Write code for our most demanding, cross\-functional networking projects.
* Functionally decompose complex problems into simple, straight\-forward solutions.
* Fully and completely comprehend system inter\-connections and limitations.
* Effectively research and benchmark Amazon technology against other systems in the industry.
* Contribute intellectual property through patents.
* Assist in the career development of others, actively mentoring individuals and the community on advanced technical issues and helping managers guide the career growth of their team members.

  

A day in the life  

You will partner with Network, Software and Systems development Engineers to deliver automation for building and decommissioning the network infrastructure. Additionally create new tools or improve existing ones for network operators.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large\-scale infrastructure
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C\+\+, C\#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (C#/.NET, Azure)
jobs.description:
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**

SimCorp is developing a new game changing Software\-as\-a\-Service solution for Performance Measurement and Attribution, which will allow Investment Managers to interact with, and analyze their investments in a modern web application. It is connected to a high\-performance computing calculation engine in the back\-end, thus combining more than 50 years of industry\-leading experience of SimCorp with a modern user experience and cloud computing, enabling users to do in minutes what used to take hours.  



We welcome applications from both early‑career and mid‑career software engineers.  



**WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

* Build solutions: collaborate closely with your team, Product Managers, Architects, peers and end\-users to deliver high\-quality, secure and valuable solutions in the Performance Product Area.
* Contribute across the entire development lifecycle \- from requirements analysis and design to implementation, test automation, documentation, and ongoing support.
* Coordinate and execute on development and maintenance of the investment performance solution in collaboration with product owners and other teams.
* Think beyond the code: Understand our strategy, goals and customer needs to enhance SimCorp’s impact.

You will work closely with experienced engineers who support your development. Over time, you will grow into taking ownership of larger components and may mentor more junior colleagues as your experience grows.  

* 

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* Solid knowledge of C\#, .NET Core/Framework, and object\-oriented design principles.
* Experience with APIs.
* Familiarity with modern engineering practices, including CI/CD pipelines and trunk\-based development. We use Git (Azure DevOps).
* Interest in cloud engineering. We use Microsoft Azure.
* You understand the importance of automated testing of business‑critical functionality and quality assurance practices.
* Willingness to dive into a complex domain, working with finance, investment performance \& attribution and investment\-related instruments.
* You are able to solve complex problems in a structured manner.
* You are enthusiastic about building state\-of\-the\-art software, and have the mindset needed to make others understand your ideas.
* Curiosity and adaptability to learn in\-house tools and frameworks \- including the APL programming language (no prior experience in APL required, we provide extensive training).
* You are good at coordinating with both programmers and non\-programmers, to ensure a full understanding of tasks.
* You have a Master’s degree or higher within Computer Sciences, Engineering, Finance, Physics, Mathematics, Economics or similar experience.

If you have knowledge of a financial domain it is plus, otherwise we will bring you up to speed using technical discussions, training and a comprehensive onboarding program.  

* 

**WHAT IS IT LIKE TO WORK HERE**

SimCorp plans work in an agile manner, using 4 planning intervals (PI’s) per year, each consisting of 5 sprints of 2 weeks each, followed by a 3\-week Innovation and Planning sprint, which can be used for mastering skills in various areas, or more freely investigating ideas with prototypes. It is important that our people learn and grow constantly, and SimCorp invests a lot to foster the continuous learning environment to support people on their journeys.  



* **Global hybrid work policy** \- We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* **Growth and** **innovation** \- Every 6 th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
* **Self\- Direction** \- High degree of self\-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
* Inclusive and diverse company culture
* Pension and health benefits and bonus
* **Work\-life balance** – We strongly believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of our self’s, both in private life and as a colleague in the workplace
* **Empowerment** – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will involved in shaping our work processes
**NEXT STEPS**

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp , we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.


If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.


We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.


**WHO WE ARE**

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations , professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.


SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.


SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best\-in\-class solutions to our clients.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Energy Billing
jobs.description:
#### **About Reel**

  

We are rethinking electricity to accelerate the transition to a carbon\-free energy system.


Electricity is one of the biggest sources of carbon emissions globally, yet most green power sold on the market today fails move the needle toward decarbonizing electricity production.


Reel empowers companies to move beyond climate commitments and achieve real\-world carbon reductions, by bridging the gap between renewable energy producers and consumers.


Join our mission\-driven, cross\-disciplinary team of developers, builders, and climate experts working to accelerate the transition to a net\-zero economy.

#### **How you can contribute**

  

We’re working with some of the most exciting technologies within energy, delivering renewable power to corporates and balancing production from asset owners. We’re optimizing solar parks, wind farms, and grid\-scale batteries, trading across different markets and providing ancillary services to help stabilize the grid.


At the end of each month, we’re condensing all of this activity into a few numbers on an invoice for each of our customers. That’s only possible with a strong, purpose\-built energy billing platform.


As our new Software Engineer for billing, you’ll own and grow our next\-generation energy billing platform. You’ll work closely with Christian, our CTO, the rest of the engineering team, and our electricity operations team.

#### **What your role will look like**


These are some (not all) of the things you will be working on:

* **Own our energy billing tech:** Lead the work on continually improving and expanding our billing platform to serve new products, collaborating closely with engineering colleagues.
* **Expand into new markets:** Every market has its own rules, data, and (more often than not) quirks we need to adapt to. You’ll build the integrations that allow us to serve new markets, building on top of the platform we have today.
* **Energy analytics**: Structure and expand our financial data for accurate and up\-to\-date customer analytics and reporting.
* **Build the tools our team runs on**: Our electricity operations team settles all of our customers every month. Build the tooling that gives them the full picture, catches anything that looks off, and makes their workflow as automated as possible.
* **Raise the bar and help set the direction:** Perform code reviews, share feedback with colleagues, contribute to key technical decisions, and be a core member of the team shaping how our tech evolves.

#### **We think you will thrive in this role if**


You have shipped production software and know how to get things done. You take real ownership of your work and have a bias for shipping. You don't need to know anything about energy today or have years of experience with energy billing \- what matters most is that you're eager to learn and ready to put in the work.


You might also recognise yourself in some of these:

* You have solid experience building and maintaining backend systems in production.
* You have worked with billing, payments, settlement or other financial systems.
* You are comfortable being the person who cares whether a number is right.
* You care deeply about building reliable, scalable systems, while shipping frequently.
* You default to simple, pragmatic solutions.
* You work well independently, make decisions with confidence, and know when to bring others in.
* You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others level up.
* You are curious about how AI tools can help us ship better software as a team.


We work in Elixir and Python. We're hosted on GCP, use Kubernetes, data in Postgres w. TimescaleDB and BigQuery, and observability using Loki, Prometheus, and Grafana. We strive to keep our infrastructure as code with tools like Terraform and ArgoCD. Experience in this specific stack is by no means a requirement.


Please note that we are located in Copenhagen, Denmark and this is an in\-office role with flexibility for occasional hybrid work.

#### **Working at Reel**


At Reel, we care deeply about our people. We offer a workplace that values initiative, ownership and kindness, with ample room for personal and professional growth. We believe great teams are built by welcoming people with different backgrounds, perspectives, and lived experiences.


You will join a tight\-knit team on an ambitious journey, where the impact of your role will be visible and recognisable on a daily basis. Every colleague \- from founders to student assistants \- are in this together. We cherish focus and autonomy just as much as team work and setting time aside for having fun together \- at our monthly socials, bi\-annual offsites and daily coffee chats in our bright and spacious office in central Copenhagen, 2 minutes from the metro.


Read more about working at Reel at our Careers page.

#### **What we offer you**


At Reel, we offer you an organisation that cares as much for its people as for the climate. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where your personal growth and well\-being is imperative.

* **Compensation:** A healthy base salary \+ warrant programme
* **Vacation:** 30 days (5 weeks \+ 1\) of paid holidays to recharge
* **Pension:** Employer\-supported pension scheme, including health insurance
* **Parental leave:** A generous parental leave policy
* **Equipment:** Choose your preferred IT setup (Mac, Windows, etc.) with a budget of 25,000 DKK
* **Office:** A vibrant office\-first culture in central Copenhagen with a flexible remote work policy
* **Lunch:** A delicious lunch at the office every day — and your daily caffeine fix from our espresso machine
* **Socials:** Monthly social events and bi\-annual offsites where we have fun, unwind, and nurture our team spirit
* **Visa:** We try to support non\-EU residents by sponsoring visas whenever we can, but our ability to do so depends on the role

#### **Interested?**


We are very excited hearing from you. You can find more information about the interview process here.

*You don't feel like you fulfill all the criteria?*


We know that 'perfect' candidates do not exist. The only thing you need to ensure is that the problem we are solving at Reel is one you cannot wait to get out of bed for on Monday morning.

***We encourage all candidates, regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, etc. to apply.***

jobs.title: Service Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
KONE moves two billion people every day. As a global leader in the elevator and escalator industry, we employ over 60,000 driven professionals in more than 60 countries worldwide joined together by a shared purpose, to shape the future of cities. In 2025, we had annual net sales of EUR 11\.2 billion.


KONE has consistently been featured on Forbes list of World's Best Innovative Companies, World's Best Employers \& World's Largest Public Companies. At KONE, we believe in teamwork and a work culture where everyone can be who they are. This is exactly what makes us strong and successful.


**Why this role?**

The Service Sales Hunter spends most of the time building new relationships and selling maintenance contracts and related digital services outside current customer base.


**What will you be doing?**

Customer relationship management


* Proactively develops and creates customer relationships in his/her area of responsibility
* Is accountable for developing KONE position in his/her customer base or market area
* Creates and communicates leads and sales opportunities for entire KONE sales team (e.g.
* cross\-selling)
* Ensures customer satisfaction and solves complaints with the rest of KONE team
* Documents the customer and contact information, maintains customer data

Sell


* Proactively generates opportunities from outside current customer base
* Handles RFQs
* Is accountable for leads, opportunities, orders and contracts to meet the sales budget and pricing targets
* Is accountable for finding customer needs and that KONE’s solution matches with the needs
* Is responsible for pricing using the approved tendering tools, and for optimizing prices and discounts within his/her authority
* Validates that the contents of the contract are in line with the negotiation process outcome
* Maintains full information of opportunities, tasks and visits (sales funnel management)
* Responsible for timely and accurate reporting in CRM
* Responsible for gathering relevant information about market and competitors from the field
* Supports the finance function in money collection.
* Drives execution of her/his individual sales plan

**Are you the one?**

* Bachelor or Master’s degree in economics, engineering or other relevant field
* Experience from/ familiar with solution selling methodology
* Experience from / familiar with KONE customers’ industries is a plus
* Sales and/ or customer service experience
* Masters the sales process
* Numbers and facts drive actions
* Is able to bring across customer needs, add value to customers’ businesses by offering solutions that meet their needs and is able to use value based pricing to guarantee healthy margins
* Comfortable and excited about the opportunities that digital solutions bring.

  

**What’s On Offer**

* Career progression in opportunities within a global organization
* Total reward elements that engage and motivate our employees and help us make KONE a great place to work
* Comprehensive learning and development programs covering a wide range of professional skills
* You are surrounded by fun colleagues and a lively working environment. The best part is all leaders are great and open\-minded

  

**To Be Considered**  

  

Click the Apply button and complete the online application process. A member of our Talent and Culture team will review your application and will be in contact with additional information accordingly.
  

  

In the meantime, feel free to browse our website for additional information on our company, brands and culture – KONE Corporation.

Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co\-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


Build the enterprise platforms that power intelligent operations.  

  

Join Agilent's Global OT \& AI Engineering organization and help develop the cloud\-native platforms that connect enterprise systems, manufacturing operations, and intelligent digital solutions across Agilent's global operations.  

  

As a Digital Solutions Engineer – Platform Services, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services, enterprise APIs, integration platforms, and cloud\-native applications that enable secure, reliable, and real\-time information exchange across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, Quality, Engineering, and Operational Excellence.  

  

Working closely with Application Experience Engineers, Data Engineers, AI \& Data Scientists, Smart Factory Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will develop the enterprise services that power digital products, operational analytics, AI applications, and connected manufacturing systems.

Our organization combines software engineering, enterprise data platforms, Artificial Intelligence, industrial automation, cloud technologies, and Smart Factory solutions to build scalable digital capabilities that improve operational visibility, accelerate decision\-making, and enable continuous improvement across global operations.

From enterprise APIs and integration services to cloud\-native microservices and event\-driven architectures, your work will provide the foundation that enables seamless communication between applications, data platforms, AI services, and manufacturing systems.


You will collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to develop reusable platform capabilities that accelerate software delivery, improve system reliability, and support Agilent's long\-term digital transformation strategy.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer (Aftermarket Applications)
jobs.description:
**Your role**
-------------

We are looking for a passionate and committed Senior Backend .NET Developer.


You will be part of our internal software development team working in the Aftermarket domain. This surrounds applications for providing technical support, processing warranty, tools for our Field Service Engineer, our back office (planning and order processing), spare part list applications and Serialized Information Management.


As such you will be responsible for technical application ownership and developments. Next to this you will be involved in the full redesign of our existing applications and creation of new applications as business needs arise in our Customer Centers.


You will have the opportunity to work with a highly motivated international business and software developer team in a challenging and very dynamic environment.


You build the back\-end behind our operational applications, not the screens in front of it. Your initial focus is the system that links as\-built documentation, bills of material and product definitions to serialized equipment and the installed base which is used by internal teams, by Customer Centers and by dealers, with a growing number of applications depending on its APIs. From there you work across the rest of our backend landscape: warranty automation and order evaluation, engineering change bulletins, maintenance engines and the shared services the whole portfolio runs on.


Your working level is domain models, APIs, events and data: what a service owns, what its contract promises, which events it publishes, and how its data is shaped so that it still answers the questions we will ask of it in three years. You work in an agile team with developers, architects and a product owner, shaping design decisions rather than only implementing them.


The work here is engineering, not configuration. We build on C\# and .NET (8 or later) on Azure: Function Apps and App Services for compute, Kafka and Azure Service Bus for the event streams that feed us, and a deliberately mixed data layer SQL for the queryable subset, a graph store for the relationships between equipment, components and product definitions. Services run behind private endpoints with managed identity and RBAC, ship through Azure DevOps pipelines with infrastructure as code, and are instrumented with Application Insights.


**To succeed, you will need**
-----------------------------

You have built back\-end systems that other teams and other applications depend on, ideally in an operational or business\-critical context where downtime is measured in stopped work rather than a slow page. You think in trade\-offs rather than absolutes, and you keep digging until you know why something failed, not just that it did. You work comfortably in an agile team, have the confidence to say in refinement that something cannot be built the way it is specified, and use AI tooling with the judgement to verify what it produces. This is a senior role: we expect you to own a domain end to end and make decisions the rest of the team builds on.


You will not have every item on the list below. Cover most of the must\-haves and be genuinely curious about the rest.


**Must\-have**

* **C\# / .NET (8 or later, moving to .NET 10\):** recent, hands\-on experience building production\-grade applications, not prototypes, at a level where you own a service end to end.
* **Azure:** practical experience with several of: Function Apps, App Services, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Blob Storage, Azure SQL, Key Vault, API Management, Application Insights.
* **REST API design and implementation:** designing and consuming well\-structured, versioned APIs, and thinking about the contract before the code.
* **SQL databases:** data modelling, query performance, and integrating relational data into cloud applications.
* **Testing as part of development:** unit and integration testing as a habit, not a separate phase handed to someone else.
* **Experience migrating .NET Framework systems to modern .NET and retiring what they replaced.**

**Strong plus**

* **Apache Kafka:** consuming event streams from systems you do not control, and living with what they send you.
* **Graph databases:** Neo4j or equivalent, and the modelling instinct for when a relationship belongs in a graph rather than a join table.
* **Secure\-by\-default cloud development:** managed identity, private endpoints, RBAC and secret management as normal practice.
* **Observability:** structured logging, tracing, alerting, and being on the hook for a system you built.
* **Domain\-driven design:** bounded contexts and aggregates applied to a real domain rather than a textbook one.
* **Microservice architecture:** service boundaries, inter\-service contracts, and the operational cost of getting them wrong.
* **Event\-driven and message\-based architecture:** queues, topics, event streams, and the practical problems that come with them: ordering, idempotency, at\-least\-once delivery, replay, poison messages.
* **CI/CD with Azure DevOps:** YAML pipelines, release management, and infrastructure as code (Bicep, Terraform or ARM).

**In return, we offer**
-----------------------

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well\-being, and we provide a flexible work\-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning.


You will have a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. You will also have access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. We offer an interesting compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.


**Job location**
----------------

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on\-site at Airpower in Antwerp, Belgium (BE).


  
Company: Atlas Copco Group
  

Location: Belgium
  

City: Antwerp
  

Date of Posting: September 14, 2026

jobs.title: Senior Netwerk Engineer
jobs.description:
**Tabaknatie is een logistieke dienstverlener in de Antwerpse haven, gespecialiseerd in de opslag en behandeling van goederen voor internationale klanten. Zowel op rechter\- als op linkeroever beschikken wij over gespecialiseerde magazijnen met een totale oppervlakte van meer dan 1\.000\.000m². Als Senior Netwerk Engineer maak je deel uit van ons IT\-departement en ga je aan de slag op ons hoofdkantoor in het centrum van Antwerpen.****WAT GA JE DOEN?**
===================


* Je bent binnen het team het aanspreekpunt voor het netwerk: van de core\-en access\-switchen in de kantoren en magazijnen tot de firewalls, WiFi\-dekking en de connectiviteit tussen onze sites.
* Je beheert, bewaakt en optimaliseert deze omgeving, en je werkt mee aan projecten zoals vernieuwingen, uitbreidingen en migraties.
* Operationeel beheer van de netwerkinfrastructuur: switching, routing, firewalling, WiFi en VPN.
* Opvolgen van incidenten en changes, inclusief root cause\-analyse en structurele oplossingen.
* Bewaken van documentatie, configuratiestandaarden en netwerkbeveiliging.
* Uitvoeren en begeleiden van projecten: van voorbereiding en planning tot implementatie en oplevering.
* Coachen van een junior collega: je neemt hem of haar stap voor stap mee in de netwerkmaterie en maakt van kennisoverdracht een vaste gewoonte.
* In het kader van NIS2, het mee bewaken van de netwerkbeveiliging: segmentatie, firewallbeleid, toegangsbeheer en hardening.

Je takenpakket stopt niet aan de grens van het netwerk. Je volgt actief de markt op voor nieuwe trends om mee te helpen bouwen van de roadmap. Afhankelijk van de noden van de organisatie schuif je mee aan bij bredere ondersteuning van de operationele teams op de werkvloer. Omdat onze operatie ook buiten de klassieke kantooruren doorloopt, ben je bereid om occasioneel onderhoud, upgrades en interventies vroeg ‘s ochtends, ‘s avonds of in het weekend uit te voeren. Ingrepen worden vooraf gepland en in overleg met het team afgesproken.
**WIE ZOEKEN WE?**
==================


Je hebt ruime ervaring als netwerk engineer en je weet waarover je praat. Je bouwt je advies op ervaring, onderzoek en overleg met je collega’s, niet op aannames. Daarnaast geef je graag je kennis door en hebt het geduld om een junior collega te laten groeien in plaats van het werk zelf over te nemen.
**Je beschikt ook over:**
=========================


* Ervaring met Cisco\-netwerkapparatuur is een must, net als aantoonbare ervaring in operationeel netwerkbeheer. Ervaring met Palo Alto\-firewalls is een plus.
* Kennis van of ervaring met informatieveiligheidsnormen zoals ISO 27001 of regelgeving zoals NIS2 is een plus.
* Een gestructureerde werking: je documenteert, plant je werk en houdt overzicht, ook wanneer er meerdere zaken tegelijk lopen.
* Een pragmatische en rustige houding. Bij een storing verlies je je kalmte niet en ga je methodisch te werk.
* Een professionele en heldere communicatiestijl, ook richting hoger management: je vertaalt techniek naar begrijpelijke taal, impact en opties. Dit in het Nederlands, maar ook Engels is een must.
* Een flexibele ingesteldheid en pakt daardoor aan wat nodig is, ook als het buiten je strikte specialisatie valt.
* Kennis van of ervaring in een magazijn\-, transport– of logistieke omgeving is een plus.
* Een rijbewijs B, om je te kunnen verplaatsen naar de verschillende sites en hoofdkantoren verspreid in de Haven van Antwerpen.

**Waarom voor Tabaknatie werken?**
==================================


Bij Tabaknatie zal je deel uitmaken van een hechte familie van getalenteerde professionals die elkaar ondersteunen en aanmoedigen om gezamenlijk grenzen te verleggen. We geloven in het creëren van een omgeving waarin iedereen zich gewaardeerd voelt en waar individuele groei en ontwikkeling worden gestimuleerd. Als wereldleider zijn we voortdurend in beweging, en dat houdt ons werk boeiend en uitdagend. Geen dag is hetzelfde bij Tabaknatie, en dat maakt ons uniek in onze branche. We omarmen verandering en innovatie, waardoor onze medewerkers de kans krijgen om hun vaardigheden te ontwikkelen en nieuwe mogelijkheden te ontdekken. Kiezen voor een carrière bij Tabaknatie betekent kiezen voor een werkplek waar je je gewaardeerd voelt, waar je kunt groeien en waar je deel uitmaakt van een familie die zich inzet voor succes. Sluit je aan bij ons team en ervaar zelf waarom onze medewerkers zo trots zijn om bij Tabaknatie te werken.

jobs.title: Teamlead software development Horizon
jobs.description:
.text\-block p { margin\-top: 0px; }
Voor ons ontwikkelingsteam achter Horizon, onze customer success portal die fungeert als dé centrale toegangspoort tot de diensten van Cegeka en klanten ondersteuning, inzichten en transparantie biedt, én als onze Employee Experience Portal, waarmee Cegeka\-medewerkers digitaal hun timesheets, afwezigheden en onkosten beheren, zijn we op zoek naar een getalenteerde en gedreven Teamlead. In deze rol bevind je je op het kruispunt van people leadership, procesoptimalisatie en product\- en technische expertise. Samen met je team bouw je mee aan digitale oplossingen die dagelijks een positieve impact hebben op zowel onze klanten als onze medewerkers.
Je leidt en coacht ons Horizon\-developmentteam, een team van ongeveer 10 getalenteerde collega's verspreid over een internationale omgeving (België, Roemenië, Moldavië en Griekenland).
Je combineert hands\-on leiderschap met een grondige kennis van Agile\-principes en helpt het team kwalitatief hoogstaand werk af te leveren, terwijl je zowel de individuele als de collectieve groei stimuleert.
Je creëert een cultuur van eigenaarschap, samenwerking en continue verbetering, over verschillende locaties en tijdszones heen.
Je faciliteert Scrum\-ceremonies zoals sprintplanningen, daily stand\-ups, reviews en retrospectives en zorgt ervoor dat Agile\-principes op een doeltreffende en pragmatische manier worden toegepast, zonder ze louter "by the book" te volgen.
Je bent eigenaar van de Jira\-werkwijze binnen het team en beheert de backlogstructuur, sprintboards, rapportering en proceshygiëne.
Je fungeert als brug tussen het developmentteam, product owners en stakeholders, waarbij je prioriteiten vertaalt naar duidelijke, concrete en uitvoerbare opdrachten.
Je identificeert en neemt zowel technische als organisatorische obstakels weg die het team kunnen vertragen.
Je ondersteunt de sprint\- en releaseplanning en bewaakt hierbij de juiste balans tussen scope, kwaliteit en oplevertermijnen.
Afhankelijk van je achtergrond draag je actief bij aan technische of productgerelateerde discussies, bijvoorbeeld door architectuurbeslissingen mee te beoordelen of productvereisten verder te verfijnen.
Je volgt de prestaties en deliverables van het team op aan de hand van relevante metrics en gebruikt deze inzichten om continue verbetering te stimuleren, niet als een loutere compliance\-oefening.
Wat breng jij mee?
Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen, begeleiden en coachen van een internationaal, verspreid team.
Je werkt graag samen met collega's uit verschillende landen, tijdzones en culturen.
Je hebt ruime ervaring in Agile omgevingen en hebt teams succesvol geleid, gecoacht of gefaciliteerd als Scrum Master, teamlead of in een vergelijkbare rol.
Je hebt een achtergrond in softwareontwikkeling of product ownership, waardoor je een geloofwaardige sparringpartner bent voor het team en vlot kunt deelnemen aan prioriteringsdiscussies.
Je hebt een gedegen kennis van Jira en voelt je comfortabel bij het configureren van boards, het beheren van backlogs en het vergroten van de transparantie binnen teams.
Je beschikt over sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en weet technische details moeiteloos te vertalen naar businessprioriteiten en omgekeerd.
Je beheerst het Engels vloeiend, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk, aangezien dit de voertaal is binnen het team. Kennis van het Nederlands is een pluspunt.
Je bent bereid om af en toe te reizen om teamleden of stakeholders in andere landen te ontmoeten.
Je hebt een pragmatische mindset gericht op continue verbetering en ziet Agile als een middel om samenwerking en waardecreatie te stimuleren, niet als een doel op zich.
Ervaring met het Horizon\-platform of een gelijkaardig product/domein is een troef.
Relevante certificeringen zoals PSM, CSM, PSPO, SAFe of gelijkwaardig zijn een pluspunt, net als ervaring met Confluence of andere documentatietools.
Je werkt minstens twee dagen per week vanuit ons kantoor in Hasselt (Corda Campus), aangevuld met tijd in een ander Cegeka\-kantoor (bij voorkeur Leuven) en thuiswerk.
Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?
We vragen heel wat (talenten) van jou. Gelukkig krijg je er ook heel wat voor terug! Competenties en karakter zijn voor ons essentieel, naast ervaring en ambities. Cegeka investeert voortdurend in talent management opdat alle medewerkers hun potentieel kunnen realiseren.
Je start bij een Top Employer.
Een marktconform dagtarief en tal van voordelen.
Cegeka bewijst jaar na jaar in het Whitelane Research dat we een betrouwbare en toonaangevende partner zijn op vlak van IT\-dienstverlening, met een eerste plaats in 2026 voor Security Services (vierde jaar op rij), een gedeelde tweede plaats voor Cloud \& Infrastructure Services en Network \& Connectivity.
Flexibele werkuren én een mooie work/life balans.
Een top team: waarin nieuwe frisse ideeën en initiatieven steeds welkom zijn! Team\-events, happy hours en een steeds legendarisch bedrijfsfeest horen daar ook bij.
Begeleiding op maat: doorheen jouw carrière word je begeleid door onze people managers. Zo heb je een aanspreekpunt, een persoonlijke coach én een sparringpartner.
Continu bijleren: door innovation centers, leesgroepen, knowledge sharing meetings, hackatons, deelname aan conferenties en externe opleidingen zetten we kennisdeling en bijleren centraal.
Mogelijkheid tot groei: afhankelijk van je eigen interesses en initiatieven, biedt Cegeka verschillende horizontale en verticale carrièrepaden.
Hybride werken: je werkt vanuit een Cegeka kantoor in jouw buurt (Hasselt, Leuven, Antwerpen, Gent, Diegem), maar ook bij onze klanten, gecombineerd met thuiswerk.
We hechten waarde aan duurzaamheid door CO2\-neutraliteit na te streven met de elektrificatie van ons wagenpark en een milieuvriendelijk datacenter. We ontwikkelen innovatieve oplossingen met een positieve impact op milieu, mens en maatschappij, en streven naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen gewaardeerd en gehoord wordt.

jobs.title: Software Developer (Java & Angular) (BE-GM-APC-2026-151-GRAP)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

Drive the modernisation of CERN's Geodetic Metrology data management system, migrating legacy Oracle APEX/PL/SQL applications to a Java/Spring Boot and Angular platform, while leading the redesign of a mission\-critical application for CERN's Accelerator Complex.

**Your responsibilities**

* Analyse Oracle APEX pages, processes and PL/SQL packages to understand business workflows and data dependencies.
* Implement Spring Boot REST APIs and Angular Frontend.
* Write automated tests and apply software quality practices.
* Participate in the whole software development lifecycle (requirements, design, development, testing), following a modern agile approach to ensure high\-quality outcomes.
* Interact with the end\-users of the services to understand their needs and help translate those into appropriate software solutions.
* Build strong partnerships with IT and multidisciplinary teams across CERN to ensure the delivery of reliable, maintainable, and scalable software solutions aligned with current needs and future strategic goals.
* This role includes team supervision responsibilities.


More information here.

**Your profile**

* Proven experience in designing and developing software applications using Java technologies and modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks.
* Practical experience with concurrent and multithreaded programming.
* Experience applying software quality assurance practices and using related tools (code review, preparing tests, deliver high quality documentation, unit tests, clean code, sonarqube).
* Experience in ICT systems architecture and design, including the design of scalable services and APIs.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated build, test, and deployment workflows.
* Experience with cloud\-native technologies, including Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of Oracle APEX would be an asset.


Skills

* Strong knowledge of the Spring framework ecosystem.
* Strong knowledge of relational database systems, particularly Oracle Database, including proficiency in PL/SQL.
* Ability to design reliable software services following SOLID principles or similar best practices.
* Knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC) tools, methodologies, and procedures.
* Ability to deliver high\-quality work on time and meet expectations.
* Contributes to a positive team environment through an optimistic and constructive attitude while proactively addressing issues.
* Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.


Eligibility criteria:

* You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
* You have a professional background in Software Engineering (or a related field) and have either:
	+ a **Master's degree with 2 to 6 years** of post\-graduation professional experience;
	+ or a **PhD with no more than 3 years** of post\-graduation professional experience.
* You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

  

**Additional Information**  

Job closing date: **06\.10\.2026 at 23:59 CEST.**


Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.


Working hours: 40 hours per week


Job flexibility: Hybrid


Target start date: 01\-November\-2026


Job reference: BE\-GM\-APC\-2026\-151\-GRAP


Field of work: Information Technologies


Benchmark job: 200020 \- Computing Engineer

**Global Benefits**

* A monthly net stipend of either 6372 or 7004 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.
* 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
* Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
* Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
* A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
* Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
* On\-the\-job and formal training including language classes.

**Overview of CERN \- Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!**


At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.


Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting\-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.


If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! **TAKE PART!**

**More information about us, here:** **careers.cern**

jobs.title: Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
SS\&C is a leading provider of mission\-critical, AI\-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS\&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid\-market firms, rely on SS\&C for expertise, scale, and technology.  



  

**Job Description**

  

Job Title: **Integration Engineer**

Location: **Madrid, Spain \| Hybrid 6 days a month**

**SS\&C Algorithmics**

The SS\&C Algorithmics (part of SS\&C Technologies Inc.) financial risk, regulatory and performance platform serves banking, insurance, asset management and hedge fund institutions. We partner with clients around the world to respond proactively and transparently to regulatory requirements and solve the most complex challenges in financial risk management and performance measurement.


**The Opportunity**

As an Integration Engineer, you will work across a broad technical stack including Linux, databases, scripting, interfaces, middleware, cloud and automation. Rather than focusing on a single technology, you will learn how complex enterprise systems are designed, integrated, deployed, tested and operated in real\-world environments.


This role is a great opportunity for a technically minded engineer who wants to combine hands\-on technology with real client exposure and ownership of complex implementation projects, and who enjoys understanding how systems work end\-to\-end, solving difficult technical problems and working with people as much as with technology.


You will work closely with some of the largest financial institutions in Europe, collaborating directly with client technology teams, project managers, financial engineers and SS\&C product specialists. From an early stage, you will be encouraged to take ownership of technical problems, contribute to solution design and become a trusted technical advisor to clients.


**What You Will Get To Do:**

* Define and specify the technical architecture and design of the SS\&C Algorithmics solution to be implemented.
* Define and scope the technical configuration, interfacing and enhancement work in conjunction with project managers, senior engineers and financial engineers.
* Provide technical consultancy to clients based on solid understanding of the Algo product suite and implementation requirements.
* Set up and configure Algorithmics and third\-party products (database, middleware, reporting solutions) at client sites.
* Design and implement interfaces between clients’ source systems and SS\&C Algorithmics products. This will largely involve the Algorithmics’ data mapping tool and definition of data required from the clients’ systems.
* Design, develop and implement customised modules using a range of development tools (typically shell, Perl or Python).
* Conduct troubleshooting, testing (functional and volume) for original installation and system upgrades, and support clients’ integration testing and acceptance testing activities.
* Where appropriate, deliver training through formal courses and workshop sessions for clients and internal teams.
* Produce technical documentation for clients describing the system and its customisations.

**What You Will Bring:**

* Bachelor's Degree in a technical degree (e.g., Computer science, telecom engineering, or a related technical field.
* English \& Spanish: Fluent
* High degree of initiative, resourcefulness, resilience, and self\-sufficiency in implementing and configuring complex software products and using technology to solve business problems.
* Hands\-on command of Unix / Linux, including shell scripting and file system navigation.
* Basic programming experience in at least one language (e.g., Java, Python, C\#, C\+\+, Kotlin, Rust
* AI \& Productivity Tools: Experience using AI agents \& tools.
* Capacity to estimate work, manage own deliverables and keep within project plans.
* Ability to work with competing demands in small multi\-disciplinary teams.
* Sound documentation and communication skills in a client\-facing environment.

**Desired:**

* Experience with middleware and business intelligence (reporting) software.
* Understanding of database essentials (including SQL, installation, sizing, performance). Specific DBA skills are not essential, but familiarity with at least one RDBMS is required.
* Client\-facing culture
* Familiarity with DevOps \& Cloud
* Understanding of the financial marketplace (market data, fixed income products, derivatives) in terms of the underlying data.

Familiarity with risk management (market risk/credit risk in a commercial or treasury environment), financial analytics and market data  

  



**Why You Will Love It Here!**

* **Flexibility** : Hybrid Work Model
* **Your Future:** Professional Development Reimbursement including access to SS\&C University
* **Work/Life Balance:** Competitive holiday scheme
* **Your Wellbeing:** Competitive benefits designed to support the wellbeing of our staff
* **Diversity \& Inclusion:** Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving on Diversity
* **Training:** Hands\-On, Team\-Customised throughout your career

*We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds to enable us to bring diverse perspectives to our thinking and conversation. It's important to us that we strive to have a workforce that is diverse in the widest sense.*

Thank you for your interest in SS\&C! If applicable, to further explore this opportunity, please apply directly with us through our Careers page on our corporate website @ www.ssctech.com/careers .  



Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS\&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee\-based recruitment services.

  



Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.  



SS\&C Technologies is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment or employee on the basis of race, color, religious creed, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by applicable discrimination laws.

jobs.title: BMS Engineer
jobs.description:
Controls (Building Services)
Europe Region

MAD0000JO Requisition \#  

**Junior BMS Engineer**


**Shape the Future of Intelligent Building Control Systems with Arup.**


Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.


Our Building Controls team plays a vital role in Arup’s commitment to smart and sustainable building solutions. We design and integrate advanced control systems that enhance building performance, optimize energy usage, and contribute to cutting\-edge digital and net\-zero solutions.


Join a team that’s making a tangible difference. Our work in intelligent buildings, energy efficiency, and digital integration is directly contributing to a more sustainable and resilient future for communities in Spain and beyond.


**The Opportunity**


This role offers an exciting opportunity to work on a diverse range of projects, including commercial, industrial, healthcare, data centres, and educational sectors.


As a Building Controls Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, integrating, and optimizing control systems to enhance building performance and contribute to our innovation building automation initiatives.


You will also have the opportunity to drive innovation in building automation, IoT integration, and energy\-efficient control strategies, shaping the future of intelligent building systems at Arup.


**As a Junior Building Controls Engineer at Arup, you will:**


* Design BMS/building controls systems to optimize building performance and streamline building management, including applications in commercial, industrial, and Data Centre environments.
* Work closely with disciplines like Mechanical, Electrical, ICT, Smart Buildings, and Digital to ensure fully integrated control solutions.
* Ensure seamless integration of BMS, EPMS, and HVAC control systems into overall building design, with consideration for Data Centres where required..
* Conduct design studies and produce conceptual design reports.
* Prepare contract documentation, specifications, and drawings ensuring compliance.
* Conduct surveys and site inspections.
* Witness control system commissioning, ensuring proper execution and alignment with design, including Data Centre BMS and EPMS where applicable.

**Does this role inspire you?**


We are looking for someone who is passionate about smart building automation and energy\-efficient control systems. We also value:


* A bachelor's degree in Controls, Mechatronics, Building Services, Mechanical, or Electrical Services Engineering.
* 3\-4 years' experience designing building control systems (BMS, BAS, or HVAC Controls).
* Actively working towards or interested in achieving Chartered Engineer status
* Experience in Data Centre projects.
* Experience with PLC (programmable Logic Controllers) and DDC (Direct Digital Control) systems, particularly in complex building environments, including Data Centre.
* Familiarity with the latest standards and regulations relevant to building control systems, with knowledge of Data Centre\-specific standards (ASHRAE, Uptime Institute, ISO 50001\).
* Proficiency in software tools commonly used in the building controls sector.

**Why Arup?**


At Arup, we offer a rewarding career with a global company committed to a better future. Our unique trust ownership structure allows us to prioritize meaningful work and invest in our people. We also offer a unique profit share program, allowing our members to share in the results of our collective efforts.


**Benefits that work for you:**


* **Professional Growth \& Development:** Benefit from continuous learning opportunities, training programs, and mentorship to enhance your skills and advance your career at Arup.
* **Global Opportunities**: Collaborate with colleagues worldwide and explore potential short\-term or long\-term assignments at other Arup offices and project locations.
* **Financial Well\-being \& Ownership**: Receive a competitive salary and benefits package and share in Arup's success through our global profit\-sharing programme.
* **Work\-Life Balance:** We offer a hybrid working model and flexible working arrangements to support work\-life balance.
* **Well\-being and Culture:** Access to a range of well\-being programs, including sports subsidies, social activities, and initiatives promoting a healthy work\-life balance. We foster a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome, respected, and valued.

Arup is recognized as one of the best companies to work for in Spain in 2026 by Actualidad Económica and Forbes magazine, thanks to our flexibility policies. We also adhere to the Code of Principles of Generational Diversity, committing to equal opportunities regardless of age.


At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective where individuality is encouraged. Our strength comes from how we respect, share, and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas. You’ll have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning—to Arup, to your career, and to the clients and communities we serve.


We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of the world around us. We actively promote a culture of inclusion where everyone feels welcome, respected, and valued.


We welcome applications from talented individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, disability, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible. We’re here to support you.


**Do you want to join us in shaping a better world?**

jobs.title: System Architect
jobs.description:
**Location:** EU remote

#### **About the Role:**


As a member of Auditdata's Architecture Group, you will join a highly skilled engineering organization building enterprise\-grade solutions for audiology clinic chains worldwide. You will shape integrations, domain boundaries, system design, and platform evolution across our SaaS product portfolio.

**Our tech stack** includes .NET, React ecosystem, Azure Servises (AKS, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Azure SQL Database).


#### **What You Will Do:**

**Integration \& API Architecture:**

* Define and maintain Manage’s integration strategy (REST, Events, APIs, Data Feeds).
* Design standard integration patterns — real\-time (Event Hubs), on\-demand (REST), hybrid workflows.
* Lead technical workshops with customers and partners to gather requirements and define integration approaches.
* Align integrations with domain boundaries, data contracts, and platform security standards.
* Govern message contracts, event schemas, versioning strategy, and error\-handling models.
* Enforce security best practices (OAuth2, mTLS, Azure AD, Key Vault).
* Oversee monitoring, observability, and integration reliability (tracking, retries, DLQs).

**Domain \& System Architecture:**

* Serve as the technical consultant for assigned domains, ensuring architectural integrity and consistent domain boundaries.
* Shape domain models and identify bounded contexts, aggregates, and integration points.
* Define APIs and event contracts across microservices and cross\-domain workflows.
* Evaluate epics and initiatives for architectural feasibility and appropriate service ownership.
* Support teams with high\-level design, technology selection, and patterns.
* Participate in architecture reviews and platform governance.
* Coach teams on DDD, Clean Architecture, and best engineering practices.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, specifications, interface documentation, and ADRs.

**Platform \& Multi\-Tenancy:**

* Design and own the architecture of a secure, performant, and cost\-efficient multi\-tenancy model.
* Contribute to the long\-term architecture vision and support the evolution of the platform strategy.

**Customer \& Pre\-Sales Engagement:**

* Participate in pre\-sales work, technical scoping, and early\-stage solution shaping.
* Support troubleshooting and performance improvements for complex integrations or distributed system issues.

#### **What You Will Bring:**


Technical Skills \& Experience:

* Strong communication skills and the ability to articulate architectural decisions to both leadership and engineering teams.
* Experience with integration architectures (Azure Service Bus, Event Hubs, Azure Functions, REST APIs, Webhooks).
* Practical knowledge of **microservices** and **event\-driven architectures.**
* Solid understanding of **Domain\-Driven Design** and **Clean Architecture.**
* Proven ability to produce high\-quality technical documentation and diagrams (Miro, Lucid, C4, Event Catalog).
* Comfortable in customer\-facing technical discussions.
* Strong background in Azure Cloud services.
* Ability to enforce architectural standards through ADRs, reviews, and quality gates.
* Familiarity with governance, audit logging, and proactive system health monitoring.
* Ability to collaborate with Product and Delivery teams to align architecture with the roadmap and business vision.
* Fluent English.


Preferred:

* 10\+ years in software engineering, including 5\+ years in architecture roles within enterprise SaaS.
* Proven experience modernizing or commercializing legacy platforms into scalable, multi\-tenant products.
* Demonstrated success designing enterprise\-grade integrations.
* Degree in Computer Science or a similar field.


Nice\-to\-Haves:

* Experience with MassTransit.
* Hands\-on experience with AI/ML, LLMs, or agent\-based architectures (semantic search, intelligent document processing, workflow automation).
* Azure Cloud certifications.
* Strong understanding of security and compliance for medical or regulated data (HIPAA, GDPR).
* .NET and React familiarity.


Key Traits:

* Strong leadership, ownership, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to solve complex technical challenges and provide clear direction.
* A consistent focus on continuous learning — both personal and team\-wide.
* A mindset that promotes cross\-team alignment, technical excellence, and architectural consistency.

#### **What’s in It for You:**

* Long\-term engagement in a stable, growing SaaS company.
* High engineering and product standards.
* Flexible environment with a flat organizational structure.
* Professional development opportunities, including certification support.
* A global, diverse, and highly skilled team across Denmark, Ukraine, UK, Poland, Canada, Australia, USA, and more.
* A culture that values personal growth as much as business outcomes.


You don’t match the description 100%? Please don’t hold back! We would love to hear from you.


We’re looking for someone who finds the role challenging and exciting and wants to grow in this role.


We look forward to your application! *(****please submit your CV in English****)*

 *Auditdata is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to create diverse work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills.*

jobs.title: Medior Full Stack Developer (.NET)
jobs.description:
Ben jij een Full Stack Developer die niet alleen enthousiast wordt van goede code, maar vooral van software die écht iets oplost voor de business? Vind je het leuk om met collega's uit verschillende onderdelen van de organisatie om tafel te gaan, processen te begrijpen en samen slimme oplossingen te bedenken? Dan zijn wij bij Amega op zoek naar jou!

Wat
ga je doen als Full Stack Developer?

Als Medior Full Stack Developer werk je aan applicaties en oplossingen binnen het Microsoft-domein. Je krijgt veel ruimte om mee te denken over zowel de technische oplossing als de vraag erachter. Je bouwt dus niet alleen wat er gevraagd wordt: je denkt mee, stelt vragen en helpt onze organisatie steeds slimmer en digitaler te werken.

Amega is continu in ontwikkeling. Binnen onze verschillende bedrijven en afdelingen zien we veel mogelijkheden om processen slimmer te maken met software en automatisering. Als Full Stack Developer speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol.

Je werkt nauw samen met collega's vanuit de business. Dat kunnen bijvoorbeeld collega's zijn uit sales, aftersales, finance, marketing of onze ondersteunende afdelingen. Samen breng je een vraagstuk terug tot de kern en vertaal je dit naar een passende softwareoplossing.

Vervolgens ben je ook zelf betrokken bij de realisatie. Van database en back-end tot gebruikersinterface: jij vindt het juist leuk om over de volle breedte van een applicatie mee te denken en te ontwikkelen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

ontwikkelen en doorontwikkelen van interne applicaties en digitale oplossingen;
vertalen van wensen en processen uit de business naar concrete softwareoplossingen;
ontwikkelen van back-endfunctionaliteit met C# en .NET;
ontwikkelen van gebruiksvriendelijke webinterfaces;
bouwen en onderhouden van API's en integraties tussen verschillende systemen;
werken met databases, bijvoorbeeld Microsoft SQL Server;
meedenken over architectuur, kwaliteit, security en onderhoudbaarheid;
testen, reviewen en verbeteren van bestaande software;
signaleren van mogelijkheden om processen verder te automatiseren.

Je werkt daarbij niet vanaf een eiland. Juist het contact met gebruikers en collega's vinden we belangrijk. Soms begint je werk met een technisch vraagstuk, maar net zo vaak met een gesprek als: “We doen dit nu iedere dag handmatig, kan dat niet slimmer?” Daar krijg jij energie van.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij Amega krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de verdere professionalisering van onze softwareontwikkeling. Je werkt in een organisatie waar veel gebeurt en waar digitalisering volop in ontwikkeling is. Daarnaast bieden wij jou:

veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief: Zie jij een betere technische oplossing of een kans om iets slimmer te organiseren? Dan horen we dat graag.
direct contact met de business: Je ziet voor wie je software maakt en ervaart ook daadwerkelijk wat jouw oplossing oplevert.
veel afwisseling: Door de diversiteit binnen Amega kom je in aanraking met uiteenlopende processen, systemen en vraagstukken.
hybride werken: Je combineert werken vanuit onze locatie in Dordrecht met thuiswerken.
ontwikkelmogelijkheden: Ruimte om jezelf technisch én persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen door opleidingen, trainingen en praktijkervaring.
werken binnen het Microsoft-domein: Je werkt met technologie zoals .NET, C# en Microsoft SQL Server.
korte lijnen: Je werkt in een organisatie waarin je gemakkelijk kunt schakelen met collega's, management en andere afdelingen.
een marktconform salaris en goede arbeidsvoorwaarden passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.
een informele werksfeer met enthousiaste collega's en een organisatie waarin samenwerken centraal staat.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

We zoeken geen developer die het liefst de hele dag met een koptelefoon op alleen tickets wegwerkt. Natuurlijk vinden we technische kennis belangrijk, maar minstens zo belangrijk vinden we jouw nieuwsgierigheid naar de organisatie achter de software.

Je wilt begrijpen hoe processen werken, waarom gebruikers bepaalde wensen hebben en hoe technologie hen écht verder kan c.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

HBO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld richting Informatica, Software Engineering of vergelijkbaar;
enkele jaren relevante ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar;
goede kennis van C# en .NET;
ervaring met webontwikkeling, zowel back-end als front-end;
ervaring met API's, integraties en databases;
ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server;
ervaring met Git en moderne ontwikkelprocessen;
je schrijft graag duidelijke, onderhoudbare en goed testbare software;
je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en denkt graag in oplossingen;
je communiceert gemakkelijk met zowel technische als niet-technische collega's;
je vindt het leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen van vraagstuk tot werkende oplossing.

Je hoeft niet ieder onderdeel van onze technische omgeving al volledig te beheersen. We vinden het belangrijker dat je een goede technische basis hebt, breed geïnteresseerd bent en graag nieuwe technologie en bedrijfsprocessen leert kennen.

Hier kom je te werken

Je komt te werken binnen de ICT-organisatie van Amega in Dordrecht. Amega is een grote en groeiende automotive dealerholding waarin verschillende bedrijven en disciplines samenwerken rondom mobiliteit.

Die diversiteit maakt jouw werk als developer juist interessant. Achter onze organisatie zitten allerlei processen rondom auto's, klanten, werkplaatsen, verkoop, mobiliteit, finance en dienstverlening. En overal liggen mogelijkheden om met slimme software het verschil te maken.

Binnen ICT werken we samen aan het ondersteunen én verder ontwikkelen van de organisatie. Daarbij willen we steeds meer zelf kunnen bouwen, automatiseren en integreren.

Als Full Stack Developer krijg jij de kans om daarin vanaf het begin mee te denken en zichtbaar bij te dragen.

Waarom deze functie bij Amega?

Omdat je hier niet alleen aan software werkt.

Je werkt aan oplossingen waarvan je vaak letterlijk een paar dagen later van een collega kunt horen wat ze hebben opgeleverd. Je krijgt de ruimte om de business in te gaan, vragen te stellen en samen iets nieuws neer te zetten.

Dus ben jij een Full Stack Developer die graag code combineert met nieuwsgierigheid naar mensen, processen en business?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Waarom kiezen voor Amega?

Werken met de gaafste automerken!
Sluit je aan bij een groeiend en succesvol bedrijf
Grootste automotive dealerholding in de regio
Financieel sterkste automotive bedrijf van Nederland
Professionele en positieve familiesfeer waardoor medewerkers gemiddeld 10,5 jaar bij ons blijven werken
