jobs.title: Partner Success Manager (DACH) (CPM/EPM Software)
jobs.description:
**Partner Success Manager (DACH)**

  


**Location:** Remote, Germany or Remote, Switzerland


**Employment Type:** Full\-Time


**Benefits Offered:** Vision, Medical, Life, Dental, 401K


**Gross annual base salary:** Germany: EUR 75,000 \- 97,500,


Switzerland CHF 114,000 \- 148,000


*Additional variable compensation and benefits may apply. Total compensation is based on experience, skills, and location using objective, job\-related criteria.*

  


**Summary**



As a Partner Success Manager (PSM), this role will play a critical role in driving the success of the OneStream partner ecosystem. The role is responsible for developing, supporting and growing all skillsets within a portfolio of strategic partners. This role blends relationship management, enablement strategy, and operational excellence to help partners build a scalable, high performing and self\-sufficient practice.



The Partner Success position bridges the gap between OneStream’s internal teams—such as customer success, partner alliances and partner enablement—and its partners, managing the functional and technical aspects of partner implementations, making sure partner needs are addressed promptly and thoroughly, and fostering lasting relationships to enhance the partner experience. This includes project tracking, partner health and growth, partner program tier levelling, measurement through scorecards, OnePass utilization and ensuring skill level certifications. Orchestrating engagements centrally with project involvement will strengthen the understanding of how and when to engage the wider Customer Support and Remote Consulting (CSRC) teams and provide opportunities for enablement/training of our partners.

  


**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**


**Partner Relationship \& Support**


* Act as the primary point of contact for implementation partners, ensuring the partner has the necessary resources and both technical and functional support.
* Own regular partner status calls to discuss partner project delivery status and delivery concerns.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with partners to drive success of OneStream implementations and partner success.
* Provide guidance on overall partner health and future planning with the partner.
* Serve as a co\-liaison with Partner Alliances between partners and internal teams (Support, Remote Consulting, Partner Enablement, Engineering, Customer Success), focusing on creating value for the partner by guiding them to appropriate teams and processes when needed.
* Alert Partner Alliances and other internal leadership concerns related to the delivery of project timelines mitigating risk.
* Provide input to Partner Delivery Managers on the leveling of partners based on experience working with specific implementation partners and their perceived skillsets.
* Maintain clear and concise communication with partners and internal stakeholders.
* Responsible for driving the partners to develop and maintain a COE function within their practices.

  


**Project Oversight \& Functional Support**


* Monitor and support partner led implementations to ensure adherence to project delivery and partner success.
* Review projects plans and provide recommendations to project timelines and go\-live success.
* Seek opportunities to increase customer satisfaction and adoption via Functional enablement to our partners. Recommend the use of enablement materials to partners based on customer requirements and expectations.
* Review partner cases and their nature to ensure they are utilizing their internal COE correctly.
* Review and identify key deliverables for partner success.

  


**Enablement**


* Develop and deliver partner Seismic pages with functional information, new features and solution content.
* Actively engage partners with COE with online (i.e.Navigator) courses, content and enablement materials.

  


**Process Improvement**


* Identify opportunities to improve partner processes and develop strategies to improve efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to improve proactive enablement and proactive services and develop strategies and new services to prevent customer escalations.
* Create SOP documentation on engaged projects and look to role this out further for governance on projects
* GAP analysis with alliances to help build a more robust framework for our partners for processes and active projects/project management.

  


**Required Education and Experience**


* Bachelor’s degree in fields such as (but not limited to) Accounting, Business, Finance, Information Systems, Mathematics, or CIS, or equivalent work experience.
* Minimum 2 years of experience with project management, stakeholder management, or account management.
* Minimum 5 years of experience consulting or Functional account management for software implementations for Corporate Performance Management / Enterprise Performance Management (CPM/EPM) platforms.
* Must Speak both Fluent German and English.

  


**Preferred Education and Experience**


* Prior experience within a Partner Success position.
* Master’s degree in business, Accounting, Finance, or Information Technology.
* A professional accounting designation (e.g. CPA, CMA, CGA, CA), advanced degrees (MBA, MFA), and/or other professional designations or certifications (applicable to accounting/finance and information technology)
* Project management, program management or account management expertise.
* Prior experience in Partner Success or Customer Success.
* Deep experience with SQL, C\#, VB.net, or Visual Basic. Any object\-oriented programing a plus.
* Prior experience and expertise in Scalability and Performance of EPM/CPM products.
* Prior experience with Azure based SaaS platforms.
* Prior experience using Telemetry tools to monitor EPM/CPM applications.
* Prior experience with any of the following products is a plus:
* + OneStream
	+ SAP Outlooksoft BPC or SAP BOFC (Cartesis)
	+ Hyperion Planning, Hyperion Essbase, Hyperion Financial Management (HFM)
	+ FDM (Financial Data Quality Management) or UpStream
	+ IBM Cognos
	+ Other CPM/EPM solutions. i.e. BlackLine, Trintech, Workiva, Tagetik, Board, Vena, Prophix, Lucanet, Jedox

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**


* Excellent project skills related to product implementation.
* Excellent customer service skills.
* An ability to effectively communicate concise functional guidance and recommendations.
* Ability to develop trust and strong relationships.
* Ability to deliver difficult feedback regarding product implementations and project status.
* Desire to enable others and continuously grow functional knowledge.
* Self\-directed and strong desire to succeed.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage and complete multiple streams of work in a timely manner.
* Presentation skills and strong interpersonal communication abilities.
* Ability to collaborate and solve problems alone and as a team.
* Strong knowledge of financial accounting processes.
* Ability to create drafts of project status.
* Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot issues.

  


**Who We Are**



OneStream is how today’s Finance teams can go beyond just reporting on the past and Take Finance Further™ by steering the business to the future. It’s the only enterprise finance platform that unifies financial and operational data, embeds AI for better decisions and productivity, and empowers the CFO to become a critical driver of business strategy and execution. Our vision is to be the AI operating system for modern finance, digitizing core financial functions and empowering the CFO to become a critical driver of business strategy. To learn more visit www.onestream.com (https://nam11\.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url\=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.onestream.com%2F\&data\=05%7C01%7Ccbaetens%40onestreamsoftware.com%7Cefb0e697518e4c23f0fc08dbc514fcc3%7Cf9796dfaf91c40958663e77a96f2d645%7C0%7C0%7C638320466155766102%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C3000%7C%7C%7C\&sdata\=Nl1Wyl3SIFPonX%2BgKBN8QCK7IJ4IPiyyTFmec43bn7k%3D\&reserved\=0\).


**Why Join The OneStream Team**


* Transparency around corporate structure, salary, and benefits
* Core value of customer success
* Variety of project work (not industry\-specific)
* Strong culture and camaraderie
* Multiple training opportunities

jobs.title: Senior Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Quality Assurance and Testing is an important part of the delivery of digital systems within the HRA. We have a team of skilled test professionals who make sure quality is delivered in the most effective way. We are looking to add automation engineering skills to our existing team as we value automating as much of the test effort as possible allowing our team of specialists to undertake better evaluations of the overall product set.
  
  

As a Senior Test Engineer, you will create and drive the automated test engineering approach within the RSP working closely with the Head of Test and others in the Agile development team. You will determine and implement automation approaches using Playwright(typescript) to assure, measure and build quality into every phase of the software life cycle. This involves developing or enhancing automation frameworks that help deliver scalable tests which are faster, frequent, and continuous. Job also involves performing manual testing where automation is not suitable.
  
  

The interview will contain a mandatory technical test for playwright/NFT coding skills where you will be expected to write and share code in the interview. You should demonstrate your knowledge of this on your CV.
  
  

PLEASE READ
  
  

Applicants should submit an anonymised CV for this role, removing any personal and identifiable information before uploading (name, email etc.).
  
  

We kindly ask that only those who have not previously applied to this post in the last 6 months submit their application.
  
  

Identify new and implement existing test automation frameworks
  
  

Work on both functional and non\-functional areas of complex system(s) built with multiple technologies (Microsoft, PEGA etc)
  
  

Identify and raise awareness of defects, issues, risks arising from the automation test results
  
  

Be proficient in a range of coding languages (C\#, .Net, Java, JavaScript, Node, React, typescript etc)
  
  

Work closely with members of Agile team
  
  

Collaborate with senior test analysts, business to make sure the required business scenarios are covered in the test scripts
  
  

Carry out system, integration and user acceptance testing using manual and automated techniques
  
  

Lead on change impact assessment of all changes ensuring that test coverage mitigates any impact to external stakeholders

Job responsibilities

jobs.title: Engineering Graduate Programme (Fullstack)
jobs.description:
Engineering Graduate Programme (Fullstack)  

**Programme start date: September 2027**


**Please review all the graduate programme opportunities and make** one application


Do you have a passion for technology? Do you want to make a difference, delivering software used by some of the biggest companies in the world? Do you love working with others in a dynamic agile environment?


Our Engineering Graduate Programme provides the ideal springboard for an exciting and significant career in global financial markets technology.


To be eligible you must be a final year undergraduate or Masters student in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Engineering, Information Technology or related discipline and have completed all the requirements of your course before August/September 2027 or a fresh graduate in class of 2026\.


While we offer a wide range of technology roles, for these positions, we are looking for candidates who are interested **Full\-Stack Development** and familiar with one of the programming languages **C\#, JavaScript, Node JS, .NET skills or Python.** Additionally for roles in the Network Product Services team interest in Network Assets, API based services and automation and orchestration tools such as Ansible **.**


We seek to match your interests, skills and background to the developer roles available.


We will also support you in discovering more about the different areas of LSEG that interest you most by connecting you with various departments so that you can learn more about them.


Our Technology Graduate Programme is a 12\-month development opportunity for the Tech Savvy. Fast\-track your technical journey, learn and work with our technology gurus, and develop your career in a leading fintech company.


**Highlights of the Graduate Programme**


* Progress through a 12\-month development journey aiming to build foundational skills that are key for your future success
* Build your foundational knowledge of LSEG, Financial Markets and the business during your global induction
* 'Engineering Bootcamp' week to immerse you in the business and Engineering principles
* Participate in group projects which are aligned to LSEG goals
* Meet in person with your cohort at ‘Ignite’, the programme mid\-point skills offsite. Explore key knowledge areas and skills
* Access opportunities to earn industry recognized qualifications, including 5 study days during programme
* Connect with global early careers community and opportunities and contribute to wider society via CSR initiatives and volunteering opportunities

Our graduates join us on a permanent basis, and from day one you will be aligned to a division, which will allow you to develop within a secure framework. During the recruitment process we will get to know your skills and interest and how they align to the needs of the business, to allow us to place you in the right division.


**What we are looking for:**


We are passionate about recruiting people who have a genuine curiosity about Technology and strive to pursue a Technology career path, as evidenced by their studies, extracurriculars or work experience. It’s important to us that you can also understand the breadth of our organisation, how it functions and the vital role that technology plays in supporting LSEG and our clients.


* You will have a strong interest in technology proven either via your work experience, extracurricular activities, or academic studies. For instance, you may have secured an internship in a technology role or focused on technology as part of a university project. You may have learnt how to code or how to use a particular technology.
* You should have a demonstrable interest in financial markets, which you’ve built through your studies, work experience or extracurricular activities.
* A curiosity for data and an ability to analyse information to draw conclusions and propose solutions.
* Individuals who can connect the dots and think strategically.
* The environment we work in is fast paced, you’ll need to demonstrate focus, resilience and the flexibility to adapt to changing demands.
* People who can collaborate with others, using their communication skills in the process.
* Ideal candidates will have the rights to work in the Romania without restrictions.

We are considering candidates beyond the core software degrees (e.g. computer science, software engineering, Mathematics and Informatics) and candidate with physics, engineering, electronic degree who can demonstrate an interest in Technology as evidenced by extracurriculars or work experience, or personal projects can apply.  

  



**Application close:** **20th October** , however we recommend an early application because we consider candidates on a rolling basis. Due to the volume of applications, we might close the applications earlier, so we recommend an early application.

  

**Recruitment Process:**

The first stage of the recruitment process involves making an application and submitting your resume. The second stage is completing Technical and Coding Assessment. The third stage of the application process is an Immersive Online Assessment. The assessment is designed to give you an insight into what it’s like to work at LSEG The fourth stage is a video interview where you will answer a series of questions using a strength\-based\-interview style The final stage is a half day assessment centre which involves several different types of exercises – further information is provided at the point of invite.

  

Please review all the graduate programme opportunities and make one application If you make more than one application, we will review your first application only.


Please note, all our assessment centres are held virtually

  

  

**Life at LSEG**


At LSEG, we provide our employees with a comprehensive benefits portfolio as part of a competitive total rewards package. Our benefit plans are designed to supplement the financial, emotional and physical wellbeing of our employees and their families at all stages of their life. We encourage an appreciative, collaborative and inclusive culture that promotes employee and organisational wellbeing.

  

We believe hybrid working makes more possible and recognise difference as a good thing. We want to set everyone up to bring their best self to work. Everyone will spend time with colleagues in the office, but you’ll be trusted to work flexibly, in a way that delivers excellence.


**Career Stage:**

Associate
**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.


LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.


Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of **Integrity, Partnership** , **Excellence** and **Change** underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.


Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.


We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.


You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.


LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.


Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject .


If you are submitting as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is essential and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to LSEG are aware of this privacy notice.

jobs.title: Head of Analysis & Design - Investment Platform
jobs.description:
**Who we’re looking for**

We are seeking a high\-calibre, hands\-on Head of Analysis \& Design to lead our team of senior Analysts and support the evolution of our business architecture across our Public Markets Investment Platform.


This role is pivotal in ensuring that enterprise strategy, operating models, and cross\-domain business capabilities are clearly defined, aligned, and translated into scalable platform outcomes.


You will operate at the intersection of business strategy, investment domain expertise, product management, solution design and technology delivery, ensuring business priorities are translated into scalable platform outcomes across Public Markets while remaining aligned to wider Asset Management Platform standards and objectives.


As a senior leader, you will lead and develop the Public Markets Analysis \& Design capability, embedding strong business analysis, solution design and product thinking disciplines that drive measurable business value, effective delivery and continuous improvement.


The role acts as the primary bridge between Public Markets business stakeholders, product management, architecture and engineering teams. Whilst engineering teams may operate under separate reporting structures, the Head of Analysis \& Design remains accountable for ensuring analysis, solution design and technology delivery remain closely aligned through active participation in technology governance, planning and design forums.  



**About Us**

Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.


Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.  



**The team**

The Asset Management Platform (AMP) is a global technology change and delivery organisation responsible for the platforms that underpin Schroders’ investment, client and operational capabilities across public and private markets


AMP brings together a set of business\-aligned technology platforms—including Client, Investment, Group Operations, Data and Finance—into a single, integrated asset management capability, enabling consistent, scalable and value\-driven outcomes across the firm.


Operating within a platform\-centric model, teams are aligned to business outcomes while leveraging shared enterprise capabilities across architecture, data, engineering and delivery to drive standardisation, reuse, and speed of execution.  



**Asset Management Platform – Analysis \& Design**

The Analysis \& Design function is a core enterprise level capability within the Asset Management Platform, accountable for shaping the future direction of the firm's technology and business capabilities.


Operating across all business aligned domains, the team provides leadership in business analysis, architecture, operating model design, strategic analysis and product management, ensuring investment is aligned to business priorities and enterprise outcomes.


Through the definition of common standards, reusable design patterns and platform\-wide governance, the function drives consistency, simplification and scalability, enabling the organisation to accelerate change, optimise cost, and realise the full potential of data, AI and platform\-based operating models.


**Analysis \& Design plays a central role in achieving this by:**

* Defining enterprise\-wide capability models and value streams
* Ensuring alignment across platforms and business domains
* Driving standardisation, simplification, and convergence
* Enabling data \- and AI\-driven transformation at scale

The Head of Analysis will provide the structural backbone linking strategy to execution, ensuring that business intent is consistently realised across the platform ecosystem.  



**What you’ll do**

* Lead the Analysis \& Design strategy for Public Markets, ensuring Public Markets products, platforms and technology investments align with Asset Management Platform standards, enterprise architecture principles and strategic objectives.
* Ensure Public Markets products, platforms and investments remain aligned with Asset Management Platform strategy, standards and architecture.
* Lead, develop and grow the Public Markets Analysis \& Design team, establishing high standards, clear career pathways and a culture of continuous improvement.
* Partner with business stakeholders across research, portfolio management, trading and investment operations to shape strategic priorities and transformation initiatives.
* Define and evolve business capabilities, operating models and business processes across Public Markets, ensuring clear alignment between strategy, execution and technology outcomes.
* Translate business strategy into clear requirements, high level designs and delivery outcomes that create measurable business value.
* Partner with Product Leads, Engineering Leads and Architects to shape backlogs, govern solution design and ensure Public Markets technology outcomes align with business priorities, architectural standards and Asset Management Platform objectives.
* Maintain strong engagement with engineering leadership and participate in technology planning, governance and architecture forums to ensure business analysis and solution design remain closely integrated with technology delivery.
* Act as the bridge between business, product, architecture and engineering teams, driving alignment and effective decision\-making across complex initiatives.
* Drive simplification, standardisation and continuous improvement across investment processes and ways of working.
* Establish and continuously improve business analysis and solution design standards, methodologies and governance across Public Markets.
* Identify capability gaps, inefficiencies and transformation opportunities across the investment lifecycle.
* Embed data, analytics and AI considerations into business processes and solution design, identifying opportunities to improve investment outcomes, operational efficiency and user experience.
* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Investments, Technology and Change to influence decisions and drive strategic outcomes.
* Contribute to the wider Analysis \& Design, Architecture and Asset Management Platform communities, promoting consistency, collaboration and best practice.
* Ensure alignment with enterprise strategies and standards

**The knowledge, experience and qualifications you need**

* Proven experience leading Business Analysis, Analysis \& Design or related functions within a complex, global organisation.
* Strong understanding of Public Markets and asset management business processes, including research, portfolio management, trading and investment operations.
* Experience building, developing and leading high\-performing teams of Business Analysts and Analysis \& Design professionals.
* Strong understanding of business architecture, operating model design, business capability modelling and end\-to\-end process improvement.
* Experience operating within platform\-led, product\-based or agile delivery organisations.
* Proven ability to translate business strategy into clear outcomes, roadmaps and deliverable change initiatives.
* Experience partnering with Product, Engineering and Architecture teams to shape and deliver technology\-enabled business transformation.
* Strong understanding of modern technology concepts, including platform architectures, data ecosystems, integration patterns and AI\-enabled solutions.
* Experience ensuring business outcomes, product direction and technology delivery remain aligned with enterprise strategy, architecture and platform standards
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and build strong relationships across business and technology functions.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and articulate a clear strategic direction.
* Experience leading large\-scale business, data and AI\-enabled transformation initiatives that deliver measurable business value.

**What you’ll be like**

The successful candidate will be a strategic and outcome‑driven senior Analyst, able to connect business priorities with clear, scalable technology direction. They will combine strong vision with pragmatism—defining long‑term platform strategy while making practical decisions that enable delivery at pace. With deep analytical credibility, they will engage confidently across analysis, architecture, engineering and delivery teams, shaping solutions that are robust, aligned to enterprise standards and focused on delivering tangible business value.  



They will operate as a collaborative and influential leader within a complex, global environment, driving alignment across business and technology stakeholders. A strong advocate of simplification, standardisation and reuse, they will actively reduce complexity and drive convergence across the platform. Clear in their communication and accountable in their approach, they will take ownership for the platform’s evolution, contribute to the wider analysis and design community, and continuously apply emerging technologies—particularly data and AI—to enhance investment capabilities and outcomes.  



An experienced people leader who develops high\-performing analytical teams through coaching, mentoring and continuous improvement.


A collaborative leader who brings together business, product, engineering and architecture stakeholders to achieve shared outcomes.


Comfortable operating strategically while remaining hands\-on where required to resolve ambiguity, shape complex initiatives and support delivery teams.  



**We Recognise Potential, Whoever You Are**

Our purpose is to deliver excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We believe diverse perspectives and an inclusive culture help us make better decisions and achieve better outcomes for our clients. That's why inclusion is a strategic priority for us, and we are an equal opportunities employer. You are welcome here, regardless of your age, disability, gender identity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, socio\-economic background, or any other protected characteristic.  



We will consider flexible working arrangements for all roles and provide reasonable accommodations to support applicants and employees, including those with neurodiversity, disability, or physical and mental health needs. For more information, please visit our FAQs.

**Senior Software Engineer, Agent Endpoint DLP \-office based 4 days per week in Moorgate, London**

Join Fortinet, a global cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of excellence, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. At Fortinet, our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere. We are currently seeking an experienced Software Engineer to contribute to the success of our rapidly growing business.


You will work in our Cyber R\&D team, and use your knowledge of systems (Kernel, OS) level development to develop our Agent architecture. The Agent is our endpoint client software and is responsible for the extraction and management of our customer's data. With this we protect people and data anywhere, with innovative companies worldwide using FortiDLP for human\-centric data loss protection.


**Key Responsibilities and Technologies**

* Implementing new capabilities within the FortiDLP endpoint agent, taking ownership of features and leading the development effort.
* Maintain and improve existing functionality of the FortiDLP agent.
* Contributing to code, tests, and code review.
* Keep a strong focus on code quality, maintainability, and secure coding practices.
Maintain close communication within the team as well as across other teams to coordinate progress.  
* 

At FortiDLP we default to programming using Go but also use a wide variety of different languages and frameworks. It's not expected that you would be familiar with Go (or any of the other languages we use) but you should be enthusiastic and willing to learn new things. We value:


* Strong programming skills backed by at least 3 years of software engineering experience.
* Familiarity with computer science fundamentals.
* Software development in Go, C, C\+\+, Java, Scala, C\# or Swift.
* Kernel and device driver development for Windows, Linux, or Mac.
* Systems Analytics; Dynamic tracing and performance analysis tools such as Instruments, VTune, DTrace and eBPF.
* Observability technologies, logging and metrics.
Security principles including PKI, certificates and cryptography.  
* 

**Communication and Collaboration**

We work on complex, cross\-functional features that require close collaboration with engineers across the endpoint, product managers, technical writers, and support teams. Team members contribute throughout the development lifecycle, from writing technical specifications and coordinating implementation to demoing features internally, supporting launches, and ensuring our solutions are well\-documented and maintainable. We also work closely with the support and QA teams to prepare for releases, debug early issues in the field, and ensure a smooth rollout experience. High engineering standards are central to our team culture, including thorough code reviews, rigorous testing, and shared responsibility for quality and reliability.


We’re looking for engineers who communicate clearly, work well with a wide range of collaborators, and enjoy building shared understanding across disciplines. The role suits people who are thoughtful partners to product managers and support teams, value feedback as part of the development process, and bring a sense of ownership and care to both their code and their collaboration.


**Why Join Us:** 

At Fortinet, we embrace diversity and inclusivity. We encourage applications from diverse backgrounds and identities. Explore our welcoming work environment designed for a rewarding career journey with an attractive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well\-being. Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 660,000\+ customers around the globe.


We will only notify shortlisted candidates.


Fortinet will not entertain any unsolicited resumes, please refrain from sending them to any Fortinet employees or Fortinet email aliases. Should any Agency submit any resumes to Fortinet these resumes, if considered, will be assumed to have been given by the Agency free of any related fees/charges.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Graduate
jobs.description:
About the Role  

Ready to launch your engineering career while shaping the future of energy? At EDF power solutions, you'll gain hands\-on experience, learn from experts, and help deliver renewable energy projects that support the electrification of homes, businesses and communities across the UK.

**The Opportunity**


As an Electrical Engineering Graduate, you'll earn a salary of £37,500 per annum and begin your career at EDF power solutions in early September 2027\. You'll develop technical and professional skills while building a strong foundation for a long\-term engineering career.


Over this 16\-month programme, you'll rotate across Engineering teams and work on wind, solar PV and private wire projects. You'll gain experience from development through to commissioning while contributing to projects that support our ambition of powering an Electric UK and Ireland.

**What You’ll Experience**


As an Engineering Graduate at EDF power solutions, you'll gain exposure to a range of renewable energy technologies while supporting projects that help transform how energy is generated, stored and supplied across the UK.


You'll support engineering activities across solar PV, battery storage and private wire projects. From feasibility studies and design development to technical assessments and problem\-solving, you'll learn how projects are delivered safely, effectively and compliantly.


You'll also review technical documentation, collaborate with project teams and build practical industry knowledge. We'll support your development as you begin your journey towards chartership with the Institution of Engineering and Technology or another relevant professional body.

**Location**


You'll be based at one of our key sites in \#Edinburgh, \#London or \#Durham. During the programme, you'll have opportunities to complete placements across different locations, giving you valuable exposure to a range of teams, technologies and operational environments.


Most roles require between three and five days per week on site. Depending on your placement rotations, travel and relocation may be required during the programme. We'll provide practical and financial support to help make these transitions as smooth as possible.

**Why EDF power solutions?**


We're united by a shared ambition: to tackle climate change, shaping an Electric UK and Ireland. Our diverse team is growing fast, driven by innovation and a commitment to clean, green energy for all.


With technologies spanning onshore and offshore wind, solar, battery storage and green hydrogen, we're one of the UK's and Ireland's most diverse renewable energy generators. By 2035, we aim to deliver 10GW of low\-carbon energy capacity, and we'd love you to help us get there.

**Where This Programme Could Take You**


Ben completed EDF power solutions' Science and Engineering Graduate Programme, where he worked on a variety of projects that developed both his technical engineering expertise and broader professional skills. The programme gave him meaningful responsibility and exposure to different engineering environments.


Working alongside experienced colleagues, Ben strengthened his technical knowledge, built his confidence and developed skills that helped him transition successfully into a permanent engineering role within the business.


"During my time on the EDF power solutions graduate programme, I had the opportunity to work on a wide range of projects, which helped me develop both my technical engineering skills and broader professional capabilities. I was trusted with meaningful work that made a genuine contribution while always having support from experienced colleagues. It was an incredibly rewarding experience that gave me the skills, confidence and experience to progress into a permanent engineering role."

**Who You Are**


To be eligible for this EDF power solutions graduate programme, you need to have achieved, or be expecting to achieve, a bachelor's or postgraduate degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Control Systems, Control and Instrumentation, or a related subject.


To be appointed to this role, you will need to meet the criteria for Security Vetting, which will, ordinarily, require you to have been a resident of the UK for at least three of the past five years.


Please note that an Assessment Centre stage of the hiring process will take place online, on 11th November 2026\. Applicants must be able to attend on this date to be considered for the programme.

**Pay, Benefits and Culture**


If you’re looking to join a company where you can work hard, have fun, and help to create a net zero future – then you’re in the right place! If you’re passionate about tackling climate change to support a cleaner, greener future, we’d love you to come and join us.


Alongside a starting salary of at least £37,500 per annum, potential for an annual bonus, and a market\-leading pension scheme, your package will include customisable benefits such as electric vehicle leasing, discounted gym membership, life assurance, tech vouchers, experience days, and more.


Everyone is welcome at EDF power solutions; we’re committed to building a workforce that reflects gender balance, social mobility, and inclusion of minority ethnic backgrounds, LGBTQ\+ communities, and those with disabilities.


As a Disability Confident employer, we're committed to creating an accessible recruitment process and encourage candidates to tell us about any support they may need. Should you disclose a disability and meet the minimum criteria (which will include holding a relevant degree discipline/grade and achieving the required pass mark for Stage 1 Testing) for the role you’ll be progressed to the first stage of the selection process. Some of our roles at EDF attract large volumes of applications. When this happens, we’ll apply the Disability Confident scheme’s guidance on taking practical and appropriate steps selecting disabled candidates who best meet the minimum criteria for the job.

**Our Recruitment Process**


We'll guide you through every stage and keep you updated along the way. You'll be supported by real people, with opportunities to ask questions, learn more and receive feedback where possible.


For our Early Careers Programmes, we use a combination of automated decision\-making, assessment technology and human review. Find out more by referring to our EDF Recruitment – AI and Automated Decision\-making policy.


We aim to close applications on the 1st October, but we may close earlier due to volumes.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Bango enables content providers to reach more paying customers through global partnerships. Bango revolutionized the monetization of digital content and services, by opening\-up online payments to mobile phone users worldwide.



Today, the Digital Vending Machine® is driving the rapid growth of the subscriptions economy, powering choice and control for subscribers.



The world’s largest content providers, including Amazon, Google and Microsoft trust Bango technology to reach subscribers everywhere.



Bango, where people subscribe.


**Role**
--------

As a Site Reliability Engineer at Bango, you own the reliability, performance and continuous improvement of the Bango Platform end\-to\-end — from the infrastructure and pipelines that build and deploy it, to the observability and incident response that keep it running to agreed service levels.



You combine three things that have historically sat in separate teams: platform and cloud infrastructure engineering, automation and delivery pipeline ownership, and proactive/reactive reliability engineering including incident response and customer impact management. You design, build and operate the automation, observability and platform capabilities that other engineering teams rely on, and you are equally comfortable diagnosing a live incident as you are designing the Terraform module that prevents the next one.



You work closely with Product and Integration Engineering teams to understand what ‘good’ looks like, support the delivery of well\-architected, secure and observable services, and represent the reliability and platform perspective in technical discussions. You are a key contributor to Bango’s engineering standards and practices, and you take pragmatic, evidence\-based decisions about where to invest effort — whether that’s automating a manual process, hardening a security control, or resolving a live customer\-impacting issue.



You are a member of the Managed Services \& Support team, working alongside NOC, Partner Support and TSM colleagues, and collaborating regularly with Software Engineering, Integration Engineering and InfoSec.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


Reliability \& Incident Management
* Ensure the Bango Platform is available, responsive and performant for customers; work proactively to identify and mitigate risk, and reactively to resolve active incidents.
* Investigate incidents, perform root cause analysis, and drive permanent corrective action rather than workarounds.
* Understand Bango's customers, their expectations, and the business impact of incidents on the platform or with partners.
* Liaise frequently with Product and Integration Engineering to document issues and defects, describe their impact, and support timely resolution — including recurring minor issues that risk being overlooked.
* Support the detection of issues introduced by new deployments, and are empowered to roll these back or work around them.
* Help prioritise bug fixes in collaboration with product teams, bringing ideas and potential solutions to the table.

Observability, Monitoring \& Security
* Design and maintain observability, monitoring and alerting capabilities that give all Bango teams visibility of service health and availability.
* Identify and remediate false alarms or gaps in current monitoring, continuously optimising signal quality.
* Implement and maintain platform security controls, hardening standards and access management, including secrets and certificate lifecycle management.
* Continuously improve platform security posture and operational risk management in collaboration with InfoSec.

Platform \& Infrastructure Engineering
* Design, implement, operate and continuously improve platform services and cloud infrastructure capabilities.
* Take ownership of platform services throughout their lifecycle, including cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms and supporting tooling.
* Develop and maintain reusable platform components, templates and engineering standards that other teams can adopt.
* Ensure Cloud configuration and automation software aligns to Bango standards, doesn't needlessly re\-invent existing solutions, and enables other teams to integrate effectively.
* Support the evolution of Bango's cloud and hybrid architecture.
* Continuously optimise infrastructure cost and ensure platform services are designed to scale efficiently with demand.

Automation \& Software Delivery
* Design, build and maintain infrastructure\-as\-code, CI/CD and GitOps workflows across Bango's software delivery lifecycle.
* Own and continuously improve build and deployment pipelines, ensuring reliable, repeatable releases that meet automated quality and security gates.
* Identify and eliminate manual activity, automation bottlenecks and technical debt across delivery and operational processes.
* Advocate for and drive adoption of automation tooling and practices across Bango engineering.
* Work with Software Engineering on the automation and setup of new projects, and with QA on effective test automation.

Collaboration, Standards \& Documentation
* Act as the reliability and platform representative for cross\-functional teams — Developers, QA, Product Managers and Technical Integration Specialists — with stakeholders across the business.
* Confidently communicate at all levels, adjusting style appropriately for CEO, Chair, engineers or the People team.
* Define, document and promote engineering standards, platform patterns and operational procedures.
* Create clear documentation and runbooks to guide Support teams and help Engineering resolve issues permanently.
* Support onboarding, mentoring and knowledge\-sharing, and act as a key contributor to Bango's engineering principles and best practices.
* Participate in code review and provide constructive, detailed feedback.
* Call out areas where Bango can improve service or reduce cost.

**Essentials**
--------------

* 3\+ years' experience in a Cloud, Platform, DevOps or SRE role in a commercial environment.
* Production experience with a major cloud provider (AWS, Azure or GCP).
* Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting (process management, memory management, signals, etc.).
* Production experience with containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Infrastructure\-as\-Code experience (Terraform or equivalent).
* CI/CD and GitOps experience (GitLab CI/CD or equivalent), with a solid understanding of what 'good' continuous delivery looks like.
* Strong scripting ability in Python and/or Bash.
* Solid networking fundamentals — TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, TLS.
* Experience with relational and non\-relational databases (e.g. SQL Server, MySQL, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch).
* Practical experience of incident management, monitoring and root cause analysis.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical problem\-solving, individually and as part of a team.
* Working experience in Agile teams and development processes.
* Excellent oral and written communication with both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Calm, clear\-thinking and flexible under time pressure when resolving live issues.
* Understanding of lower\- and high\-level architectural concepts and common cloud design patterns.

**Desirables**
--------------

* Configuration management tooling (Puppet, Ansible).
* Advanced Kubernetes (Karpenter, KEDA, HPA/VPA, Service Mesh).
* Observability tooling (Datadog, OpenTelemetry) and SLI/SLO design.
* Security and identity tooling (SSO, IAM, PKI).
* Queue or streaming design patterns (SQS, Kafka).
* Commercial or low\-level languages beyond scripting (Java, C\#, Golang, C\+\+, Rust).
* Experience with legacy Windows Server / .NET / T\-SQL / PowerShell environments, where Bango still operates them.
* Experience working across time zones and cultures on cross\-border projects.
* Experience with virtualisation, SAN, or data security and protection practices.

**Benefits**
------------


* A friendly, informal working environment
* Your own Bango buddy – to help you settle in
* Bendi\-time (flexible working hours)
* Bango social events
* Choose your own headphones, keyboard \& mouse
* Generous share option scheme
* Private Medical Insurance
* Health Cash Plan
* 25 days holiday a year increasing to 28 days with 4 years’ service
* Cycle to work, gym discount
* Weekly Pilates \& Yoga classes (virtual)
* Financial support for employee activity groups and charitable activities
* Free fruit, drinks and snacks, limitless tea, coffee and good quality espressos
* Company branded hoodie… to keep you happy and comfortable
* Group personal pension scheme
* Life assurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* 1Password
* Income Protection
* Bango branded Chilly’s bottle and coffee cup

We’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Senior Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Cellular Origins**


Cell therapies are changing how we treat some of the most devastating diseases, by using a patient’s own cells as the treatment. To bring these therapies to many more people, manufacturing must change too, becoming far more scalable, reliable and efficient. At Cellular Origins you’ll help build the firmware that drives our robotic manufacturing technology, so more patients can access life\-changing treatments sooner.


As a Senior Firmware Engineer, you’ll sit at the intersection of software, electronics and automation. You’ll take technical ownership of turning motion, sensing and control ideas into reliable, production\-ready firmware that keeps our systems running smoothly in a bioprocess environment. You’ll regularly see your code make motors move, sensors respond and complex systems run reliably.

 **Job Description**  

You’ll join a multidisciplinary team of engineers and scientists working on our core automation platform, from first prototypes through to production systems. You’ll design, implement and test firmware that runs on ARM microcontrollers, work directly with hardware on the bench, and help shape technical decisions across firmware, electronics and the wider system.


This is not a role confined to the firmware team: you may spend as much time working with electronics, mechanical, automation and systems engineers, and with biologists, as you do with other firmware or software engineers. You’ll need to enjoy crossing disciplinary boundaries and learning enough about the wider system to help make it work as one coherent whole.


In this role, you’ll:

* Own firmware development for key parts of our core technology, from requirements and architecture through implementation, verification and support in production.
* Write and review high\-quality C for ARM microcontrollers (primarily STM32\), focusing on robust, maintainable and testable code.
* Design and maintain automated tests for embedded firmware, including unit, integration and hardware\-in\-the\-loop, and integrate them into continuous integration workflows.
* Turn system needs into clear firmware requirements and interfaces, working directly with electronics, mechanical, automation and software engineers, plus biologists.
* Make and communicate technical decisions within your area, balancing engineering rigour, maintainability and delivery speed, and support other engineers through design discussions and code reviews.
* Debug complex embedded\-system issues using tools such as debug probes, oscilloscopes, multimeters and logic analysers, getting to the root cause of tricky problems.
* Use Linux\-based tools and development environments as part of your day\-to\-day work.
* Support and occasionally develop custom test equipment for internal use, helping the wider team move faster.
* Use higher\-level languages such as Python, C\# or Java to build supporting tools and simple GUIs for debugging, testing or internal users.


Depending on your experience, you may also:

* Turn your hand to electronics design and prototype modification when needed, working with electronics engineers to shape interfaces and resolve cross\-discipline issues.
* Develop and optimise hard real\-time algorithms for motion control, sensing or safety\-critical functions.
* Use Docker and containers to create reliable, repeatable development and test environments.
* Contribute to embedded Linux software and the interfaces between it and our microcontroller firmware.

  

**Qualifications** **About you**


You enjoy seeing firmware come to life in real hardware, and you like being close to the bench, motors and sensors rather than hidden away from the physical system. You are comfortable owning firmware end to end, from first requirements and architecture through to code that ships, and you get energy from solving problems with people from different technical backgrounds.


We’re looking for:

* A strong track record of designing and delivering embedded systems, with the judgement to take ownership and make pragmatic technical decisions independently.
* Extensive professional experience developing firmware in C and/or C\+\+ on ARM microcontrollers, ideally STM32\.
* Strong experience developing and maintaining automated tests for embedded systems, including using them within continuous integration workflows.
* Confidence working directly with hardware and independently debugging complex systems at both code and signal level.
* Strong skills in interpreting component datasheets and electronics schematics, and using them to inform design and debugging.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial approach, with the ability to explain technical trade\-offs, support other engineers and solve problems with people from very different disciplines.

  

**Additional Information**  

Cellular Origins is currently based on the TTP Campus, within purpose\-built sustainable offices, labs and green surroundings, 10 miles south of Cambridge. Our working culture encourages entrepreneurship, shared ideas and collaboration, while providing you the freedom to do your best work.


Our employee benefits include:

* Annual bonus
* 25 days holiday
* Employer pension contribution of 10% of salary
* Private medical insurance for employees and dependants
* Enhanced family friendly leave
* Life insurance worth 6x salary
* Electric car leasing scheme
* Cycle to work scheme
* Season ticket loan

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are Printed.com, one of the largest and fastest growing on\-line print shops in the UK. We are filled to the brim with a passionate team who are mad about printing, designing, building and growing the business. In the office you’ll find that we are forward\-thinking, with a mission to be creative, innovative and to help our customers.


We are constantly investing in new products and using technology to improve how we increase our market share and take advantage of new opportunities. Catch us in our production space and you will find a fast\-paced, dedicated team who endeavour to reach perfection for our customers.

  

We’re a growing company with offices in London and Newcastle, looking for employees that are equal parts dynamic and enthusiastic. People brimming over with new, original ideas that they just can’t wait to share with their team and bring to life.


Printed.com is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Engineering team as we scale our platform across UK and US markets, reporting directly to our Head of Engineering. You'll work across a mix of PHP (Symfony/Laravel) applications running on AWS (EC2 and EKS), contributing hands\-on to multiple concurrent projects while helping raise the bar on engineering practices across the team. This role carries the scope and expectations of someone who takes the initiative on ambiguous or unowned problems with little to no guidance, is comfortable moving fluidly between workstreams, conversations, and challenges, and can dig past the symptom to find the actual root cause. You'll be trusted to own technical decisions and help set technical direction, not just execute against a spec, and to bring that same drive to mentoring others as the team continues to mature.


This is a hybrid role with minimum of 2 days required in our Cramlington office.

 **Requirements** **Responsibilities**


Ownership \& Initiative


Take the initiative on problems with little to no guidance — spotting what needs doing, digging past the symptom to find the actual root cause, and driving the technical decisions needed to resolve it, working closely with the Engineering Leadership Team, Head of Engineering and Head of Programme to keep that aligned with the wider technical direction.

  

Multi\-Project Delivery


Work across several concurrent workstreams — spanning feature development, platform improvements, and infrastructure initiatives — balancing competing priorities while maintaining code quality and delivery pace.

  

Engineering Best Practices


Champion and help embed engineering best practices (code review standards, testing, CI/CD, documentation) across the team, acting as a role model for the standard of work expected from senior engineers.

  

Process \& Ways\-of\-Working Adoption


Support the rollout and adoption of new tools, processes, and ways of working as the engineering function matures, helping teammates understand the "why" behind changes and troubleshooting adoption friction.

  

Mentoring \& Technical Guidance


Mentor less experienced engineers through pairing, code review, and informal guidance, helping build technical capability and confidence across the team.

**Key Skills**

* Our stack is PHP (Symfony/Laravel) with Vue.js front ends — but we're open to strong engineers from other frameworks (e.g. Rails, Django, .NET) or other JS frameworks (React, Angular) who can demonstrate solid fundamentals and pick things up quickly
* Comfortable working across JavaScript, SCSS, and Twig as part of day\-to\-day full\-stack delivery, or a proven track record of moving fluently across a similar front\-to\-back stack
* Solid working knowledge of AWS (EC2, EKS/containers, RDS, or similar services)
* Background in DevOps, platform, or infrastructure engineering
* Comfortable working across multiple projects and shifting priorities
* Confident, senior\-level communicator able to work autonomously and influence without authority
* Experience mentoring or supporting the development of other engineers
* Familiarity with observability tooling (e.g. Grafana, Prometheus/Mimir) is a plus
* Pragmatic approach to trade\-offs between speed, technical debt, and long\-term maintainability
* A genuine self\-starter — comfortable picking up an ambiguous or unowned problem, working out what's really going on, and driving it to a solution with minimal handholding
* Approaches technical disagreement collaboratively — pushes back on ideas, not people, and can hold a firm position without it turning combative
* Cost\-conscious when working with cloud infrastructure — thinks about the cost implications of architectural decisions, not just the technical ones
* Comfortable working with legacy and end\-of\-life systems — able to help modernise incrementally without needing a clean\-slate rewrite
* Security\-conscious by default — thinks about access control, dependency hygiene, and data handling as part of normal development, not as an afterthought

  

**Benefits**  

* 22 days holiday Plus 8 days bank holidays
* Staff discounts \& Friends and Family discounts
* Cycle to work scheme, Tech Scheme and EV Scheme (subject to conditions)
* Breakfast and drinks provided on days you work in the office
* 1 Charity Day per year
* Summer and Christmas Parties
* Street food days
* Perkbox membership
* Enhanced parental leave
* Staff discount on print

jobs.title: Full-stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
AirHelp is a global travel tech company on a mission to make every journey smoother. We built our name helping millions of travellers claim the flight compensation they're owed \- and that's now the foundation of a broader platform of travel protection and convenience products spanning the entire journey.


We are looking for a product\-minded Full\-stack Software Engineer to join our Claiming Experience team, responsible for the journey that helps travellers start, complete, and submit their claims with confidence.


It's one of the highest\-leverage surfaces in the company. What happens here moves submission rates, traveller trust, and the cost and speed of everything that happens downstream \- legal, documents, operations, comms. Small wins compound.


The claiming journey is a real product problem that happens to span frontend, backend, experimentation, document and signature flows, legal requirements, partner integrations, and production reliability. You'll own meaningful parts of it end to end, working day to day with engineers, PMs, designers, data analysts, and QA.


This is a hybrid role based in Kraków or Gdańsk.


Salary:

* If you join us as a full\-time employee: 14\.000 \- 20\.000 PLN gross/month
* If you join us as a contractor (for specific projects): 15\.000 \- 25\.000 PLN net \+ VAT on a B2B contract


What you can expect from us* Opportunity to build high\-leverage features and tooling for the core business domains that directly impact the travel experience for millions of users.
* Culture that promotes good engineering practices, high\-quality code, and continuous improvement.
* Daily deployments to production, ensuring fast impact and iterative development.
* Access to a modern tech stack and a variety of functional areas, including:
* + Backend: : Node.js and Ruby on Rails
	+ Frontend: TypeScript\-first React ecosystem (Vite, Turborepo, TanStack Query/Table, Zod)
	+ Databases: PostgreSQL
	+ Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform.
	+ Monitoring: ELK/Grafana, Sentry, GitHub Actions CI/CD
	+ Testing: Bruno (API), Playwright (E2E), k6 (performance)


What you'll achieve:* Build and evolve the core claiming flows, across frontend and backend, all the way to production.
* Work with Product, Design, and Data to spot friction, frame the problem, and ship measurable improvements.
* Design and run experiments that lift submission rates and reduce confusion and make it easier and safer for the whole team to do the same.
* Integrate the claiming flow with the systems around it: documents, comms, claim processing, partner APIs, internal tooling.
* Modernise the legacy parts of the journey so the team can move faster with less risk.
* Raise the bar on reliability and observability for these flows, so we catch and fix issues before they cost a traveller their claim.
* Hold the line on engineering quality through reviews, testing, and pragmatic technical decisions.
* Use AI\-assisted workflows where they genuinely speed you up or improve the work.

  

A year in, you'll have measurably improved how many eligible travellers complete their claims, made experimentation faster and safer, and simplified enough of the codebase that the team ships with more confidence than it does today.

 **Requirements**  

  

What sets you apart:* 4\+ years building and owning client\-facing production apps where reliability, performance, and conversion actually matter.
* Strong in at least one of our core technologies: TypeScript/React, Ruby/Rails, Node.js and willing to work across the stack.
* A product instinct: you care whether the code solved the right problem, not just whether it shipped.
* Comfortable across the full lifecycle: framing, building, testing, deploying, monitoring, iterating with the testing discipline to back it.
* Solid with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL.
* An ownership mindset: you go looking for the important problems instead of waiting for a perfect ticket.
* Clear communicator in English, written and spoken.

  

**Benefits**  

  

Why AirHelp* Fast Impact: We deploy daily \- your code reaches millions quickly.
* Autonomy: High trust, zero politics. We hire builders, not order takers.
* Growth: Learning days, personal development plans, workshops, mentorship, and language classes.
* Perks: Private healthcare, non\-service days, wellness budget, travel stipend, gym/transport subsidy, free access to AirHelp services, and more.


At AirHelp, we're on a mission to make the world of travel better. Since our foundation in 2013, we've assisted over 2\.7 million passengers in receiving their rightful compensation, and we've protected over 9 million travelers through our membership program, AirHelp\+. With a global team of 400 AirHelpers speaking 19 languages, we aim to provide a stress\-free travel experience for all. Our commitment extends to standing up to airlines in court and advocating fair air passenger rights through APRA.


And there’s more! AirHelp isn’t just a great company, but a truly lovable place to work. That's why we're so proud to have been named a , also for LGBTQ\+, women and young professionals.


Our offices are fully accessible, and we customize interviews to accommodate special needs, including those of neurodiverse candidates. Refugees and displaced individuals are encouraged to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: .NET Developer | SEB, Solna
jobs.description:
Help keep SEB's credit process running smoothly by maintaining and evolving the core applications that support credit review.

  


  

SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology\-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. AI, data and modern engineering are natural parts of how we work, build and deliver value. From core banking platforms to agentic AI , automation, cybersecurity and cloud, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible and future\- proof solutions for our customers and society. Are you ready to take on a new challenge?

### **About the role****:**

  

As a .NET Developer in CIB Credit, you will be part of a team responsible for developing and maintaining solutions that support SEB's credit processes for Corporate and Investment banking. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, business analysts, and fellow developers to create reliable applications that enable efficient credit decision\-making and risk management. The focus of this role is on ensuring stability, reliability, and continuous operation of existing applications.

### **To thrive in this role, we believe you have:**



* Experience working with complex enterprise applications and system integrations.
* Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience with SQL Server and data\-driven applications.
* Understanding of software lifecycle management, release processes, and change management.
* Experience working in Agile teams and collaborating with both business and technology stakeholders.
* A structured and quality\-focused mindset with a strong focus on stability, reliability, and risk awareness.
* Previous experience working with credit processes is meriting
* Fluency in English and Swedish
### **What we offer****:**



* Entrepreneurial Scandinavian environment
* Hybrid work model, meaning remote work is possible up to 2 days/week
* International opportunities and working environment
* Attractive compensation and access to SEB staff banking with exclusive benefits

  


Do you want to be part of SEB?  

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value\-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.  

  

Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than 14th of September 2026\. If you have questions about the position, please contact hiring manager Kimberly Lejonö at kimberly.lejono@seb.se, but we will not process applications via email.

  




Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and criminal records checks. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks.

  


  

During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.

The employment is covered by collective agreements signed between Finansarbetsgivarna and Akademikerföreningen and between Finansarbetsgivarna and Finansförbundet.

**Vil du utvikle løsninger som bidrar til å varsle flom, skred og andre naturfarer?** I Norges vassdrags\- og energidirektorat (NVE) får du bruke teknologien din til å løse samfunnsoppgaver som betyr noe for folk.


Vi styrker utviklermiljøet vårt og søker to backend\-utviklere til team naturfag i utviklingsseksjonen. Teamet utvikler fagsystemer og varslingstjenester basert på data om blant annet flom, skred, snø, målinger og prognoser. Løsningene våre er viktige verktøy for NVEs arbeid med naturfare og bidrar til økt trygghet og beredskap i samfunnet. Seksjonen består av rundt 30 utviklere og designere fordelt på to fagområder – energi og naturfag.


Team naturfag leverer fagsystemer for håndtering av naturfaglige data som flom, skred, snø, måle\- og prognosedata og flomsikring. Vi står også bak varslingstjenester som mange er avhengige av. Dataene og løsningene våre er grunnlag for beregninger som gjør at NVE kan varsle naturfare og bidra til at folk kan ferdes trygt i naturen.


Du vil først og fremst jobbe med backend\-utvikling, men også bidra på frontend. Sammen med teamet utvikler du sikre, stabile og brukervennlige løsninger som forvalter og tilgjengeliggjør viktige data for samfunnet.

  

  

#### **Arbeidsoppgaver**


**Du vil jobbe med:**
* utvikling av backend\-applikasjoner i .NET
* utvikling av frontend\-applikasjoner i Javascript (Vue)
* utvikling av SQL\- og databaseløsninger
* integrasjon mot NVEs GIS\-plattform (ArcGIS, ESRI)

**Sammen med teamet vil du bidra til:**
* kompetansedeling på tvers av team og fagområder
* dokumentasjon av prosesser og rutiner
* å utvikle sikre, stabile og brukervennlige løsninger med høy kvalitet

Aller viktigst er det at du er nysgjerrig og liker å sette deg inn i nye problemstillinger. Vi er i gang med å modernisere flere av løsningene våre, og du får være med på denne reisen. Hvis du ønsker det, kan du også bli med ut i felt for å se hvordan dataene samles inn og brukes i praksis.


#### **Kvalifikasjoner**


* utdanning på bachelor\- eller masternivå innen IT, teknologi eller tilsvarende. Relevant arbeidserfaring kan kompensere for manglende formell utdanning
* god muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk
* sikkerhetsmessig skikkethet for stillingen

Det er nødvendig med autorisering eller sikkerhetsklarering fordi stillingen innebærer å håndtere og behandle sikkerhetsgradert informasjon. For å klareres må du fylle ut en personopplysningsblankett og samtykke til personkontroll.

* kartbiblioteker (ArcGIS, Leaflet eller lignende)
* SQL\- og databaseløsninger, Microsoft SQL Server

* Docker
* kunnskap om UX og universell utforming
* erfaring med smidig utviklingsmetodikk og teamarbeid
* kunnskap om sikkerhet og sikker utvikling

#### **Personlige egenskaper**


* tar ansvar for egne leveranser og er opptatt av kvalitet og robuste løsninger
* er nysgjerrig, strukturert og liker å sette deg inn i nye problemstillinger
* samarbeider godt med andre og bidrar til kunnskapsdeling

Personlig egnethet tillegges stor vekt.
#### **Vi tilbyr**


Som medarbeider i NVE blir du del av et sterkt fagmiljø med et viktig samfunnsoppdrag. Vi er opptatt av at alle i NVE skal oppleve personlig og faglig utvikling, trives på jobb over tid og ha det godt på jobb i alle livsfaser. Vi ønsker oss medarbeidere med ulike erfaringer og perspektiver sånn at vi kan løse oppgavene våre på best mulig måte.


**Hos oss får du:**
* meningsfulle oppgaver med innflytelse på viktige samfunnsområder, i en sterk og tverrfaglig kunnskapsorganisasjon
* en hverdag der læring står på planen – tid til å lære nye teknikker, metoder og teknologier sammen med dyktige og hyggelige kolleger
* moderne, nyoppussede lokaler sentralt på Majorstuen i Oslo
* fleksible arbeidstidsordninger (fleksitid, sommertid, betalt overtid) og mulighet for hjemmekontor etter avtale
* eget treningsrom, trening i arbeidstiden og et aktivt bedriftsidrettslag
* gode pensjons\-, forsikrings\- og låneordninger i Statens pensjonskasse

Skipstrafikken er kompleks, og hver dag skal hundrevis av fartøy navigere sikkert gjennom trange farvann – uten ulykker, forsinkelser eller akutt forurensing. For å bidra til dette utvikler vi digitale tjenester som støtter sjøsikkerhet, fremkommelighet og effektiv sjøtransport.


Nå søker vi en erfaren fullstackutvikler som trives i skjæringspunktet mellom teknologi og tverrfaglige problemstillinger, og som ønsker et meningsfullt samfunnsoppdrag. Hos oss får du jobbe i team sammen med produkteiere, designere, utviklere og domeneeksperter – tett på fagmiljøene. Stillingen er en del av staben for digitalisering og innovasjon og du vil rapportere til direktøren plassert på kontorlokasjon i Ålesund. Staben består i dag av 15 ansatte. Hos oss får du jobbe i et tverrfaglig og inspirerende arbeidsmiljø med dyktige kollegaer som samarbeider tett med andre etater, innovasjonsmiljøer og næringslivet.  

  



Vi tilbyr en stabil jobb med gode rammer, rom for faglig utvikling og et arbeidsmiljø med høy takhøyde og engasjerte kolleger. Vi liker teknologi, vi deler kompetanse, og vi heier på hverandre. Kystverket har et voksende teknologimiljø med stort handlingsrom, og vi tilrettelegger for at du kan bygge kompetanse i takt med både egne interesser og Kystverkets behov.

  

  

#### **Arbeidsoppgaver**


* Utvikle og forvalte digitale løsninger som støtter Kystverkets strategiske mål
* Bidrag i tverrfaglige produktteam med ansvar for løsninger i produksjon
* Utvikling av funksjonalitet på tvers av backend, frontend og integrasjoner der det er relevant
* Arbeid med skybaserte løsninger i Azure
* Faglig retningsstyring og veiledning av andre utviklere
* Andre oppgaver kan tillegges

Noe reisevirksomhet må påregnes


#### **Kvalifikasjoner**


* Relevant høyere utdanning på masternivå. Særlig lang og omfattende relevant erfaring kan kompensere for utdanningskravet
* Solid kompetanse innen systemutvikling dokumentert gjennom faglige resultater i relevante stillinger/prosjekter. Av teknologier bruker vi i C\# / .NET 10, React og Terraform. Vi pakker applikasjonene våre i Docker\-containere og kjører de i Azure Container Apps med PostgreSQL som underliggende database. Teamene anvender Github Actions for kvalitetssjekk, bygging og utrullinger. Vi bruker LGTM\-stacken for observabilitet og bruker Grafana aktivt for overvåkning og innsikt.
* God skriftlig og muntlig formuleringsevne på norsk

Du må ha erfaring med


* Utvikling på tvers av applikasjonslag og integrasjoner
* Skybasert utvikling, fortrinnsvis i Azure
* Erfaring med, eller interesse for å ta i bruk AI i utviklingsarbeidet
* Forståelse for kjøretidsmiljø, herunder applikasjonsdrift og containere

  

*Den som blir ansatt må kunne sikkerhetsklareres på nivå hemmelig. Vi opplyser om at klareringsmyndigheten har en streng praksis ved vurdering av nødvendig tilknytning til Norge ifm klarering.*  

  



#### **Personlige egenskaper**


* Innovativ tilnærming, med evne til å se muligheter i ny teknologi og anvende denne
* Nysgjerrig og lærevillig, med ønske om å holde deg oppdatert og utvikle egen kompetanse
* Trygg og selvstendig
* Fleksibel og løsningsorientert
* Gode samarbeids\- og kommunikasjonsferdigheter, og evner å jobbe effektivt på tvers av fagmiljøer

Personlige egenskaper vil bli vektlagt


*Sammen med oss må du kunne identifisere deg med Kystverkets verdier som er fremtidsrettet, engasjert og pålitelig.*
#### **Vi tilbyr**
