jobs.title: Forward Deployment Engineer
jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

Build technology that solves real business problems
We are looking for an experienced Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
to work at the intersection of technology, data, AI and the business.

This is not a traditional software engineering role. You will work directly with our investment, operations and distribution teams, spending time with the people who use our technology to understand their workflows, identify meaningful problems and build solutions that make a measurable difference.

You will have the autonomy to take ideas from problem definition through to production, often moving from prototype to a working solution in days or weeks rather than months.

The role
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:
Work directly with business teams to understand their workflows, challenges and opportunities.
Identify high-impact problems where software, automation, data or AI can improve how we operate.
Rapidly prototype solutions, test them with users and iterate based on real-world feedback.
Take successful prototypes through to production, building secure, reliable and maintainable services.
Work across the full technology stack, including backend services, APIs, data pipelines and user-facing applications.
Integrate data and systems across APIs, databases, files and message queues, turning complex and fragmented data into useful products and services.
Apply modern AI and LLM capabilities to accelerate delivery and create new ways of working.
Partner closely with engineering, data and platform teams to align with architecture, security and technology standards.
Maintain a strong focus on security, governance, data protection and operational resilience, particularly where solutions interact with client assets and regulated activity.

About you
You are a hands-on engineer and pragmatic problem solver who enjoys being close to the people you build for.
You are comfortable operating in environments where the problem is not always clearly defined. You can ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, make sensible trade-offs and move quickly from an idea to something users can actually work with.
You are equally comfortable discussing architecture with engineers, mapping a business process with a subject matter expert, or explaining a technical trade-off to a senior stakeholder.
Most importantly, you care about building the right thing, not simply building things right.

Experience needed for the role:
4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering and supporting production systems.
Experience taking projects end to end, from problem definition and design through development, deployment and ongoing improvement.
Experience working directly with users, clients or business stakeholders is highly desirable.
Strong experience integrating APIs, databases, files and messaging systems, and working with complex or imperfect real-world data.
Experience in financial services, investment management, asset management or another regulated, data-intensive environment is highly desirable.
Experience using modern AI/LLM technologies, or a demonstrated ability and enthusiasm to adopt them quickly.

Technical skills
We are looking for strong engineering fundamentals rather than a specific technology background. Experience with one or more of the following is valuable:
Programming: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, C# or Go.
Full stack development: backend services, APIs and modern web applications.
Data: SQL, PostgreSQL, Azure SQL, data modelling, cloud storage and graph technologies, including GraphRAG.
Cloud and infrastructure: Azure, containers, CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
Security: authentication, authorisation, data isolation, input validation and secure handling of sensitive information.
AI: LLMs, AI-assisted development, intelligent automation and emerging AI application patterns.

If you are an engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working directly with users and turning ideas into production technology, we would like to hear from you.

About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

Position Overview 

We are building a cutting-edge Platform that will transform the way our customers identify, protect and govern their data. This will revolutionize how customers secure their data by placing identity at the core — providing unparalleled visibility and control.

We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to design, build, and operate the services powering our enterprise SaaS security platform. You will work across a microservices architecture spanning ASP.NET Core APIs, Azure Functions, SQL Server, and Azure CosmosDB — shipping capabilities that serve Fortune 500 customers in hybrid cloud and on-prem environments at high scale.

This is a hands-on engineering role where strong technical execution, distributed-systems fluency, and a security-first mindset are essential. You will independently own features and services end-to-end, collaborating closely with product, architecture, and fellow engineers to deliver scalable, multi-tenant solutions that meet enterprise and regulatory standards.

This is a hybrid role with visits to our Kraków office.

Key Responsibilities 

Backend Service Development

Design and implement backend features end-to-end: from ASP.NET Core REST APIs and Azure Functions through to SQL Server and CosmosDB data layers.
Develop and extend .NET services within a microservices architecture composed of independently scalable, per-service function hosts.
Write and maintain Azure Functions for asynchronous processing workloads.
Build resilient, idempotent message-driven workflows using Azure Service Bus.

Data & Cloud Engineering

Work with SQL Server and Azure CosmosDB to implement performant, secure data access patterns at scale.
Own data access patterns that respect multi-tenant isolation boundaries and comply with security and privacy requirements, including RLS policy management.
Leverage Azure platform services including Service Bus, Blob Storage, Azure App Configuration, Application Insights, and Entra ID integration.

Quality & DevOps

Write comprehensive backend tests: xUnit, Moq, and FluentAssertions for unit and integration coverage.
Participate in CI/CD pipeline maintenance using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps.
Contribute to infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and containerized local development (Docker Compose, Azurite).
Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, security vulnerabilities, and technical debt across services.

Collaboration & Growth

Independently break down and deliver complex backend work, owning full project lifecycles from design through production.
Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design decisions; enforce best practices across the codebase.
Partner with product managers and frontend/full-stack engineers to define clean, well-documented API contracts.
Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through pairing, code review, and knowledge sharing.
Champion the use of AI-driven approaches within the development process to enhance quality, speed, and innovation.

Qualifications  

6-8 years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong backend/distributed-systems focus.
Strong proficiency in **C# / .NET 8/10** (ASP.NET Core APIs, Azure Functions, isolated worker model).
Hands-on experience with **SQL Server** (T-SQL, Entity Framework Core, relational modelling, Row-Level Security) and at least one NoSQL database (CosmosDB preferred).
Experience building and operating **Azure-hosted** services (Functions, Service Bus, Blob Storage, App Configuration, Application Insights).
Solid understanding of **authentication and authorization** patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT, Auth0 or similar identity providers).
Experience with **multi-tenant SaaS** architectures and the data isolation patterns they require.
Comfortable designing and debugging **asynchronous, message-driven systems** (queues, event-driven processing, idempotency, retries).
Familiarity with **CI/CD pipelines** (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
Familiarity with **Docker and Kubernetes**.
Strong testing discipline (unit, integration) using xUnit/Moq/FluentAssertions or equivalent.
Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team.

Preferred Qualifications 

Exposure to enterprise security domains (identity security, data security posture management, compliance).
Experience with **Azure CosmosDB** (SQL API and/or Gremlin graph API), including partitioning and throughput tuning.
Experience designing service boundaries in a **microservices architecture** with independent scaling and deployment.

jobs.description:
Who We Are 

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general.    

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.   

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

We are building and evolving Private Debt, a top-priority project for SimCorp right now and we are expanding the area to meet increasing client demand and deliver more outcomes. We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer with strong experience in test automation and a solid foundation in manual testing to ensure our product remains robust and reliable. You will also have the opportunity, and need, to learn APL, a functional programming language used in key parts of our stack. Prior experience with APL isn’t required, we provide comprehensive training and a supportive environment to help you succeed. Our company also partly owns Dyalog APL, ensuring the language remains actively maintained and relevant.

This is a great fit if you're a hands-on QA engineer who enjoys digging into code, designing automated tests, and wants to broaden your programming skills in new paradigms.

This role is pivotal in accelerating delivery cycles while maintaining high product quality. By automating critical test scenarios and integrating them into the CI/CD pipeline, you’ll help reduce manual testing effort, catch defects early, and ensure faster, more reliable releases-directly impacting customer satisfaction and business agility.

WHY PRIVATE DEBT, WHY NOW

Private Debt is growing rapidly in the market and we see increasing demand from existing and potential clients. That’s why SimCorp is investing in an efficient and attractive solution that supports Private Debt as a key part of illiquid investments, an area where our clients expect both innovation and robustness.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Design, build, and maintain test automation frameworks using APL, C# and related tools
Execute manual and exploratory testing to validate complex financial solutions and edge cases
Collaborate with developers, analysts, and product owners to define clear, testable requirements
Analyze and report bugs with clarity and precision
Help maintain product quality
Learn and apply APL to automate solutions built in this language (full training provided)
Contribute to continuous integration, quality gates, and deployment pipelines

What We Value

3+ years of experience in QA or software engineering with a focus on test automation
Proficiency in C# and .NET testing frameworks like SpecFlow/Reqnroll
Strong understanding of software QA methodologies, tools, and processes
Comfortable with manual testing in complex business domains (ideally finance or data-heavy systems)
Solid experience testing APIs, services, and data pipelines
A willingness and curiosity to learn APL, no prior experience required, but enthusiasm is essential
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Agile and BDD practices.

Additionaly We Value

Working with others to leverage the knowledge of everyone on the team
Taking responsibility for your work and striving to achieve tangible results
Trying new approaches to handle both new and existing challenges
Learning new skills and enhancing existing ones
Continually seeking ways to improve our processes and the way we work
Giving and receiving feedback in a way that promotes growth and understanding

Benefits 

Flexible working hours and hybrid model - 2 days in the office, 3 days remote
Modern office (next to Wilanowska metro station) with quiet zones and ergonomic workstations
Base salary with annual bonus structure 
Holiday allowance upon a 2-week vacation
Occasional remote work across Poland and international options available (up to 24 days domestic, 20 days international per year - subject to internal policy)

This role sits within Coro's DevOps and Assurance team, part of the Next Generation Software Solutions (NGSS) department. The team enables secure, efficient, and reliable delivery of technology across Bain's global ecosystem, focusing on both technical operations and platform assurance so that every deployment meets the firm's standards for quality, security, and compliance.
WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM 

The Staff Engineer owns the design, architecture, and long-term direction of cloud infrastructure and software delivery across Coro's DevOps and Assurance team. Working alongside architects and backend engineers, this engineer sets the technical standard for how the team provisions infrastructure, ships software, and secures its platforms, and ensures those platforms scale as the build plan expands.
This is a critical foundational role in the early stages of the platform build, requiring both strong technical fundamentals and the pragmatism to make infrastructure decisions that support a fast-moving product team.
WHAT YOU’LL DO 

Infrastructure Architecture & Automation – 30%

Own the design and evolution of cloud infrastructure built on Terraform and Terraform Cloud. Define the module structure, state strategy, and remote backend conventions the rest of the team builds against.
Architect Azure networking end to end: VNet/subnet topology, private endpoints, DNS resolution, NSG design, and Front Door Premium configuration across dev, demo, and production.
Set the standard for provisioning Azure platform services (App Services, Azure SQL, Azure OpenAI, Container Registry (e.g. Azure Container Registry, Cloudsmith), Key Vault, Entra ID, Storage Accounts / ADLS Gen2) and ensure environment parity by design.
Own the automation roadmap for the team: identify manual, repetitive operational work, own the backlog of it, and drive it toward self-service and infrastructure-as-code so operational load trends down over time.
Partner with Bain's central cloud and infrastructure teams to shape shared processes, tooling, and standards for operational work.

Cloud & Platform Management (Azure) – 20%

Own Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) architecture, including node pools, scaling strategy, spot instance usage, and workload connectivity to dependent services (databases, storage, AI services).
Define identity and access architecture: Entra ID app registrations, managed identities, RBAC model, and integration with external IdPs (Okta).
Set infrastructure standards for database platforms (Azure SQL Serverless, PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Cosmos DB), including connectivity, Entra auth, firewall rules, and private endpoints.
Ensure platform reliability and robust access controls across all environments, and act as the senior escalation point for platform-level issues.

CI/CD & Software Delivery – 15%

Define and own the CI/CD strategy using GitHub Actions for container builds, infrastructure deployments, and application releases, setting the patterns other engineers extend.
Establish the container image lifecycle standard: build, scan, push to a container registry (e.g. Azure Container Registry, Cloudsmith), and deploy to AKS or App Services.
Design environment promotion workflows with appropriate gating, secrets management (Key Vault), and rollback strategies.
Architect and operate GitHub-hosted private runners where required, including network integration with Azure VNets.

Monitoring, Security & Assurance – 15%

Own the observability strategy using the team's monitoring stack (e.g. Datadog, Azure Application Insights). Define what the team monitors, alerts on, and how it optimizes cost and reliability.
Lead the response to security findings: triage, containment, IAM scoping, container image CVE remediation, and endpoint hardening, and set the remediation standards others follow.
Lead L2/L3 incident escalations, including root-cause analysis, user journey tracing, and log analysis, and drive the improvements that prevent recurrence.
Define and enforce solution compliance across products: network isolation, least-privilege access, secrets hygiene, and deployment guardrails.
Own the developer experience: set the standard for local development environments and deployment documentation so engineers across the distributed team can onboard quickly and operate with minimal infrastructure friction.

Technical Leadership & Team Development – 20%

Lead and mentor DevOps engineers: set technical direction, review designs, grow the team's depth, and raise the bar on engineering practice.
Anticipate the needs of stakeholders across NGSS and the wider business, and shape the platform roadmap proactively rather than reactively.
Partner with architects, product engineers, and security teams to align on infrastructure standards and shape platform roadmaps across NGSS.
Drive DevOps culture and automation-first thinking across the engineering organization, and lead knowledge sharing.
Contribute to and often lead technical discovery, POCs, and innovation workstreams to validate new tools, technologies, and architectural patterns.

ABOUT YOU

Education & Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
7–9 years
of experience in DevOps, infrastructure engineering, or cloud platform engineering, with time spent at a senior or staff level.
Proven track record of architecting and operating cloud infrastructure in production at scale, owning technical decisions end to end.
Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring DevOps or platform engineers in fast-paced product organizations.

Professional Skills & Mindset

Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex technical topics for diverse stakeholders and to set direction others can follow.
Proactive, analytical, and systematic, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to trace issues across multiple layers (DNS, networking, identity, application).
Results-driven with a strong bias for automation and continuous improvement, and a track record of driving operational load down over time.
Comfortable owning ambiguity and working with limited direction: able to define standards and roadmaps where none exist yet, and to manage multiple stakeholders independently.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and a genuine commitment to team enablement and growth.

Technical Expertise

Deep hands-on expertise with Terraform 
and Terraform Cloud (or equivalent): module design, state strategy, and remote backends at scale.
Strong mastery of Azure services, including AKS, Networking (VNets, subnets, private endpoints, NSGs, DNS zones), App Services, Key Vault, Container Registry, and Storage Accounts
.
Deep experience with containerization technologies ( Docker, Kubernetes
) and container image lifecycle management.
Expertise in roles, permissions, and IAM,
particularly Microsoft Entra ID and Okta
.
Advanced CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions
, Azure DevOps, and related DevOps toolchains, with the ability to define patterns for a team.
Proficient in Linux administration and automation scripting ( Bash, PowerShell, Python

Strong command of monitoring and observability platforms (e.g. Datadog, Azure Application Insights
).
Deep familiarity with Azure private networking: private endpoints (blob, DFS, SQL, PostgreSQL), Private DNS Zones, and VNet integration for App Services and AKS
.
Command of database deployment and management from an infrastructure perspective, Azure SQL Serverless, PostgreSQL Flexible Server
, and Cosmos DB.
Strong foundation in security remediation
: container CVE patching, IAM scoping, NSG/firewall tightening, and WAF/Front Door rule management.

administration or connectivity from a DevOps lens.

Vem är du?

Vi vill jobba med dig som vill vara med och bygga branschens starkaste affär och team inom Azure cloud consulting. Du drivs av teknisk utveckling samtidigt som du är en stjärna på att kommunicera på ett enkelt språk med kunder och kollegor. Du är lyhörd för kundens nuvarande behov och vågar samtidigt utmana befintliga arbetssätt och lösningar.

Vi söker dig som har

Flerårig erfarenhet av design och implementation av lösningar i Azure, inklusive god kännedom om Microsoft well architected framework & Cloud adoption framework.
Du har jobbat med on premises- eller hybrida system.
Du är bevandrad inom agilt arbetssätt och har stor kunskap av DevOps.
Kompetens inom Infrastructure as code (IaC) & PowerShell/CLI
Du har viss erfarenhet av att designa nätverk och tillhörande komponenter, i Azure och OnPrem.
Du har erfarenhet inom kravinsamling och presale-arbete
Mycket god kommunikationsförmåga och förmågan att leda ditt projekt och dig själv.
Gedigen erfarenhet som konsult där du jobbat med medelstora och stora bolag.

Ett plus om du har

Du har erfarenhet att vårda kundrelationer och driva säljprocesser
Erfarenhet av andra publika molntjänster
Microsoft Certifikat: AZ-104, AZ-305 och AZ-400
IT-Arkitektcertifiering från Dataföreningen eller liknade instans.
Erfarenhet av Cisco och Ubiquitinätverkstekniker

Detta kommer du att göra

Vi arbetar med att möjliggöra våra kunders digitalseringsresor genom att vara djupt tekniska specialister på kundens teknikplattformar, med utgångspunkt i Microsofts ekosystem. Du kommer jobba med kunder som behöver hjälp att flytta upp sina On Premis miljöer till Azure. Du kommer att designa lösningarna utifrån kundens krav och Microsoft well architected framework. Samt hjälpa till att implementera lösningarna.

Vi lägger stor vikt på gemensamma teamleveranser och vi samarbetar ofta med andra team på Accigo. Därför är det viktigt att du trivs med att jobba tillsammans med andra och samtidigt tar ansvar för din egen leverans.

I din roll som Cloud-arkitekt kommer du att agera lösningsarkitekt i våra kunduppdrag, hjälpa till med införsäljning, genomföra externa och interna kompetensutvecklingsinitiativ, design och uppsättning av Azurelösningar, samt hands-on och problemlösning. Du förväntas driva uppdrag och ta stort eget ansvar i dina projekt. Du kommer med din kompetens och branscherfarenhet vara en mycket viktig länk mellan affärsverksamhet och IT-infrastrukturen i Azure.

Vårt team

Vi är ett nyfiket och samarbetsvilligt team, med ett gemensamt brinnande intresse för teknik och digitalisering. Vi ser oss som Sveriges vassaste (och gladaste) team inom våra fokusområden, och har en långsiktig strategi att växa och bli fler. Vi arbetar dagligen med varandra, både i kundleveranser och med erbjudandeutveckling och att driva våra fokusområden.

Förutom att arbeta tillsammans bjuder vi även in till frukostar där vi delar med oss av pinsamheter och udda fakta, kompetensspridning, veckovisa team-träffar och spontana fikastunder. Vi strävar efter att skapa en vardag fylld med spännande projekt och möjligheter hos kund, samt glädje, energi och gemenskap i teamet där dina idéer får ta plats.

Kompensation och förmåner

Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. Vi erbjuder både professionell och personlig utveckling.

Har du några frågor eller är du bara nyfiken? Vi berättar gärna mer om oss över en kaffe: tyra.drakenberg@accigo.se

Accigo är ett konsultbolag som hjälper företag och organisationer med digital affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling med tekniken som möjliggörare. För oss handlar digitalisering till 90% om människor och 10% om teknik. Det är när samspelet mellan människa och teknik fungerar som digitaliseringens fulla styrka visar sig.

För många handlar digitalisering mest om teknik. För oss är det så otroligt mycket större. Digitalisering kan få både människor och organisationer att våga sikta högre, följa sina drömmar och öppna dörrar som de inte ens visste fanns. Och när man ser igenom tekniken och börjar skönja vilka möjligheter som gömmer sig där bakom. Då ser man att framtiden kan vara en fantastisk plats – fylld av mänsklig energi och värme – och digitalisering är inget annat än vår superkraft för att komma dit.

Tech Consulting on digitaalisen suunnittelun ja ohjelmistokehityksen yksikkö, jossa autamme asiakkaitamme kasvamaan yhdistämällä liiketoimintamuotoilun, teknologisen osaamisen ja modernin ohjelmistokehityksen parhaat käytännöt.

Uskomme yhteistyöhön, avoimuuteen ja siihen, että parhaat ratkaisut syntyvät erilaisten ihmisten ja ajatusten kohdatessa.

Asiakkainamme on yli 130 organisaatiota eri toimialoilta, kuten julkishallinto, finanssi-, eläke-, energia-, logistiikka- ja valmistava teollisuus. Kehitämme digitaalisia palveluita, joita ihmiset käyttävät päivittäin – ratkaisuja, joilla on todellista vaikutusta arkeen ja yhteiskuntaan.

Mitä tulet tekemään tässä roolissa?

Tässä roolissa yrittäjähenkisyys ja oma-aloitteisuus ovat avainasemassa. Pääset rakentamaan roolistasi omanlaisesi osana tiimiämme, ja painopisteesi voi olla esimerkiksi myynnin tukemisessa, asiakasdialogissa, teknisten ratkaisujen määrittelyssä, backlogien jalostamisessa tai jatkuvan parantamisen edistämisessä.

Työskentelemme usein funktioittain asiakkaiden sijaan, ja odotamme sinulta uusia näkökulmia sekä halua kehittää toimintatapojamme. Asiakastyössä autat ohjaamaan keskustelua pitkäjänteisen ja ketterän tuotekehityksen suuntaan sen sijaan, että keskityttäisiin pelkästään aikataulukysymyksiin.

Liityt tiimiin, jossa osaamisen jakaminen, yhteistyö ja asiakkaista huolehtiminen ovat vahvasti läsnä. Näkemystäsi arvostetaan, ja toivomme sinun olevan tärkeä osa yhteistä menestystämme!

Vähintään 2 vuoden kokemus Microsoft Power Platform -ratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta
Vahva osaaminen Power Platformista (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Power Pages, Copilot Studio)
Dynamics 365 -kokemus katsotaan eduksi
Power Platform / Dynamics -sertifikaatit plussaa
Kokemusta .NET- ja/tai React-kehityksestä sekä integraatioista
Kokemusta Azure Functions- ja Logic Apps -ratkaisuista sekä DevOps-ympäristöistä
Kokemusta tekoälyn hyödyntämisestä kehityksessä ja asiakasratkaisuissa
Hyvät viestintätaidot ja kyky selittää teknisiä ratkaisuja ei-teknisille sidosryhmille
Sujuva suomi ja englanti
Soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto (esim. tietojenkäsittely, ohjelmistotekniikka)

Miksi liittyä kasvavaan tiimiimme?

Tiedolla rakennamme teknologiaa, joka toimii ihmisten hyväksi. Tech Consultingissa työskentelet teknologian, innovaation ja yhteiskunnallisen vaikuttavuuden rajapinnassa.

Saat tueksesi Suomen laajimman IT-osaajaverkoston sekä kulttuurin, joka kannustaa yhteistyöhön, uteliaisuuteen ja jatkuvaan oppimiseen. Meillä kasvu ei pysähdy.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Merkityksellistä työtä yhteiskunnallisesti kriittisten digitaalisten ratkaisujen parissa
Pohjoismaisen, vastuullisen ja luottamukseen perustuvan työyhteisön
Mahdollisuuksia kehittää osaamistasi eri toimialoilla, teknologioissa ja rooleissa
Joustavat työskentelytavat, hyvinvointia tukevat edut sekä inhimillisen työkulttuurin

Miten haet mukaan?

Lähetä hakemuksesi urasivujemme kautta ja tule mukaan rakentamaan Microsoft-ratkaisujen tulevaisuutta eri toimialoilla!

Huomioithan, että emme käsittele hakemuksia heinäkuun aikana. Palaamme rekrytointiprosessiin elokuun alussa, joten jätä hakemuksesi jo nyt, jotta ehdit mukaan hakuun!

About The Role

Public 360 integrates cloud-based AI capabilities into standard enterprise software. We are building solutions for 600+ public organizations in the Nordics, and our AI platform runs customer deployments at scale and is evolving fast with GenAI and agentic AI.

As Senior AI Cloud Architect, you own the cloud architecture for our AI platform and shared services. You will define reference architectures, make key technology choices (Microsoft-first, but open), and ensure security, reliability, and automation as we scale.

Design and evolve the target architecture for a public-cloud-first AI platform (Azure preferred).
Exploration of alternative deployment strategies for high-security customers

Senior – 8-10+ years of relevant experience, including service or solution architecture in complex product environments. More junior profiles will be considered in case of relevant experience – not the time but the type of experience and responsibility is important to us.

Increase delivery speed and consistency through automation: self-service environments.
Improve reliability and cost efficiency with SLO-driven operations, observability, and FinOps practices.

Azure-first and automation-driven: containers/Kubernetes, serverless, messaging, IaC (Terraform/Bicep), CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub), observability, and cloud security tooling. We are open to AWS/GCP experience.

A clear platform roadmap indicating the next steps for our data and ai platform as baseline for our product teams, supporting our vision of AI-first and agentic-first software offerings in the public sector domain.

Build technology that improves citizen services - with real-world scale and meaningful impact.
A highly skilled, collaborative environment with room to influence architecture decisions end-to-end.
Modern cloud-first stack, strong focus on security and responsible AI, and freedom to explore new approaches (including agentic AI).
Professional growth, international collaboration, and a culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership.

with strong expertise in X++ and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain Management (D365 F&SCM)
? This is your opportunity to join the central ICT team at Jan De Nul, based in Aalst, Belgium
. From our offices in Hofstade/Aalst, you will work on innovative, tailor-made solutions that support the core processes of a global organization.

You actively contribute to integrations, optimizations, and technical architectures within a dynamic ICT environment where quality, collaboration, and technological innovation are key.

Join our ICT team in Aalst and help shape future-proof digital solutions within a leading international company.

Your Role

At Jan De Nul, our ICT Development team plays a key role in supporting a wide range of dynamic business processes. Through both in-house developed and third-party software, we deliver tailored solutions that meet the evolving needs of the company.

As a Senior Software Developer D365 F&SCM Engineer within our FLOW ICT team you will focus on the technical side of building solutions in D365 F&SCM, going from implementing architecture design, programming, unit testing and ultimately delivering the solution towards our business users worldwide.

Your key Responsibilities:

Assist the Integration/Solution Architect in designing integrations between D365 applications and legacy/third party systems using multiple technologies, including X++, REST API, Power Automate, and MS SQL/Datalake/Dataverse.
Create SSRS reports
Provide feedback to improve and refine specifications.

Write clean, structured, and testable code.

Follow established design principles, integration patterns, coding standards, and conventions.
Use modeling languages to understand and implement analyses.
Continuously build knowledge of the business domain and explore emerging technologies.
Deliver technical support for third-line incidents.

You will work from within our centralized ICT- team based in Belgium, Hofstade/Aalst where you can count on a stimulating work environment, a competitive salary, and a comprehensive benefits package — including the option to lease a company car.

What do you need?

As Software Developer, you are passionate about coding and bring a strong foundation in computer science — either through a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

You have at least five years of professional experience in object-oriented programming (X++, D365 FSCM is a must). Creating reports with SSRS is considered as a plus.

You have solid expertise in X++, and RESTful web services using ASP.NET Web API. You are also proficient in SQL and stored procedures.

Understanding of security design principles for both D365 F&SCM and Azure components, including the mechanisms for authorization and interaction with these components

You possess a good knowledge and can speak fluently in Dutch, considered as a prerequisite for this role

Working at Jan De Nul

Working at Jan De Nul means helping to find solutions to some of the biggest challenges of our time: from energy transition to rising sea levels to smart mobility. It means learning and working together every day, with the aim of ensuring the global quality of life for generations to come. 

What We Offer

Through the JDN Academy, we offer you an ongoing training path.
Through our FIT program, we watch over your well-being with attention to exercise, nutrition and various team activities.
A healthy work-life balance (flexible working hours and occasional work from home).
An open-ended contract with 42 paid vacations (20 statutory, 12 ADV and 10 public holidays).
An attractive salary with thirteenth month and double vacation pay included:
Meal vouchers and eco vouchers.
Possibility to participate in the Flex Reward program containing bicycle and car leasing including fuel card in Belgium.

You become part of an internationally growing family business.

The world becomes what you make of it. 
Jan De Nul is shaping water and land around the world. We drive the transition to renewable energy with offshore energy infrastructure. We focus on nature-inclusive dredging solutions to build ports and protect our coastline. We develop innovative construction projects for smart mobility and sustainable buildings. And we redevelop our planet by giving polluted sites a new purpose. At Jan De Nul, the world becomes what you make of it.

Bij Nexuzhealth, met kantoren in Hasselt, Leuven, Gent en Antwerpen, werken we aan de toekomst van de gezondheidszorg door krachtige platformen en ecosystemen te ontwikkelen waarin alle belanghebbenden samenwerken voor een gezondere wereld. We gaan verder dan het leveren van een elektronisch patiëntendossier (EPD); we streven ernaar een breed scala aan gebruikers in de gezondheidszorg te ondersteunen. Voor onze Primary Care afdeling (Huisartsen en Thuiszorg) zijn wij op zoek naar een ervaren Application Architect om het ontwerp, implementatie en de architectuur van een van onze SaaS-producten te helpen uitbouwen. Als de technische visionair ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen van schaalbare, veilige en high-performance oplossingen die voldoen aan zowel de huidige als toekomstige behoeften. Je zult deel uitmaken van 1 van onze engineering teams, en verantwoordelijk zijn voor het ontwerpen en helpen implementeren van 1 of meerdere functionele domeinen binnen onze producten. Als Application Architect zorg je ook voor de groei en goede werking van het team, je volgt de developers op, helpt met coachen en persoonlijke ontwikkeling, en helpt het team efficiënt werken. Daarnaast maak je deel uit van het Architectuur Team, dat over de teams heen zorgt voor een consistente aanpak en waar de overkoepelende architectuur beslissingen worden genomen.

Technisch Leiderschap: Geef strategische richting voor het ontwerp, de ontwikkeling en implementatie van features, waarbij hoge beschikbaarheid, schaalbaarheid en beveiliging worden gegarandeerd.
Coach en begeleid ontwikkelaars binnen je team om ervoor te zorgen dat ze allemaal naar dezelfde doelen toewerken.
People Management: je bent verantwoordelijk voor de opvolging, groei en evaluaties van de ontwikkelaars binnen jouw team
Evaluatie van de Technologie Stack: Selecteer en evalueer technologieën, frameworks en tools om ervoor te zorgen dat ze in lijn zijn met de behoeften van het product, de technische doelen en de best practices binnen de industrie.
Hands-on development: Werk binnen een engineering team om de code architectuur, kwaliteit en design te bewaken. Lead by example: je ontwikkelt actief mee aan features en coached de rest van het team
Deployment Architecture: Ontwerp de applicatie-implementatie architectuur voor services, APIs en integraties, waardoor een modulaire en losgekoppelde architectuur wordt mogelijk gemaakt die hergebruik en snelle implementatie bevordert.
Security and Compliance: Implementeer beveiliging volgens de security by design-principes, waarbij wordt gegarandeerd dat het platform voldoet aan industriestandaarden zoals GDPR, SOC 2 en andere compliance vereisten.
Performance Optimization: Zorg ervoor dat de architectuur hoge beschikbaarheid, lage latentie en efficiënt gebruik van middelen ondersteunt, en streef naar continue verbetering.
Documentatie en normen: Zorg ervoor dat architecturale documentatie geschreven en up-to-date gehouden wordt en stel normen op voor ontwikkelingsteams om consistentie en kwaliteit te waarborgen.
Innovatie en Toekomstige Groei: Identificeer en evalueer opkomende technologieën en praktijken die de architectuur van het platform kunnen verbeteren en toekomstige zakelijke behoeften kunnen ondersteunen.

Wat breng jij mee?

Opleiding: Bachelor- of masterdiploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering of een gerelateerd vakgebied.
Minimaal 8 jaar ervaring in softwareontwikkeling, met ten minste 4 jaar in een software architect-rol gericht op SaaS-producten.
Bewezen ervaring in de architectuur van cloudgebaseerde oplossingen met platforms zoals GCP, AWS of Azure.
Sterk begrip van contract-first en event-driven architecturen, containerisatie (Docker, Kubernetes), micro-services en serverless technologieën.
Ervaring in de gezondheidszorg wordt als een pluspunt beschouwd.
Expertise in moderne programmeertalen zoals Java en idealiter Golang. Ervaring met Java en Spring Boot, en ervaring met Golang wordt als een groot pluspunt beschouwd.
Diepgaand begrip van databases (SQL/NoSQL), gedistribueerde systemen en event-driven architectuur.
Ervaring met CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps-praktijken en infrastructure as code (IaC).
Sterke kennis van security best practices en compliance-normen in SaaS-omgevingen.
Uitstekende probleemoplossende vaardigheden en het vermogen om in een samenwerkende omgeving te werken.
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden, met het vermogen om complexe technische concepten uit te leggen aan zowel technische als niet-technische belanghebbenden.
A can-do mentality: Je stelt oplossingen voor in plaats van problemen aan te kaarten en je kan actief mee in de code duiken
Je hebt ervaring binnen grotere omgevingen, waar er meerdere teams samen werken aan hetzelfde product.

Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?

Maatschappelijk Relevant Werk: Werk bij ons biedt de unieke kans om de gezondheidszorg te verbeteren en de levens van patiënten wereldwijd positief te beïnvloeden.
Uitgebreid salarispakket met Extralegale Voordelen: Een aantrekkelijk loon aangevuld met de keuze tussen een elektrische wagen met laadpas of een mobiliteitsbudget, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, een uitgebreide groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering, een gsm-abonnement, een forfaitaire onkostenvergoeding en de flexibiliteit om je salarispakket aan te passen met ons Flex Reward Plan.
Carrièreboost: Neem je eigen professionele groei met vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid in handen.

Fun@work: Werk is leuk bij ons! Geniet van maandelijkse happy hours, spannende team-events en legendarische bedrijfsfeesten.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Cloud Simulation & Full-Stack
jobs.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About The Role

We are looking for a software engineer to build the cloud-native and full-stack systems that power customer-facing simulation at Skydio. In this role, you will design and implement the services, APIs, and interfaces that allow customers to configure, personalize, and interact with the Skydio Simulator at scale.

This is not a pure cloud role: you will work closely with the simulator itself, interfacing directly with C++ and Python systems that run real-time simulation and autonomy software. You’ll help bridge the gap between a complex robotics simulator and intuitive, flexible user experiences delivered through the cloud.

Areas Of Responsibility

Cloud-Backed Simulation Services: Build backend systems that orchestrate simulator execution, configuration, and lifecycle management in cloud environments.
Customer Personalization and Configuration: Enable customers to tailor simulation environments, scenarios, vehicles, and behaviors through robust APIs and services.
Simulator Integration: Design clean, reliable interfaces between cloud services and the core simulator runtime, including control, data exchange, and monitoring.
Full-Stack Experiences: Develop backend and frontend components that expose simulator capabilities through web interfaces and customer-facing tools.
Scalability and Reliability: Ensure simulation services are secure, observable, and scalable to support production customer workloads.

What You’ll Do

Design and build cloud-native services that orchestrate, configure, and interact with the Skydio Simulator at scale.
Develop robust backend systems that interface directly with the simulator runtime, enabling control, configuration, data exchange, and monitoring.
Build customer-facing workflows and APIs that allow users to personalize simulation environments, scenarios, vehicles, and behaviors.
Implement full-stack features, collaborating across backend services and frontend applications to deliver intuitive, reliable simulation experiences.
Partner closely with simulator, autonomy, and product teams to translate complex simulator capabilities into usable, production-ready customer features.
Architect systems with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, observability, and security, supporting multi-tenant, production workloads.
Contribute to technical direction and architectural decisions around how simulation is delivered as a cloud product.

Qualifications

Strong professional experience building backend and distributed systems in production environments.
Proficiency in Python and C++ (required), with the ability to integrate cloud services with performance-sensitive native systems.
Proficiency in modern frontend development using TypeScript and React.
Experience designing and consuming APIs, including GraphQL or similar API paradigms.
Experience with cloud and platform technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes, and PostgreSQL.
Comfort working across system boundaries — from cloud services and APIs down to simulator-facing interfaces.
Strong product sense and ability to design systems that are both technically sound and intuitive for customers.
Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across multiple teams and disciplines.

Bonus Experience

Experience with Go for backend or platform services.
Experience with Rust (strong plus), especially for systems, performance-sensitive, or infrastructure work.
Frontend experience with 3D or visualization technologies such as Three.js or WebGL.
Familiarity with workflow orchestration systems such as Temporal.
Experience productizing complex technical systems for external users.
Background or interest in simulation, robotics, or real-time systems.

At Skydio we believe that diversity drives innovation. We have created a multidisciplinary environment that embraces the power of diverse perspectives to create elegant solutions for complex problems. We are committed to growing our network of people, programs, and resources to nurture an inclusive culture.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local anti-discrimination laws.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Diligent, you’ll be hands-on in shaping the future of our platform by designing and delivering secure, scalable, and high-performing microservices that power our SaaS solutions. You’ll have the full power of AWS at your disposal and will work primarily in C#/.Net Core and Angular to build serverless solutions, either from the ground up or by modernizing existing services.

In this role, you’ll lead by example, owning services end-to-end from development to deployment and monitoring, driving architectural discussions, and mentoring others across the team. You’ll be a key voice in evolving our engineering practices and will actively champion the use of AI-powered tools to streamline development, improve quality, and boost team productivity.

We’re looking for someone who is not only passionate about building great software but also excited to explore how AI can unlock better ways of working for themselves and their teammates.

Key Responsibilities:

Design and own secure, scalable services, guiding technical decisions and evaluating trade-offs (including AI-driven components) to meet reliability, performance, and cost goals.
Leverage AI tools to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, and prototyping, while rigorously validating outputs to ensure quality and safety.
Advise on appropriate AI use (model concepts, prompt patterns, ethical/privacy considerations), embed monitoring and compliance checks into workflows, and document residual risks and mitigations.
Coach peers on engineering best practices and AI-augmented approaches; partner with Product, Security, DevOps, and other teams to align on features, deployment, and compliance.
Scout and pilot emerging tools or frameworks (including AI toolchains), integrate automated governance checks into pipelines, and enhance observability and incident response with an eye on productivity, cost, and resilience.

Required Experience/Skills

5-7 years of professional software engineering in an agile environment, delivering secure, scalable services.
Understands high-level LLM concepts (e.g., hallucinations, prompt sensitivity) and safe vs. unsafe AI use cases.
Experienced in using AI tools to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, and prototyping, with critical review of outputs.
Skilled in prompt engineering—designing reusable prompts and coaching peers.
Familiar with ethical/cost risks (bias, privacy, vendor lock-in) and embeds basic compliance checks into workflows.
Proficient in C#, .Net for RESTful APIs (OpenAPI), and hands-on AWS serverless patterns.
Comfortable with infrastructure as code (CDK/Terraform), containerization (Docker), CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring tools.
Experience with SQL (PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL databases; able to design and optimize schemas for performance.
Applies security best practices in code and deployments (e.g., IAM, secrets management) and reviews AI-assisted suggestions for safety.
Strong communication of technical and AI-related concepts to diverse stakeholders.
Proven ability to mentor or guide peers on engineering best practices and AI-augmented workflows.
Familiarity with Angular to collaborate effectively on end-to-end features.
Degree in Computer Science/Engineering/related field or equivalent hands-on experience.

About Us

Diligent is the AI leader in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) SaaS solutions, helping more than 1 million users and 700,000 board members to clarify risk and elevate governance. The Diligent One Platform gives practitioners, the C-Suite and the board a consolidated view of their entire GRC practice so they can more effectively manage risk, build greater resilience and make better decisions, faster.

At Diligent, we're building the future with people who think boldly and move fast. Whether you're designing systems that leverage large language models or part of a team reimaging workflows with AI, you'll help us unlock entirely new ways of working and thinking. Curiosity is in our DNA, we look for individuals willing to ask the big questions and experiment fearlessly - those who embrace change not as a challenge, but as an opportunity. The future belongs to those who keep learning, and we are building it together. At Diligent, you’re not just building the future - you’re an agent of positive change, joining a global community on a mission to make an impact.

Learn more at diligent.com or follow us on LinkedIn and Facebook

What Diligent Offers You

Creativity is ingrained in our culture. We are innovative collaborators by nature. We thrive in exploring how things can be differently both in our internal processes and to help our clients
We care about our people. Diligent offers a flexible work environment, global days of service, comprehensive health benefits, meeting free days, generous time off policy and wellness programs to name a few
We have teams all over the world. We may be headquartered in New York City, but we have office hubs in Washington D.C., Vancouver, London, Galway, Budapest, Munich, Bengaluru, Singapore, and Sydney.
Diversity is important to us. Growing, maintaining and promoting a diverse team is a top priority for us. We foster and encourage diversity through our Employee Resource Groups and provide access to resources and education to support the education of our team, facilitate dialogue, and foster understanding.

Diligent created the modern governance movement. Our world-changing idea is to empower leaders with the technology, insights and connections they need to drive greater impact and accountability – to lead with purpose. Our employees are passionate, smart, and creative people who not only want to help build the software company of the future, but who want to make the world a more sustainable, equitable and better place.

Headquartered in New York, Diligent has offices in Washington D.C., London, Galway, Budapest, Vancouver, Bengaluru, Munich, Singapore and Sydney.  To foster strong collaboration and connection, this role will follow a hybrid work model. If you are within a commuting distance to one of our Diligent office locations, you will be expected to work onsite at least 50% of the time.
We believe that in-person engagement helps drive innovation, teamwork, and a strong sense of community.

Diligent is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, pregnancy, childbirth, physical disability, mental disability, age, military status, protected veteran status, marital status, registered domestic partner or civil union status, gender (including sex stereotyping and gender identity or expression), medical condition (including, but not limited to, cancer related or HIV/AIDS related), genetic information, or sexual orientation in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Diligent's EEO Policy and US EEOC’s Know Your Rights. We are a drug free workplace.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at recruitment@diligent.com.

Infrastructure Architect (Azure)

Azure Cloud • Networking & Security • AKS • Logging & SIEM • Infrastructure as Code

Location:

Cloud Platform Team
Reports to:
Head of Cloud Platform / Director of Infrastructure

Role Overview

Our client is a large, highly regulated organisation based in Abu Dhabi
seeking an experienced Infrastructure Architect to join its Cloud Platform team.

You will own the design, build and governance of the Azure foundations that delivery teams across the organisation build on, including subscriptions, networking, firewall and WAF, AKS, and the underlying logging and SIEM estate.

This is a hands-on
architecture role. You will produce high-level and low-level designs, deliver them as Infrastructure as Code alongside engineering teams, and ensure the platform operates reliably and securely in production.

The wider technology estate includes on-premises infrastructure, databases and middleware. Experience designing highly available and disaster-resilient architectures across complex hybrid environments, while providing technical leadership to engineering teams, will be highly valued.

Key Responsibilities

Azure Subscriptions & Governance
Manage Azure subscriptions, management groups and resource groups within an enterprise landing-zone model, enforcing naming, tagging, Azure Policy and RBAC standards.
Govern platform identity through Entra ID, including managed identities, service principals and PIM.
Monitor and optimise Azure cost, utilisation and capacity.

Networking, Firewall & WAF
Define VNets, subnets, IP address plans, peering and hub-and-spoke architectures.
Design hybrid connectivity using ExpressRoute/VPN, routing, DNS and Private Link.
Design, configure and operate Azure Firewall, including network/application rules, TLS inspection and IDPS.
Own WAF policies across Application Gateway and Front Door, including OWASP rule tuning.
Define network segmentation, DDoS protection, secure administrative access and firewall change-management processes.
Produce comprehensive HLDs, LLDs and SOPs.

Container Platform — AKS / Kubernetes
Define AKS reference architectures and hosting standards covering private clusters, node pools, networking, ingress, network policies and workload identity.
Harden AKS environments using image scanning, admission policies, Defender for Containers and Key Vault integration.
Support and guide migrations from existing container platforms onto AKS.

Logging, Monitoring & SIEM
Architect the observability stack using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics, including workspace architecture, retention and cost management.
Define SLO/SLI-based monitoring and alerting for critical services.
Design and operate Microsoft Sentinel or equivalent SIEM platforms.
Ensure firewall, WAF, AKS, identity and database logs are centrally collected and retained in accordance with security and audit requirements.

Infrastructure as Code
Build and maintain Terraform and/or Bicep for platform components, including reusable modules, remote state, environment promotion and drift detection.
Deliver infrastructure through automated CI/CD pipelines.
Establish IaC and policy-as-code standards using technologies such as Azure Policy, Checkov and tfsec.
Automate operational processes using PowerShell, Bash or Python.

Resilience & Technical Leadership
Architect HA and DR across infrastructure, databases and middleware.
Lead periodic DR exercises, L3 incident escalations and root-cause analysis.
Review project architectures against platform standards and provide architecture sign-off.
Mentor infrastructure, cloud and DevOps engineers.

Essential Skills & Experience

12+ years of experience across infrastructure and/or cloud architecture, including 5+ years designing and operating Azure at enterprise scale.
Strong combination of architecture and hands-on engineering experience
— candidates should have personally designed, built, configured and operated Azure environments.
Proven experience managing Azure subscriptions, RBAC, Azure Policy and Entra ID within enterprise landing-zone architectures.
Deep Azure networking expertise covering VNets, peering, hub-and-spoke, ExpressRoute/VPN, Private Link, DNS, NSGs and load balancing.
Strong experience configuring and tuning Azure Firewall and WAF.
Production experience architecting and operating Kubernetes/AKS, including networking, security hardening and upgrades.
Experience designing centralised logging and SIEM platforms using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk or equivalent.
Strong Terraform and/or Bicep capabilities alongside PowerShell, Bash or Python.
Experience producing HLD/LLD documentation and designing and testing HA/DR solutions.
Excellent stakeholder communication skills and experience leading technical teams within large, complex environments.

Desirable Skills & Experience

Experience within government, financial services, critical infrastructure or another highly regulated environment.
Familiarity with recognised information-security standards and regulatory frameworks.
Experience across hybrid or multi-cloud estates including OCI, AWS, VMware or OpenShift.
Defender for Cloud, Key Vault, certificate lifecycle management and zero-trust networking.
API Management and Redis within microservices architectures.
Exposure to GPU/AI workloads within Azure, including GPU VM SKUs, AKS GPU node pools and Azure OpenAI.
Relevant certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), AZ-700, AZ-500, CKA, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, CISSP or CCSP.

Other Requirements

Based in, or willing to relocate to, Abu Dhabi, UAE

jobs.title: Fullstack Developer
jobs.description:
Werk jij graag met moderne front-end technologie en wil je bijdragen aan een grote migratie van een Sitecore- naar een headless ContentStack-omgeving? Word Fullstack Developer bij Loyalis, onderdeel van a.s.r. in Heerlen.

Als Fullstack Developer bij Loyalis, een belangrijke inkomensverzekeraar in het zuiden van Nederland, werk je aan de vernieuwing van een belangrijk digitaal platform voor klanten en collega's. Je speelt een centrale rol in de migratie van de bestaande Sitecore-omgeving naar een moderne headless ContentStack-omgeving en helpt mee om het platform klaar te maken voor de toekomst. Daarbij ligt de nadruk op front-endontwikkeling met Vue.js, Nuxt en TypeScript, terwijl je ook betrokken bent bij API's en de verdere modernisering van de back-end. Je werkt samen met ontwikkelaars, testers, een businessanalist en de product owner aan oplossingen die dagelijks worden gebruikt. Bovendien krijg je ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen richting back-enddevelopment en mee te denken over de technische koers van het platform. Wil jij bouwen aan een nieuw digitaal platform binnen een betrokken team dat volop in ontwikkeling is? Solliciteer dan nu als Fullstack Developer bij Loyalis, onderdeel van a.s.r.!

Dit ga je doen als Fullstack Developer bij a.s.r.
je ontwikkelt en verbetert de front-end van het nieuwe digitale platform met Vue.js, Nuxt en TypeScript

je vertaalt ontwerpen naar toegankelijke, schaalbare en onderhoudsvriendelijke front-endoplossingen
je koppelt front-endcomponenten aan API's en ContentStack

je werkt mee aan de migratie van technisch complexe functionaliteit naar nieuwe API's en services

je draagt bij aan het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van API's in .NET, inclusief documentatie via Swagger

Dit bieden we je
een bruto salaris van € 4.100 - € 5.800 op basis van 38 uur per week, een 13e maand en 8% vakantievergoeding. Een thuiswerkvergoeding en korting op verzekeringen
een goede pensioenregeling met veel flexibiliteit en een hoge bijdrage van de werkgever
een NS-Business Card met vrij reizen (ook privé) of een kilometervergoeding
veel aandacht voor je ontwikkeling, je inzetbaarheid en je gezondheid
hybride werken: gemiddeld 60% vanuit huis en 40% op kantoor en veel ruimte om je eigen werktijden te bepalen
werk waarmee je een positieve invloed hebt op de samenleving van morgen; samen stropen we onze mouwen op voor een eerlijkere en duurzamere toekomst

Deze vacature is echt iets voor jou, want jij
hebt ervaring met Vue.js, Nuxt en TypeScript of vergelijkbare moderne front-end frameworks
hebt ervaring met contentmanagementsystemen; ervaring met een migratietraject is een pré (bijvoorbeeld Sitecore of een headless CMS zoals ContentStack)

hebt affiniteit met back-endontwikkeling en API-integraties

hebt bij voorkeur ervaring met businessanalyse, requirementsanalyse en technische analyse
communiceert gemakkelijk met collega’s en werkt graag samen binnen een scrumteam

Hier ga je werken als Fullstack Developer in Heerlen
Je gaat aan de slag in Team Apollo binnen Loyalis. Samen met ongeveer 7 DevOps-engineers, een product owner en een scrum master werk je aan de Loyalis-website en de verwerking van nieuwe polisaanvragen. Daarbij krijg je te maken met verschillende technologieën, zoals Sitecore en ContentStack, Vue en Nuxt, .NET-services en OutSystems. De komende periode staat in het teken van belangrijke vernieuwingen, waardoor je volop kunt meebouwen aan de toekomst van het platform. Het team werkt in sprints van 3 weken en komt 2 keer per week samen op kantoor voor overleg, samenwerking en kennisdeling. De overige dagen kun je vanuit huis werken. Loyalis, een merk van a.s.r., is dé verzekeraar voor inkomen en zekerheid binnen de sectoren overheid, onderwijs, zorg, vervoer, bouw en nutsbedrijven. We bieden producten en diensten op het gebied van arbeidsongeschiktheid en helpen onze klanten om uitval te voorkomen. Werken bij Loyalis heeft nog méér voordelen: een fijne werksfeer, een uitstekende werk-privébalans, alle ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen én de mogelijkheid om thuis te werken! Collaborate with relevant IS and Business stakeholders to deliver a user-friendly and efficient Sales Configurator solution.

Provide technical support, troubleshooting and fixing issues reported by users.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (AI-Native)
jobs.description:
Despre noi

Suntem un start-up care sprijină SOLOprenorii în drumul lor spre succes. Peste 30.000 de freelanceri, medici, IT-iști și antreprenori români au ales în ultimii 5 ani să își gestioneze PFA-ul cu SOLO — și asta ne face și mai ambițioși. Vrem să ajungem cât mai curând la 100.000 de clienți activi. Misiunea noastră este să transformăm birocrația într-un sistem simplu, digital și automatizat.

Despre ce este rolul?

SOLO este o companie de tehnologie care construiește produse folosite zilnic de zeci de mii de antreprenori din România.

Suntem într-o etapă în care AI-ul devine o componentă centrală în modul în care dezvoltăm produsul. Căutăm un inginer care vede AI-ul nu ca pe un tool auxiliar, ci ca pe o componentă de bază în construcția sistemelor.

Vei lucra la probleme reale, cu impact direct în produs, și vei contribui la modul în care integrăm AI în procesele noastre de dezvoltare în următorii ani.

Este un rol dificil, dar cu impact major asupra direcției tehnice a companiei.

Misiunea ta în acest rol

Vei construi și livra funcționalități care ajung rapid în producție și sunt folosite de un număr mare de utilizatori.
Vei folosi AI pentru a automatiza fluxuri existente și pentru a construi sisteme noi — de la procese interne până la funcționalități direct în produs.
Vei contribui la decizii de arhitectură și la definirea modului în care folosim AI în dezvoltare. Nu există încă un playbook clar — o parte din rol este să îl construim.
Vei lucra direct cu fondatorii, CTO-ul și cu o echipă care pune accent pe simplitate, viteză de execuție și calitate.

Ce ne dorim de la tine

Ai experiență solidă ca software engineer (focus pe .NET) și poți livra constant într-un mediu cu ritm rapid.

Poți transforma probleme neclare în soluții funcționale, fără să depinzi de specificații perfecte.

Ești un power user real de AI. Scrii prompturi ca pe specificații tehnice. Ai construit sau cel puțin ai încercat să construiești un agent autonom, chiar și ca proiect personal de weekend.

Ai instincte bune despre când AI-ul e soluția și când nu e. Ești genul care citește release notes-urile OpenAI și Anthropic în ziua în care apar.

Comunici bine, colaborezi ușor și îți asumi responsabilitatea pentru ceea ce construiești.

Cultura noastră este orientată către performanță, energie și disciplină. Ne dorim colegi care împărtășesc un stil de viață sănătos, iar acest lucru nu este compatibil cu fumatul.

Ce oferim

Salariu competitiv (14.000 - 20.000 RON net, în funcție de nivel)
Zile nelimitate de concediu (pe care le și folosim)
Program flexibil
Abonament premium la clinicile medicale Regina Maria;
Abonament Bookster;
Acces la tool-uri AI (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc) și buget de utilizare.
Lucrăm de la biroul nostru din București (Aviatorilor/Ch de Gaulle), pentru viteză și colaborare

Despre cum lucrăm în general

Modul În Care Lucrăm Este Influențat De Valorile În Care Credem Și Pe Care Ne Propunem Să Le Aplicăm În Tot Ce Facem

Creșterea continuă și accelerată e ceva fundamental - ne așteptăm de la fiecare coleg să își dorească să se dezvolte și să profite pe deplin de toate resursele pe care le punem la dispoziție pentru învățare. Apoi, ne așteptăm ca fiecare coleg să fie interesat mai ales de rezultat, nu doar de efort în sine.

Clientul este în centrul activității noastre: îi înțelegem nevoia reală, îl tratăm cu empatie și alegem soluții simple și clare pentru el. Facem toate acestea în timp ce ne comportăm cu bunăvoință unii față de alții, oferim și acceptăm feedback și menținem și consolidăm un spirit de echipă în care să ne regăsim cu toții.

Fiind un start-up, ne dorim alături oameni energici, curajosi, autonomi, cu o gândire dincolo de tipare, cu simțul umorului și cu o mare flexibilitate mentală, pentru că adesea realitatea din jur și activitățile noastre de zi cu zi se schimbă din mers în timp ce direcția rămâne clară: suntem aici pentru a sprijini SOLOprenorii.

jobs.title: Medior .NET Engineer
jobs.description:
Software ontwikkelen die dagelijks door miljoenen mensen wordt gebruikt. Dat is wat je wil. Samen met je DevOps-team. Software voor het uitwisselen van medische en administratieve gegevens tussen ketenpartijen in de zorg, voor duurzame energieoplossingen of voor de robotisering van distributiecentra. Veilig, betrouwbaar, 100% vakmanschap. Met jouw drive om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen in jouw vakgebied wil je uitgroeien tot de top van de Nederlandse IT.

Bedrijfskritische software ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en in productie brengen voor onze klanten. Dat is waar jij als medior .NET Engineer aan bijdraagt. Samen met een team van collega’s. Applicaties voor medische en administratieve gegevensuitwisseling in de zorg, logistieke en besturingssystemen binnen de industrie, maar ook gebruikers- en werkgeversportalen voor banken en verzekeraars. Systemen die vaak in korte tijd grote hoeveelheden data verwerken. Dit vraagt om betrouwbare, schaalbare en onderhoudsbare software die 24/7 beschikbaar moet zijn. Als medior .NET Engineer weet jij hoe je deze software moet bouwen. Je beschikt over fundamentele en conceptuele kennis van software development en past deze toe in de praktijk. Je deelt kennis en inzichten met collega’s, teamleden en de klant.

Je werkt vaak in een multidisciplinair team dat bestaat uit meerdere Developers, een Architect, Product Owner, Scrum master en een Requirements Engineer. Samen met je team draag je zorg voor het hele traject van ontwerp tot en met het succesvol in productie brengen en laten draaien van de software.

Wat bied jij Info Support?

Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante ervaring als .NET Developer. Je kan projectmatig werken in een professionele omgeving en bent in staat om projecten zelfstandig op te starten. Je levert kwaliteit, beschikt over uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en hebt de ambitie om te blijven groeien; als vakinhoudelijk expert of bijvoorbeeld in een rol als Lead Developer.

Daarnaast:

heb je een passie voor software ontwikkeling;
heb je een bachelor- of universitaire master in ICT, Software Engineering of gelijkwaardig;
houd je ervan om complexe vraagstukken op te lossen, zodat jij de beste oplossing kunt bieden aan de klant;
ben je bereid te fungeren als aanspreekpunt voor junior developers;
ben je gewend zelfstandig te werken en beslissingen te nemen;
wil je voorop lopen in je vakgebied.

Wat biedt Info Support jou?

Uiteraard bieden we je een uitstekend pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden met verschillende keuzemogelijkheden. Denk hierbij aan:

Vakantiegeld, winstuitkering, onkostenvergoeding, bijdrage pensioen
Leasebudget met tankpas (ook voor het buitenland)
Fietsleaseplan
Laptop en smartphone (of BYOD), facilitering thuiswerkplek
Een marktconform salaris en transparant salaris- en beloningsbeleid

Gedurende de eerste twee jaar van je dienstverband volg je onder werktijd naast vakinhoudelijke cursussen en opleidingen regelmatig sociale, bedrijfskundige en commerciële trainingen. Na die twee jaar kan je daardoor eventueel al doorgroeien naar andere rollen.

Ook na de eerste twee jaar krijgt je alle ruimte om je nog verder te ontwikkelen en je doelen en ambities waar te maken. Daar helpen we je bij door samen met jou een persoonlijk ontwikkelplan op te stellen waarin jij op inhoudelijk én persoonlijk vlak nog verder kunt groeien.

Daarnaast biedt Info Support jou:

Collegiale en gepassioneerde IT-collega’s die je continu uitdagen en verder brengen
Veel vrijheid in hoe je je werk indeelt en uitvoert
Uitdagende projecten bij toonaangevende bedrijven die ervoor kiezen hun complexe vraagstukken bij Info Support neer te leggen
Een gegarandeerde plek in een van onze communities waar je op de hoogte blijft van de allerlaatste ontwikkelingen binnen jouw vakgebied
Veel ruimte voor vakinhoudelijke en persoonlijke ontwikkeling door opleiding, training, coaching en conferenties
Leuke team-, unit- en bedrijfsuitjes en de mogelijkheid om je aan te sluiten bij de kook-, boeken-, gaming-, cycle-, muziek- of (mud)runclub of een nieuwe club te starten
Werken bij een solide groeiende en financieel gezonde werkgever!

Over Info Support

Info Support is specialist in maatwerksoftware, data/AI solutions, beheer en trainingen en actief in de sectoren Finance, Industry, Agriculture, Food & Retail, Mobility & Public en Healthcare. Wij bieden solide en innovatieve oplossingen voor complexe en bedrijfkritische softwarevraagstukken. Onze hoofdkantoren zijn gevestigd in Mechelen (BE) en Veenendaal (NL). Op dit moment zijn er circa 500 medewerkers bij Info Support in dienst.

De werkwijze van Info Support kenmerkt zich door een aantal kernwaarden: soliditeit, integriteit, vakmanschap en passie. Deze kernwaarden zijn verweven in ons werk en de manier waarop we met elkaar omgaan.

Om te zorgen dat alle medewerkers altijd op de hoogte kunnen zijn van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen beschikt Info Support over een inhouse IT Academy waar graag wordt voldaan aan de honger naar meer of andere kennis en vaardigheden.

Een salaris tussen € 5.500,- en € 6.250,- bruto per maand, afhankelijk van de ervaring die je meeneemt

Collegiale en gepassioneerde IT-collega’s die je continu uitdagen en verder brengen
Veel vrijheid in hoe je je werk indeelt en uitvoert
Direct een contract voor onbepaalde tijd
Veel ruimte voor vakinhoudelijke en persoonlijke ontwikkeling door opleiding, training, coaching en conferenties
Een gegarandeerde plek in een van onze communities waar je op de hoogte blijft van de allerlaatste ontwikkelingen binnen jouw vakgebied
Leuke team-, unit- en bedrijfsuitjes en de mogelijkheid om je aan te sluiten bij de kook-, boeken-, gaming-, cycle-, muziek- of (mud)runclub of een nieuwe club te starten
Werken bij een solide groeiende en financieel gezonde werkgever!

Info Support is specialist in maatwerksoftware, data/AI solutions, beheer en trainingen en actief in de sectoren Finance, Industry, Agriculture, Food & Retail, Mobility & Public en Healthcare. Wij bieden solide en innovatieve oplossingen voor complexe en bedrijfkritische softwarevraagstukken. Onze hoofdkantoren zijn gevestigd in Veenendaal (NL) en Mechelen (BE). De werkwijze van Info Support kenmerkt zich door een aantal kernwaarden: soliditeit, integriteit, vakmanschap en passie. Deze kernwaarden zijn verweven in ons werk en de manier waarop we met elkaar omgaan.

In this role, you will join our software development department of 35 professionals covering analysis, development, and testing. The team is highly autonomous and works closely with Product Owners to build in house, business driven applications.

Our architecture is Angular, API first, cloud native, and centered around Microsoft Azure, with Apigee for API management and Okta for identity and access management. Knowledge of WEB design is highly valued.

To be successful as a WEB developer, you are analytical, technically strong, and comfortable translating business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable software solutions.

What will you do?

As a WEB Developer, you will:

Develop and maintain scalable web applications using modern front end (Angular) and back end (Dotnet) technologies within Azure
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices and coding standards
Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement responsive and intuitive user interfaces
Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability
Implement security and data protection measures
Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members
Write and maintain technical documentation

What do we expect from you?

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in an Informatics or IT related field
Proven experience as a WEB developer
Strong proficiency in front end technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), and modern frameworks (Angular preferred, React or Vue.js)
Experience with Agile development methodologies
Experience with version control systems (Git)
Knowledge of web security best practices and OWASP guidelines
Good command of the English language (spoken and written)

Experience with cloud platforms (Azure)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines
Experience with testing frameworks and TDD
Knowledge of TypeScript

Throughout September and October, we will review and shortlist potential candidates. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for onsite interviews in October.

With great pride, we can say that Hillebrand Gori is the largest beverages logistics company in the world. Founded in 1844, we are active in over 90 countries. Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities to realize your ambitions in an international environment

Professional training
a fun place to work, with room for recreation; weekly and monthly drinks, quarterly company meet ups, regular company festivities
