jobs.title: (Senior) Cloud Solution Architect – Microsoft Azure (all genders)
jobs.description:
Bei uns kommen AI-Kompetenz, Engineering-Exzellenz und fundiertes Branchenverständnis zusammen – getragen von Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen wollen. So entstehen zukunftsfähige Lösungen, die im Alltag unserer Kunden wirklich einen Unterschied machen. Das gelingt durch Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Chancen erkennen und technologische Möglichkeiten in greifbare Ergebnisse verwandeln. Dafür schaffen wir ein Umfeld, das von gegenseitiger Unterstützung geprägt ist: Raum für fachliche Weiterentwicklung, offene Communities, in denen Wissen gerne geteilt wird, Peer Groups und Trainingsangebote, die sich an dir orientieren. Vertrauen, Wertschätzung und gemeinsam gefeierte Erfolge prägen dabei unser Miteinander und machen Entwicklung zu etwas, das bei uns einfach dazugehört.

DAS KANNST DU BEWEGEN

Azure Architektur: Du entwickelst moderne, sichere und skalierbare Azure-Architekturen und erstellst die Architekturplanung für die zu implementierende Lösung.
Cloud Foundation & Landing Zones: Du konzipierst Azure Landing Zones und gestaltest die technische Basis für Cloud-Transformationen – inklusive Management Groups, Subscriptions, Networking, Identity, Governance und Security.
Azure Migration & Modernisierung: Du begleitest unsere Kunden bei der Analyse, Planung und Umsetzung von Migrationen nach Azure und entwickelst bestehende IT-Landschaften gezielt weiter.
Hybrid Cloud & Networking: Du konzipierst hybride Architekturen und verbindest bestehende On-Premises-Umgebungen sicher mit Azure – beispielsweise mit Azure Virtual Network, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, Private Endpoints und Azure DNS.
Security & Identity: Du integrierst Security von Beginn an in deine Architektur und arbeitest unter anderem mit Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault, Azure Policy und Microsoft Defender for Cloud.
Automation & Infrastructure as Code: Du automatisierst den Aufbau von Cloud-Infrastrukturen mit Technologien wie Terraform oder Bicep und integrierst diese in moderne CI/CD-Prozesse mit GitHub oder Azure DevOps.
Cloud-native Lösungen: Du berätst unsere Kunden auch beim Einsatz moderner Azure Services wie Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps oder Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Integration & APIs: Du kennst die Möglichkeiten von Azure API Management, Service Bus und Event Grid und kannst diese sinnvoll in moderne Lösungsarchitekturen integrieren.
Betrieb & Resilienz: Du berücksichtigst Monitoring, Verfügbarkeit, Backup und Disaster Recovery bereits im Lösungsdesign und nutzt dafür beispielsweise Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Azure Backup und Azure Site Recovery.
Governance & Kosten: Du unterstützt unsere Kunden dabei, ihre Azure-Umgebung kontrollierbar und wirtschaftlich zu betreiben und berücksichtigst dabei Governance- und FinOps-Prinzipien.
Kundenberatung & Workshops: Du diskutierst Anforderungen auf Augenhöhe mit IT-Verantwortlichen und Architekten, moderierst Architektur- und Cloud-Workshops und übersetzt Anforderungen in konkrete technische Lösungen.
PreSales & Angebote: Gemeinsam mit unserem Sales- und Microsoft-Team entwickelst du Lösungsansätze für neue Kundenprojekte und unterstützt bei Architekturkonzepten, Aufwandsschätzungen, Angeboten sowie Präsentationen.
Microsoft Ecosystem: Du arbeitest eng mit Microsoft und unseren internen Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten zusammen und bringst neue Azure-Technologien und Best Practices aktiv in unsere Kundenprojekte ein.
Teamarbeit: Du gibst dein Wissen weiter, unterstützt Kolleginnen und Kollegen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns unser Microsoft Azure Portfolio weiter.

WIE DIR DAS GELINGT

Azure-Erfahrung: Du bringst mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure und der Konzeption sowie Umsetzung von Azure-basierten Kundenlösungen mit.
Infrastructure Know-how: Du verstehst klassische und moderne IT-Infrastrukturen und kennst dich insbesondere mit Cloud Networking, Compute, Storage, Identity, Security und hybriden Architekturen aus.
Architekturkompetenz: Du kannst komplexe Anforderungen analysieren, technische Optionen bewerten und daraus verständliche, sichere und skalierbare Lösungsarchitekturen entwickeln.
Azure Best Practices: Konzepte wie Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework, Azure Landing Zones und Azure Well-Architected Framework sind dir vertraut.
Infrastructure as Code: Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit Terraform und/oder Bicep sowie mit Automatisierungs- und Deployment-Prozessen.
Security: Zero Trust, Identity & Access Management, Network Security, Governance und Cloud Security sind für dich integraler Bestandteil einer Architektur und keine nachgelagerten Themen.
Modernisierung: Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung mit Azure Migrate sowie mit PaaS-, Container- oder Kubernetes-basierten Architekturen gesammelt.
DevOps: GitHub, GitHub Actions oder Azure DevOps sowie CI/CD-Konzepte sind dir vertraut.
Beratungskompetenz: Du kannst komplexe technische Sachverhalte verständlich erklären, trittst beim Kunden sicher auf und entwickelst Lösungen gemeinsam mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.
Eigenverantwortung: Du übernimmst gerne technische Verantwortung und möchtest Lösungen nicht nur konzipieren, sondern deren Umsetzung aktiv begleiten.
Zertifizierungen: Microsoft Azure Zertifizierungen wie Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) sind ein Plus – oder du bist bereit, entsprechende Zertifizierungen bei uns zu erlangen.
KI-Kompetenz: Du verfügst über vertiefte KI-Expertise, gestaltest deren verantwortungsvollen Einsatz in deinem Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mit und fungierst als Enabler für Kunden sowie intern bei adesso.
Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.
Reisebereitschaft & Flexibilität: Du bist bereit, projektbezogen zu reisen, und arbeitest gern in agilen Teams.

CHANCENGEBER - WAS ADESSO AUSMACHT

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, gemeinschaftlich und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Lerne und wachse mit uns: Mit über 400 Trainingsangeboten und unserer digitalen Lernplattform unterstützen wir deine kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung.
Erlebe echten Teamgeist: Gemeinsame Events (z.B. Sport-Weekend und die jährliche Fortbildungsreise eduCamp), Welcome Days, Firmenläufe stärken unseren Zusammenhalt und lassen dich von Anfang an Teil des Teams sein.
Engagement, das belohnt wird: Dein Einsatz zahlt sich aus – mit Prämien für Empfehlungen, Vorträge, die Betreuung von Abschlussarbeiten sowie attraktiven Vergünstigungen über unser Corporate-Benefits-Portal.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns – auch im Home-Office. Arbeiten in Teilzeit ist nach Absprache möglich (80-100%). Zum wiederholten Mal wurden wir zu einem der besten Arbeitgeber der Schweiz gekürt! Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

Translate business and process requirements into technical designs, data models, and integration patterns.
Develop UNS structures (MQTT / Sparkplug / event-driven architectures), ensuring clean naming conventions, governance, and interoperability.
Define how MES, historians, SCADA/PLC, and enterprise systems (ERP, LIMS, QMS) communicate.

Technical Leadership

Provide technical guidance to project teams (MES consultants, automation engineers, data engineers, developers).
Review and validate functional & technical designs, ensuring alignment with the architectural vision.
Support implementation by offering hands-on expertise when needed (prototyping, integration, troubleshooting).
Coach teams and clients to adopt modern industrial IT/OT design principles.

Collaboration & Strategy

Facilitate workshops with stakeholders to explore requirements and align on architectural decisions.
Support clients in building digital transformation roadmaps — focusing on value, resilience, maintainability, and long-term scalability.
Contribute to AG SOLUTION’s internal knowledge base, best practices, and reference architectures.

Quality, Security & Governance

Ensure architectures comply with cybersecurity, data governance, and reliability standards.
Promote modern practices: event-driven architectures, decoupled integration, domain-based modelling, and clean data flows.

Essential Experience

What we’re looking for

Strong expertise in MES platforms (e.g., Siemens Opcenter, Rockwell FTPC, Werum, Aveva, Ignition, etc.).
Deep understanding of manufacturing processes and OT/IT ecosystem integration.
Solid experience with Unified Namespace concepts and enabling technologies:
MQTT, Sparkplug B, broker design, payload conventions

jobs.description:
About This Role

Your team

The Investments and Trading Engineering (ITE) team builds and delivers Aladdin’s risk management, portfolio management, compliance, and trading capabilities. Within ITE, Quantitative Analytics Engineering (QAE) is a global team of quantitative developers responsible for implementing security valuation, portfolio risk, liquidity, and performance attribution models. BlackRock portfolio managers and external Aladdin clients, including pension funds and insurance companies, rely on these models to identify investment opportunities, build portfolios, and manage risk.

Security Analytics Infrastructure (SAI) is an established QAE team with colleagues in Hungary, New York, India, and Switzerland. The team develops scalable, high-throughput, low-latency analytical software in close partnership with Aladdin Financial Engineering, supporting the valuation of fixed-income products such as swaps, bonds, private credit, and derivatives. We challenge established approaches, adopt modern engineering practices, and bring together diverse perspectives to deliver reliable analytical capabilities. Our primary programming languages are C++ and Python.

Your role and impact

As a Director in Quantitative Engineering based in Budapest, you will help shape the next generation of our single-security analytical modeling platform using C++23 and Python 3. Working with colleagues across Europe, India, and the United States, you will influence the strategic development of analytical services in Aladdin and improve how investment analytics are delivered at scale.

You will combine hands-on engineering expertise with technical leadership to understand business processes, identify bottlenecks, and optimize cloud-compute performance. You will lead complex implementations across scalable, modular, and distributed architectures while partnering with users, stakeholders, and engineering teams to translate business and client needs into reliable production solutions. The analytical models supported by the team are central to investment and risk-management workflows, making their scalable and dependable delivery a high-impact, cross-team responsibility.

Your responsibilities

Responsibilities

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:

Design and build the next generation of the single-security analytical modeling platform using C++23 and Python 3, collaborating with colleagues across Europe, India, and the United States.
Influence the strategic development of analytical services in Aladdin by understanding business processes, identifying bottlenecks, and improving cloud-compute performance.
Develop modules, applications, APIs, and observability pipelines that provide clients with new ways to access and use analytics.
Lead complex implementations and translate technical and business requirements into maintainable solutions using scalable, modular, and distributed architectures.
Engage with users, stakeholders, and teams responsible for external client requirements to understand their needs and shape effective solutions.
Partner with teams across BlackRock to understand supported business use cases and determine how they can be delivered more efficiently on a modern platform.
Promote quality through agile delivery, automated testing, effective engineering practices, clean code, and a focus on scalable and reliable analytical services.

Your experience

10+ years of experience in enterprise software development, including ownership of production services, platforms, or distributed systems.
Deep knowledge of software architecture, service design, APIs, data modeling, concurrency, and distributed systems.
Ability to mentor other engineers, lead ambiguous cross-functional initiatives, and deliver maintainable production systems with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Proficiency in C++17 or later and Python 3, supported by knowledge of design patterns, object-oriented design principles, algorithms, and data structures.
Familiarity with software testing, version control, continuous integration, C++ development tools such as CMake, Ninja, ccache, and distcc, Google Protocol Buffers, Unix systems, profiling tools, Azure DevOps, scripting with bash or PowerShell, Microsoft SQL, and enterprise-grade container orchestration platforms supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling.
Familiarity with agentic development principles and knowledge of finance or fixed-income asset types are beneficial but not required. We will support you in developing the relevant financial knowledge.

The salary range for Hungary is 32400000 - 46700000 HUF

Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance.

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Role
  
We're looking for a senior AI Engineer for a consulting assignment focused on building AI\-driven capabilities in a business\-critical, quality\-sensitive setting for a company within healthcare/medtech.
  
Responsibilities
  
Build AI functions that turn clinical content into practical, actionable suggestions for therapists in their daily work.
  
Design end\-to\-end pipelines, including prompt and chain architectures, with structured outputs broken into clear, independently testable steps.
  
Own model selection and strategy, including fine\-tuning open\-weight models.
  
Help establish a data foundation with measurable quality, ensuring data is de\-identified, version\-controlled, and reproducible.
  
Define per\-function evaluation methodology — identifying which error types matter most and what quality bar must be met before output reaches a human reviewer.
  
Set up regression testing and continuous quality monitoring in production.
  
Build traceability mechanisms capturing what the AI suggests versus what the reviewer approves or edits, supporting transparency and long\-term improvement.
  
  

Required Skills
  
Proven experience building LLM\-based systems that run in production, not just proof\-of\-concept work.
  
Able to give concrete examples of how you've iterated on and improved live solutions over time.
  
Strong background across data modeling, pipeline development, and model\-related engineering.
  
Clear understanding of why versioning datasets matters as much as versioning code.
  
Experience handling sensitive personal data, with a real grasp of how nuanced de\-identification can be.
  
Comfortable working against defined quality bars rather than optimizing for a demo.
  
Understands the stakes of reliability in AI systems, particularly where mistakes carry real consequences.
  
**Consulting mindset:** able to step into an existing team, collaborate closely with domain experts, and leave behind solutions others can maintain.
  
  

Nice to Have
  
Background in medical technology, healthcare, or other regulated fields with strong traceability requirements.
  
Experience with speech\-to\-text systems, particularly for Swedish as a lower\-resource language.
  
Familiarity with the .NET ecosystem.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
### **HIGHLIGHTS VAN DEZE VACATURE**


✔ Werken aan internationale machinebouwprojecten, zien wat jouw werk doet in de supermarkt. ✔ Bouwen, installeren en inbedrijfstellen van geavanceerde automatiserings\- en robotsystemen bij klanten. ✔ Genieten van flexibele werktijden en extra vrije dagen, zonder planningchaos.
### **DIT GA JE DOEN**


Als Field Engineer binnen de afdeling Montage werk je aan geavanceerde automatiseringsoplossingen voor de voedingsindustrie. Je bouwt, assembleert en installeert machines en complete productielijnen voor het handlen van blikken, potten en maaltijdzakken. Een deel van je werk doe je in de werkplaats, waar je modules opbouwt en installaties gereedmaakt voor transport. Daarnaast werk je op locatie bij klanten, in binnen\- en buitenland, waar je installaties inbedrijfstelt en zorgt dat alles veilig en volgens specificatie draait. Jij bent de monteur die mechanica, elektrotechniek, robotica en industriële automatisering bij elkaar brengt op de werkvloer. Je werkt veel samen met project engineers en software engineers en bent daarmee letterlijk de schakel tussen tekening en draaiende lijn. Je houdt overzicht, ook als de planning wijzigt omdat een klant opeens een idee heeft aan de rand van een deadline. Zo zorg jij ervoor dat onze systemen bij elke oplevering betrouwbaar draaien en de klant tevreden is. Dit ga je concreet doen:  

* Opbouwen van machines en modules in de werkplaats, inclusief mechanische en elektrische assemblage volgens tekening.
* Installeren, aansluiten, afstellen en inbedrijfstellen van complete productielijnen op locatie bij klanten, circa 30% in het buitenland.
* Ondersteunen bij het testen en opstarten van installaties, inclusief praktische troubleshooting bij technische uitdagingen.
* Signaleren van fouten, afwijkingen en verbeterpunten tijdens montage en installatie en deze terugkoppelen aan betrokken collega’s.
* Bieden van technische ondersteuning richting project engineers en software engineers, zodat hardware en software soepel samenwerken.


Actueel werkt de organisatie aan steeds meer internationale projecten met robotica en industriële automatisering, waardoor jij nu extra veel kunt leren over moderne machinebouw en inbedrijfstelling op verschillende klantlocaties.
### **DIT BRENG JE MEE**


In deze rol werk je gestructureerd, neem je verantwoordelijkheid voor het eindresultaat en denk je actief mee bij technische vraagstukken. Je blijft rustig schakelen tussen werkplaats, klantlocatie en planning, ook als een project nét iets anders loopt dan vooraf bedacht.  

* MBO\-opleiding in een technische richting, bijvoorbeeld mechatronica of werktuigbouwkunde.
* Bij voorkeur ervaring in de machinebouw of montage van industriële installaties.
* Praktische technisch monteur die graag met de handen werkt en robotgestuurde systemen wil leren aansturen.
* Bereid om circa 30% van de tijd in het buitenland te werken bij klanten.
* Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal voor overleg met collega’s en internationale klanten.


### **HIER KUN JE OP REKENEN**


De arbeidsvoorwaarden voor deze functie als Field Engineer zijn gebaseerd op een fulltime werkweek van 40 uur.  

* € 3\.345,00 tot € 5\.210,00 bruto per maand.
* 25 vakantiedagen en 13 adv\-dagen per jaar.
* Reiskostenvergoeding volgens bedrijfsregeling, nader toe te lichten in een gesprek.
* Een werkomgeving vol kansen om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen via opleidingen en trainingen.
* Flexibele werktijden die helpen om werk, sport, hobby’s en gezin praktisch te combineren.
* 8% vakantiegeld.
* Werkgeversbijdrage van 2/3de aan het pensioen.


Daarnaast zijn er nog meer arbeidsvoorwaarden, die we in een persoonlijk gesprek graag stap voor stap met je doornemen. Reageer direct op deze vacature als Field Engineer als dit bij jouw ervaring en wensen past. Je krijgt altijd binnen 1 werkdag een terugkoppeling op je reactie. Neem voor vragen contact op met Luca Stoop via 06 \- 27 52 14 925\.
### **HIER GA JE WERKEN**


Je gaat aan de slag bij een organisatie die geavanceerde automatiseringsoplossingen ontwikkelt en bouwt voor de voedingsindustrie. Met eigen machines en complete productielijnen worden blikken, potten en maaltijdzakken automatisch gehandeld in supermarktomgevingen. De techniek combineert machinebouw, robotica, mechatronica en industriële automatisering en wordt wereldwijd bij klanten geïnstalleerd. Daardoor werk je aan projecten die je later in de supermarkt letterlijk terugziet in het schap, wat het plannen van je boodschappen ineens een stuk technischer maakt.  

  

Je werkt binnen de afdeling Montage samen met andere Field Engineers, assemblagemonteurs, project engineers en software engineers. De sfeer is nuchter en direct, met veel overleg op de werkvloer en korte lijnen tussen kantoor en uitvoering. In de werkplaats heb je goed gereedschap, nette faciliteiten en lekkere koffie, zodat je ook tijdens het afstellen van een complexe lijn niet op automatische piloot hoeft te draaien. Op locatie werk je meestal met vaste collega’s, waarbij de planning vooraf duidelijk wordt afgestemd en je altijd bij ervaren collega’s terechtkunt als een technische uitdaging net even anders blijkt dan op tekening.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.description:
###### **At Suitsupply, we combine radical style with radical technology. We are looking for a Principal Engineer — the most senior hands\-on engineer in the company: you design, you build, and you ship alongside our teams. You set the engineering standard for an entire domain, and you make it stick — in the code, in the pipelines, and in how our teams adopt AI\-native ways of working. Expect a roughly 50/50 split: half your time accelerating projects inside teams, half driving the cross\-cutting standards everyone works to.**


##### **What you will do:**


* **Set the standard:** own the cross\-cutting standards backlog for your domains — unified observability and monitoring, alerting, release and deployment processes, CI/CD templates, and shared packages — and make them binding: non\-compliant code does not merge.
* **Stay in the code:** design, prototype and build on the hardest cross\-team problems — the migrations, integrations and foundations no single team can own.
* **Jump\-start delivery:** parachute into projects that need momentum — run the technical discovery, shape the solution, get the first implementation moving with the team. You accelerate teams.
* **Embed, don't tower:** work inside teams to raise the bar in place, pairing with Tech Leads and Engineering Managers.
* **Enforce through systems:** skills\-per\-repo, PR guardrails and automated checks carry the standard, so it scales without you hand\-reviewing every merge.
* **Make us AI\-native:** drive agentic development as the default way of working, on a drumbeat you set with the Engineering Managers.
* **Cover the gaps:** step into teams without a Tech Lead to keep delivery and quality on track while we hire.
* **Pair at the top:** partner with Engineering Leadership on domain architecture. You set the standard; the Tech Leads spread it.

##### **Who you are:**


* 10\+ years of engineering, with recent staff\- or principal\-level scope at a strong product or tech company.
* You have carried technical responsibility across at least three domains — not one deep silo. This is a hard requirement.
* You have joined an existing ecosystem and changed it — change management in a landscape you didn't build is core to this job; greenfield\-only track records don't clear the bar.
* Hands\-on across the stack and still shipping code weekly; deep in at least one of .NET and Azure event\-driven backends, large\-scale commerce ecosystems, or integration and data platforms.
* You have made standards stick across teams that didn't report to you — through tooling, guardrails and example, not decks.
* Already ahead of us on AI\-assisted and agentic development at enterprise scale — multi\-team, inside an existing ecosystem. We expect to learn this from you, not to teach it to you — and you can show a team or codebase you made measurably faster.
* You explain hard things simply — to engineers, to product, to the board. If you truly know it, you can say it plainly.
* Zero direct reports, by design — and that suits you. Your authority is technical, and on domain standards it is final.

##### **What you will get:**


* Competitive compensation — we benchmark this role against the top of the Dutch tech market, not against retail. A freelance\-first start is possible if that is how you work.
* A real top\-of\-ladder IC seat: final say on domain standards, a direct line to the Head of Engineering and the Director, and no management detour required to keep growing.
* Scale that shows: \~16 product teams, a global Shopify migration, own\-built Custom Made and Radical Personal platforms, and an ERP transition — with the mandate to make it all AI\-native.
* Autonomy without layers of sign\-off
* Hybrid working: three days in the Amsterdam HQ, two remote — flexible in both directions once you're up to speed.
* A 40% discount on Suitsupply product, and a working wardrobe you'll actually want to wear.

Wij bouwen aan de digitale toekomst van Jumbo Supermarkten. Het JAM Team (Captain Yellow) richt zich op de ontwikkeling en doorontwikkeling van JAM (Jumbo Article Management): hét centrale artikelbeheerplatform van Jumbo.

Als SAP Developer in het JAM team ontwikkel, optimaliseert en onderhoudt je de logica en integraties waarmee artikeldata veilig en performant tussen systemen stroomt.

* Meer dan 5 jaar ervaring als SAP\-ontwikkelaar, met onder andere de volgende technologieën: ABAP, CDS, OData, Fiori, Restful ABAP Programming Model (RAP) en SAP BTP.

Een werkplek waar jij je thuis voelt, jezelf kunt zijn én waar we samen werken aan gezamenlijke doelen. Jouw ideeën om klanten, winkels én collega's blij te maken zijn hier meer dan welkom. jobs.title: Business Development Engineer
jobs.description:
At Helm Operations, we build the software that keeps the world’s maritime operations moving. From tugboats in Vancouver Harbour to offshore service vessels in the North Sea, our customers rely on Helm CONNECT to manage their crews, maintenance, compliance, and day\-to\-day operations — and we don’t take that responsibility lightly.

World\-class software doesn’t happen by chance. It takes people who care deeply about quality, take ownership, collaborate effectively, and continually look for better ways to work. That’s The Helm Way, and that’s where you come in.

As Helm continues to grow internationally, Europe is a key part of our next stage of growth. **We’re looking for a Business Development Engineer based in Central Europe or the UK,** with the ability to work within relevant European business hours, who can help us expand our presence across the region by building relationships with maritime operators, uncovering operational challenges, and showing prospective customers how Helm CONNECT can make a meaningful difference in their businesses.

This is not a traditional sales role. You’ll need the curiosity to understand how maritime businesses operate, the technical confidence to have credible conversations about software and workflows, and the commercial drive to turn opportunities into long\-term customer relationships.

You’ll work closely with our Sales, Product, Professional Services, and Marketing teams to identify opportunities, develop the European market, and help more maritime organizations discover a better way to run their operations.

We’re looking for someone who is comfortable creating momentum rather than waiting for it — someone who is naturally curious, commercially minded, technically capable, and hungry to build something in a growing market.

**Your Mission**

Proactively prospect and generate new business opportunities across Europe through outbound outreach (calls, email, LinkedIn, and other channels)

Qualify inbound leads and route sales\-ready prospects to the appropriate Account Executive

Book and support product demonstrations, with a quarterly target of 30 completed demos

Maintain a disciplined outreach cadence, with a benchmark of approximately 10 qualified contacts per demo booked

Research target accounts and personalize outreach to reflect regional market nuances across European sub\-regions (UK, DACH, Nordics, Southern Europe, etc.)

Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of prospecting activity, pipeline status, and account information in the CRM

Collaborate closely with Account Executives to ensure smooth handoff of qualified opportunities and alignment on target accounts

Use AI and sales enablement tools to improve research efficiency, lead enrichment, and outreach personalization at scale

Represent Helm Operations professionally in all prospect\-facing interactions, building credibility and trust from first contact

**What Success Looks Like**

Consistently achieving the quarterly target of 30 completed demos

Generating $1–2 million in annual pipeline once fully ramped (target: incremental $500,000 for the remainder of 2026\)

Building a reliable, repeatable prospecting engine that keeps Account Executives consistently supplied with qualified opportunities

Establishing Helm as a trusted, responsive partner for prospects across the European market

**Qualifications**

Fluent in English (written and spoken)

1–3\+ years of experience in a Business Development, SDR/BDR, or similar outbound sales role, ideally in B2B SaaS

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt messaging across different cultural and market contexts

Comfortable with high\-volume, target\-driven outbound prospecting

Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) and sales engagement platforms

**Bonus points if you have:**

Additional languages such as Spanish, Dutch, German, French, Italian, Portugese

Experience selling into the maritime, shipping, logistics, or industrial/technical B2B markets

Prior experience in a remote, internationally distributed sales team

Familiarity with using AI tools to support prospecting and outreach workflows

**Compensation \& Commission Structure**

Base salary: €45,000 \~ €60,000

**Commission:**

2% on Initial Sale and Professional Services (PS) revenue directly attributable to BDE\-sourced activity, excluding any PS managed by partners

€5 per qualified demo booked and attended

€40 per net\-new sales opportunity created (net\-new only; excludes upsells)

Estimated OTE: \~€57,000 at target performance (30 demos/quarter, 50% demo\-to\-opportunity conversion, 35% company win rate)

**Why You’ll Love Working at Helm**

We live by our core values:

Together We Win  
Collaboration is our superpower. We achieve more by sharing knowledge, supporting one another, and working toward common goals.

Own It  
We take initiative, follow through, and deliver on our commitments.

Care Deeply  
We care about our products, our customers, the quality of our work, and each other.

Enjoy the Ride  
We celebrate wins, learn through challenges, and make space for connection and joy along the way.

Eye of the Tiger  
We bring a healthy hunger for challenge, take proactive action, and embrace opportunities to learn and grow.

Perks and Benefits

* A 100% remote working environment.
* Flexible working hours with overlap during core business hours.
* Base salary of €45,000–€60,000 base \+ commission
* Paid vacation and your birthday off.
* Comprehensive benefits from your first day.
* Fitness reimbursement.
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan eligibility after six months.
* Learning and professional development pathways.
* An inclusive culture with remote\-team activities and events.

The salary offered will depend on the successful candidate’s education, experience, skills, geographical location, and alignment with internal equity and external market considerations. The actual salary may be higher or lower than the range posted.

Total On\-Target Earnings include base salary plus a target performance bonus.

*As part of our commitment to transparency, we use artificial intelligence tools to support certain stages of our recruitment process, which may include résumé screening, candidate matching, interview scheduling, and candidate communications.*

*These tools help us improve efficiency, support consistency, and enhance the candidate experience. All hiring decisions are made by qualified people, and we monitor our processes to support fairness and compliance with applicable requirements.*

Research has shown that women and members of underrepresented groups may be less likely to apply for a role unless they meet every listed qualification.

This posting describes what we are ideally looking for, but we encourage you to apply even when you do not meet every requirement. Everyone brings different strengths and experiences, and we hire for both demonstrated capability and future potential.

Helm is proudly an Equal Opportunity Employer where everyone is welcome.

Each person brings a unique story and perspective, and we believe our diverse mix of minds, backgrounds, identities, and experiences is where our greatest ideas come from.

We welcome people of all races, ethnicities, ages, religions, abilities, genders, gender identities, gender expressions, and sexual orientations. We want everyone to feel able to bring their authentic selves to work, share our values, shape our vision, drive innovation, and contribute to a culture we celebrate every day.

We sincerely thank everyone who applies. Due to the volume of applications received, we will contact candidates whose experience most closely aligns with the requirements of the role.

Make this the place where *you* grow.


* Collaborate closely with delivery teams, business stakeholders, analysts, and developers to understand requirements, define test scope, and ensure quality expectations are met.
* Design, develop, maintain, and execute automated and exploratory tests across Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Power Pages, portal journeys, and Azure\-integrated solutions.
* Build and maintain automation frameworks and test suites using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Spec Flow and programming language as C\#.
* Integrate automated testing into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing, quality gates, and rapid feedback.
* Investigate test failures, manage defects through resolution and retesting, and communicate quality risks, dependencies, and release readiness.
* Contribute to test strategy, engineering standards, automation improvements, quality reporting, and maintenance of test documentation.


We are looking for an Automation Test Engineer who can take a requirement or user story, understand what needs to be tested, and apply the right mix of technical testing, automation and exploratory testing to give the team confidence in the quality of what is being delivered.


You should be comfortable using engineering standards, automation frameworks and CI/CD practices to make testing more efficient and repeatable. You will be expected to communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, contribute to quality planning, and support the resolution of defects in a collaborative Agile delivery environment.


Depth in test automation, Dynamics 365/Power Platform delivery and CI/CD based quality assurance matters more to us than breadth across every testing tool. The right person will be hands\-on, collaborative, quality\-focused and comfortable working in a public sector delivery environment.

  

  

**Must Have**


* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non\-technical teams.
* Proven experience in Agile delivery environments, working closely with Developers, Business Analysts, and Test Engineers.
* Hands\-on test automation experience using tools such as **Selenium, Playwright, Cypress**, or similar, with programming experience in **C\#,**
* Knowledge of **BDD practices** and tools such as **Spec Flow** or **Cucumber**.
* Experience designing, developing, executing, and maintaining automated test suites for enterprise applications, including **Dynamics 365, CRM, or portal\-based solutions**.
* Strong understanding of test design and execution across **functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, integration testing**.
* Experience using **Azure DevOps** for test management, source control, CI/CD pipelines, reporting, and defect tracking.
* Ability to derive test scenarios from requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, while managing test data, environments, dependencies, and defects.
* Self\-sufficient approach to delivering testing activities, producing clear test evidence, reporting outcomes, and supporting release readiness decisions.


**Nice to Have**


* Experience defining test scope, estimating effort, and selecting risk\-based testing approaches.
* Experience building or enhancing automation frameworks and integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines with quality gates.
* Experience with **API and integration testing** using tools such as **Postman, REST frameworks and hands on performance testing using Jmeter or load runner**.
* Understanding of modern engineering practices including branching strategies, pull requests, peer reviews, accessibility testing and continuous quality improvement.
* Experience using GitHub Copilot or other AI\-assisted development/testing tools to improve productivity.
* Certifications such as AWS Cloud Practitioner, SAFe, ISTQB, Microsoft Power Platform or relevant automation/testing certifications.


We offer a range of tailored benefits that support your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing. Our Learning and Development team ensure that there are continuous growth and development opportunities for our people. We also offer the opportunity to have flexible work options.

We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe in the fair treatment of all our employees and commit to promoting equity and diversity in our employment practices. We actively collaborate with individuals who have disabilities and long\-term health conditions which have an effect on their ability to do normal daily activities, ensuring that barriers are eliminated when it comes to employment opportunities. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know. Join us in building a truly diverse and empowered team.


We are delivering Dynamics 365 Customer Service solutions for a public sector client, extended with Power Pages, Power Automate and related Azure components.


The Automation Test Engineer will play an important role in helping the team deliver reliable, well\-tested and maintainable solutions. You will work closely with Developers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, Test Leads and client stakeholders to determine what needs to be tested, how it should be tested, and how test outcomes should be recorded, reported and used to improve quality.


You will take direction from the Test Lead and wider delivery leadership, but you will be expected to work independently on assigned test activities, challenge constructively where appropriate, and bring practical suggestions to improve test coverage, automation quality, continuous feedback and release confidence.

jobs.title: Frontend React Engineer with .NET knowledge
jobs.description:
**Build Next\-Gen Transportation Logistics Tech: Front\-End React Engineer**


Are you ready to build high\-impact production UIs from scratch using modern React, TypeScript, and AI\-augmented tools? Join a modern engineering environment where you will replace a legacy desktop application with a fast, browser\-based React experience, shipping functional software directly to energy dispatchers every single week!

**About Us:**  

Trimble is a global technology company that connects the physical and digital worlds, transforming the ways work gets done. With relentless innovation in precise positioning, modeling and data analytics, Trimble enables essential industries including construction, geospatial and transportation. Whether it's helping customers build and maintain infrastructure, design and construct buildings, optimize global supply chains or map the world, Trimble is at the forefront, driving productivity and progress.

  

Trimble Transportation provides the mobility, enterprise, and visibility tools that move freight across North America. Our TMW Suite TMS platform is the backbone of dispatch operations for energy carriers — managing orders, dispatch, tank readings, pricing, and delivery for bulk fuel and petroleum logistics.

  

Right now, we’re doing something our customers have been waiting for: replacing the legacy Windows desktop application (Suite Dispatch TMS) with a modern, browser\-based experience that dispatchers can access from anywhere. This is a greenfield React build, not a reskin. We’re building the next\-generation TMW Suite Dispatch UI from scratch, shipping 7 screens in 18 months, and going live with real dispatchers on June 1 2027\.

**Here’s what you’d be doing day to day:**  

You’ll be embedded in one of four pair\-squads (2 developers \+ 1 embedded generalist), building production React screens that fuel dispatchers will use to run their daily operations. Each squad owns specific screens end\-to\-end from data service integration through UI polish and Playwright testing. Every Friday, your squad demos working software to stakeholders. No spec theater, no sprint reviews six weeks from now. Weekly demos, weekly accountability, weekly progress.  

The architecture is straightforward: your React UI talks to CloudHub (a tenant\-routing gateway), which dispatches to a per\-tenant OData API, which connects through a CloudHub Connector (CHC) to the customer’s on\-prem SQL database. You’re building a fast, reliable, accessible front\-end that makes fuel dispatchers more efficient.

**Your Key Responsibilities:**

* Build Production React Screens: Own screens end\-to\-end: data service layer, Redux state management, UI components, and Playwright \+ axe\-core tests. Build responsive layouts (1280/1440/1920px) using MUI X DataGrid, Trimble Maps SDK, and the team’s shared design system
* Update and Enhance the Backend Services: Integrate with the CloudHub/OData/CHC API stack, wire up real data from customer SQL databases through the tenant\-routing gateway. Create new services to ensure the new React screens provide the same functionality as the existing Fuel Dispatch on premise application.
* Ship Working Software Weekly: Demo functional, tested features every Friday \- not mockups, not prototypes, not slide decks. Pair with your squad’s embedded generalist on PR reviews, accessibility checks, and test coverage. Maintain CI/CD discipline: main is always deployable, PRs are feature\-scoped, weekly tags cut for demos.
* Solve Real Dispatcher Problems: Build drag\-and\-drop planning interfaces, real\-time map synchronization, threshold\-based alerting, and inline validation engines. Optimize for dispatcher workflows: keyboard navigation, WCAG accessibility, loading skeletons, and error states that tell users what went wrong and what to do next. Performance\-tune data grids for large datasets with server\-side pagination and column virtualization.
* AI\-Augmented Development: Use Cursor and AI coding assistants to accelerate development, generate test scaffolding, and refactor code. Contribute to the team’s shared patterns and component library as the design system evolves.

**Our Tech Stack:**

* the app scaffold React \+ TypeScript \+ Vite
* sortable, filterable, server\-paginated grids MUI X DataGrid
* live truck/station pins, route visualization, bidirectional map\-grid sync Trimble Maps SDK
* shared state across screens (orders, dispatch status, planner sync) Redux Toolkit
* E2E and accessibility testing in CI Playwright \+ axe\-core

 the API layer (tenant routing per\-tenant OData on\-prem connector* SQL) CloudHub / OData / CHC
* authentication via token forwarding Trimble Identity SSO
* daily development tooling, not optional Cursor / AI assistants
* source control and CI/CD GitHub \+ GitHub Actions

**Your Essential Skills \& Experience:**

* 3\+ years building production React applications with TypeScript — not tutorials, not side projects, production apps that real users depend on
* Strong component architecture: you think in composable, testable components with clean prop contracts and proper state management
* Experience with data\-heavy UIs: grids, tables, filters, server\-side pagination, real\-time updates
* Comfort with REST/OData API integration — you’ve wired up front\-ends to real backends and debugged the full request/response chain
* CSS/styling proficiency: responsive layouts, design system integration, consistent cross\-browser rendering
* Git workflow fluency: trunk\-based development, feature branches, clean commit history, PR reviews
* Ability to work in a pair\-squad model — tight collaboration with one other developer and an embedded generalist, shipping weekly

**Bonus Points for:**

* Drag\-and\-drop implementation experience (dnd\-kit, react\-beautiful\-dnd, or similar)
* Experience with AI coding assistants Cursor in daily development workflows
* Familiarity with MUI (Material UI) component library and theming
* Previous experience modernizing legacy desktop applications into browser\-based UIs
* Background in .NET/C\# OData APIs (helpful for debugging the API layer)
* Logistics, transportation, or energy industry domain knowledge you understand what a dispatcher does and why their screen matters

  

Location: UK, Remote

**Why You'll Enjoy Working With Us:**

* At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real\-World Impact.
* We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
* You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose\-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide. Our impact is tangible, from connected machines that save fuel to data\-driven insights that reduce waste.
* Collaborate with like\-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging. We're a company of "visionary pragmatists" who think boldly and build things that work.
* Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self\-authored," empowering proactive "doers."

  

React, TypeScript, Front\-End Engineer, Software Developer, Redux, Material UI, Playwright, Greenfield, Transportation, Logistics

 **How to Apply:** Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

**Join a Values\-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.**


At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

jobs.title: Security Engineer II, Traffic Quality, Traffic Quality
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Advertising at Amazon is a fast\-growing, multi\-billion dollar business that spans across desktop, mobile and connected devices; encompasses ads on Amazon and a vast network of hundreds of thousands of third party publishers; and extends worldwide. Traffic Quality, within Amazon Advertising, builds technology to detect invalid traffic (IVT) and ensure that Advertiser spend worldwide is directed towards human audiences and protected from ad fraud.  

  

As the Security engineering team within Traffic Quality, we research programmatic advertising risk landscapes to build an understanding of existing and emergent threats. We build specialized techniques to detect and mitigate these threats, contributing to a robust Traffic Quality platform that is a bedrock of advertiser trust and saves hundreds of millions of dollars in ad spend that would otherwise be lost to IVT. The Security Engineering team is responsible for: (a) Targeted threat hunting, including on the dark web, to consistently stay updated on modus operandi and risks associated with advertising fraud, (b) Building sophisticated mitigation techniques through reverse engineering known software, identifying network layer signatures, and conceiving client\-side scripting methods, and, (c) Collaborating with security teams across Amazon for sharing intelligence and devising durable detection techniques.  

  

As a Security Engineer in the team, you are passionate about unraveling ad fraud tactics utilizing a diversity of highly specialized skills in reverse\-engineering, deep packet inspection of network traffic, understanding of network security, operating systems and browser architectures. You accomplish your tasks by applying expert level knowledge to tools to understand not only what a particular piece of malware for perpetrating ad fraud can do but also how it does it. You work with internal security teams to identify and mitigate botnets, as well as leverage the ethical hacking community to obtain standard modus operandi, source code and tactics used by malware and botnets. The role requires influencing leaders across the company to improve our security bar and protect advertiser trust. A Security Engineer also works with other product and security teams to proactively identify problems and suggest approaches to solve them.  

  

Given the high level of ambiguity in the advertising fraud space, and the need to prepare for unknown unknowns, your creativity, judgement and bias for action will all be key ingredients towards delivering the right results for advertising customers.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP, DNS and TCP/IP
* Experience programming in Python, Ruby, Go, Swift, Java, .Net, C\+\+ or similar object oriented language
* You have passion for reverse engineering, malware analysis, threat detection and risk hunting.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS products and services
* Experience with any combination of the following: threat modeling, secure coding, identity management and authentication, software development, cryptography, system administration and network security

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: 2027 Software Engineer Program - Full-time - Dublin
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Join our 2027 Software Engineer Program in Dublin (September start) and propel your career to new heights with a team of innovative technologists. Engage in diverse projects, gain new skills, and create positive change for the communities we serve. We value your unique skills and innovative ideas within our supportive and diverse technology organization. Ready to tackle big challenges with a global technology team? We're eager to meet you.


**About the Program**




As a Software Engineer in the Software Engineer Program (SEP) at JPMorganChase, you will embark on a global two\-year career development journey. This program is designed to equip you with essential technical and professional skills, enabling you to build strong networks and establish a successful career with us. You will have opportunities for job growth, accelerated career advancement, and career mobility. Our program begins with an in\-depth induction that introduces you to our businesses, enhances your understanding of development methodologies, and sharpens your professional skills. You will dive head\-first into creating innovative solutions that make a difference for our customers, clients, and employees.


We will be filling our classes on a rolling basis. We strongly encourage you to submit your application as early as possible before job postings close.


**Job Responsibilities**


* Execute basic software solution, design, development, and technical troubleshooting
* Write secure and high\-quality code using the syntax of at least one programming language with peer guidance
* Interpret architecture and design representations as well as nonfunctional requirements to develop secure, stable software against a defined architecture
* Apply automation to reduce manual toil in the Software Development Life Cycle
* Gather, analyze, and synthesize basic data sets to troubleshoot technical issues and generate insights for continuous improvements.
* Breaks down routine technical tasks to troubleshoot and solve issues
* Work and share ideas, information and innovation with our team of technologists from all over the world.
* Participate in our Force for Good program to build real\-world sustainable technology solutions for social good organizations.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Pursuing a Bachelors or Master's degree with expected graduation year of 2027
* You should be available to start full time employment in September 2027
* A well\-rounded academic background
* Baseline knowledge of software, applications and technical processes within a given technical discipline (e.g., cloud, artificial intelligence, machine learning, mobile, etc.)
* Ability to work effectively in large, collaborative teams to achieve organizational goals, with a commitment to fostering an inclusive and innovative culture
* Foundational knowledge of programming languages (e.g., React,Python, JavaScript, Java, C\+\+, C\#), databases, data structures and algorithms
* Understanding of software skills including business analysis, development, maintenance, and software improvement
* Proficiency in developmental toolsets
* Basic knowledge of industry\-wide technology trends and best practices
* Exposure to agile methodologies, including CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**


* Computer Science and/or Engineering majors are preferred
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment
* Exceptional problem\-solving ability
* Exposure to cloud technologies
* Experience with relational databases

**About Us**




When you work at JPMorganChase, you're part of a global financial institution and a leading tech company. Our team of over 63,000 technologists across global technology centers is dedicated to designing, building, deploying, and managing a wide range of solutions, including enterprise technology initiatives, big data, mobile solutions, electronic payments, cybersecurity, machine learning, and cloud development. If you're ready to put your passion for technology to work in a way that makes a real difference, you'll find your place in our Software Engineer Program.

After you confirm your application, we will review it to determine whether you meet certain required qualifications. If you are advanced to the next step of the process, you'll receive an email invitation to complete a coding challenge powered by HackerRank.


HackerRank is required, and your application will not be considered for further review until you have completed this step. We strongly encourage that you apply and complete these required elements as soon as possible, since programs will close as positions are filled.

Software Engineer I

	+ Operating Systems architecture and platforms

What is the impact you want to make?


Unleash your biggest strengths, apply skills \& knowledge, learn new things, connect with your peers and build your career with us!


Why rinf.tech?


\#EngineerOfTheFuture, \#PeopleofManyTalents

* At rinf.tech, you’ll encounter friendly people who are eager to explore and reinvent the world of technology.
* We encourage ideas \- we like to share and learn from each other. We’re all in for curious \& ambitious people.

\#GrowOpportunities

* Our Technical Management team, possesses a robust technical background. Many of our team members have advanced to strategic roles through internal promotions.

\#EngineeringExcellence

* Fail fast, learn fast: we experiment, we iterate, we know when to stop and we don't repeat the same mistakes.
* The right technology stack for the right problem: we don't force technology choices just because we know them; our focus is on solving problems, not on pushing predefined stacks.

\#Innovation

* Adapta Robotics is a successful spin\-off born through an R\&D project within rinf.tech www.adaptarobotics.com/

Why do we do what we do?


We inspire one another to share our tech\-works in this amazing and abundant world. So we became developers, innovators, thinkers, software builders, and hardware makers!


Our Vision!


Founded in 2006 with 650\+ engineers \& global presence (8 delivery centers in Europe \& North America) we strive to become a leading East\-European technology partner for growing organizations in need of digital transformation of their products and services!


What you’ll do

* Current\-State Architecture \& Discovery
* Lead discovery across SAP and non\-SAP source systems, archival interfaces, processing/abstraction layers, repositories, physical storage and retrieval paths.
* Treat existing diagrams as a starting hypothesis; validate the as\-built landscape through SMEs, vendors, configurations and operational evidence.
* Maintain a clear view of confirmed facts, assumptions, unknowns, legacy dependencies and transition components.
* Data, Repository \& Dependency Mapping
* Define where document binaries, metadata, indexes and business references reside and how they are linked across platforms.
* Map major archive populations by repository, technology, age/date range, country/business area, usage status, retention constraints and retrieval dependency.
* Identify critical dependencies between SAP/non\-SAP producers, ArchiveLink or custom integrations, middleware, FileNet/PBS/Centera/Dell EMC and future GCP WORM storage.
* Ownership \& Multi\-Vendor Governance
* Create the technical ownership/RACI model covering business owner, data owner, application owner, operations, infrastructure, storage, legal/compliance and vendor responsibilities.
* Expose ownership gaps, duplicated responsibilities, vendor lock\-in and key\-person dependencies across internal teams and external providers.
* Act as the end\-to\-end technical coordination point where no single vendor owns the whole archival service.
* Risk, Stabilization \& Architecture Decisions
* Identify architectural risks: unsupported technology, undocumented integrations, hidden point\-to\-point links, repository duplication, weak monitoring, unclear recovery and fragile metadata/reference chains.
* Prioritize stabilization needs by business impact, compliance impact, likelihood and remediation complexity.
* Drive architecture decision records and ensure technical recommendations are evidence\-based and feasible.
* Target \& Transitional Architecture
* Define the target archival service across SAP/non\-SAP ingestion, archival interfaces, metadata/reference management, immutable storage, retrieval, monitoring, security and resilience.
* Design a realistic transition architecture for coexistence between legacy repositories and GCP WORM, including read\-only legacy scenarios and staged migration.
* Avoid a storage\-only transformation; ensure the target covers the complete archive lifecycle and preserves retrievability and auditability.
* onsolidation, Migration \& Business Case
* Determine which components/data populations should be retained, migrated, consolidated, modernized, made read\-only or decommissioned.
* Define migration principles and sequencing based on legal retention, dependency, risk, volume, cost and business criticality.
* Provide architecture input to the business case covering cloud/storage, licensing, vendor support, dual\-running, migration effort and decommissioning opportunity.

What you need to be successful

* Senior Enterprise Architect with strong experience in complex legacy integration, data/ECM landscapes, cloud modernization and multi\-vendor transformation.
* Strong understanding of SAP integration and enterprise archival/content\-management concepts; experience with ArchiveLink, FileNet, PBS/Centera, Dell EMC or GCP is highly desirable.
* Able to work with incomplete/contradictory information, challenge vendor assumptions and translate technical findings into governance, roadmap and investment decisions.
* Strong stakeholder management across application, infrastructure, storage, legal/compliance, country teams and external providers.

What we offer you to be successful

* Flexible working environment, ability to work remotely or in a hybrid model, depending on your project requirements.
* Work with worldwide technology leaders \- We partner and deliver technology to industry giants like Intel, NXP, Panasonic, Visteon, Carrefour, Windriver, Kardex, METRO Digital, and many others.
* Priority Plus Medical Subscription @Regina Maria (fully covered by the company)

jobs.title: Senior Software Architect
jobs.description:
**Overview**  

The Microsoft Device Ecosystem Platform (MDEP) team is building a device operating system platform that supports a broad ecosystem of devices, experiences, and cloud\-connected services.


We are seeking a **Senior Software Architect** to define the technical architecture and long\-term direction of MDEP across the full device platform stack. This role extends beyond expertise in any single operating system or technology. The architect will shape how modern device operating systems are designed, secured, serviced, extended, and connected to cloud services at scale.


We are looking for candidates that bring backgrounds in one of the following areas: embedded, device operating systems, open\-source platforms, distributed systems, Microsoft Azure, or cloud services, which combines deep expertise in several areas with the architectural breadth to work effectively across the rest of the stack.


This role offers the opportunity to shape MDEP as an end\-to\-end device OS platform—from the operating system and hardware boundary through platform services, application frameworks, security, manageability, developer experiences, and cloud integration.


Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Define and evolve the long\-term architecture of the MDEP device OS platform.
* Drive architectural decisions across the operating system, platform services, device capabilities, security, manageability, application platform, and cloud\-connected experiences.
* Apply systems thinking across kernel and OS fundamentals, hardware abstraction, system services, application frameworks, networking, identity, security, device management, telemetry, and cloud services.
* Translate architectural direction into practical designs that engineering teams can implement, operate, service, and evolve.

jobs.title: IT Domain Architect
jobs.description:
Beschrijving van de vacature
  
  

Vol energie aan de slag bij een Belgische hoofdrolspeler in het energielandschap!
  
  

Het Belgische en Europese energielandschap zijn volop in beweging. Wist je dat Elia België hierbij een cruciale rol speelt?
  
  

Als onderdeel van de Elia groep, een Europese transmissienetbeheerder, verzekert Elia België de betrouwbaarheid en duurzaamheid van de elektriciteitsbevoorrading in ons land.
  
  

Bij ons bouw je samen met andere talentvolle collega’s aan een duurzame, groene en betrouwbare energie\-infrastructuur die economische groei stimuleert en onze ecologische voetafdruk verkleint.
  
  

Samen gaan we voor maximale impact! We geloven in de kracht van diversiteit: we zijn ervan overtuigd dat een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving leidt tot meer innovatie, creativiteit en betere resultaten.
  
  

IT Domain Architect
  
**Vacature ID:** 11490
  
**Startdatum publicatie:** 10\-09\-2026
  
  

Functiebeschrijving
  
  

Sluit je aan bij Elia Group als Application \& Technical Architect en help de digitale ruggengraat van Europa's energie\-infrastructuur vormgeven.
  
  

In deze functie met grote impact stuur je de evolutie van het Asset IT\-landschap aan, waarbij je ervoor zorgt dat het veilig, schaalbaar en klaar voor de toekomst is en zo de kritieke werking van het net ondersteunt. Je treedt op als een betrouwbare adviseur en hands\-on architect en slaat de brug tussen business en technologie. Je vertaalt strategische assetbeheerdoelen in robuuste, innovatieve IT\-oplossingen die een betrouwbare en duurzame energielevering mogelijk maken.
  
  

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden
  
  

Je vertaalt bedrijfsstrategie naar bruikbare IT\-roadmaps en architectuurblauwdrukken.
  
Je werkt architectuurprincipes, \-standaarden en \-ontwerpbeslissingen uit en stuurt ze aan.
  
Je stelt architectuuroplossingen voor in governancefora en verdedigt ze.
  
Je zorgt ervoor dat de IT\-oplossingen doorheen hun volledige levenscyclus consistent, kwalitatief en duurzaam zijn.
  
Je beheert en optimaliseert de assetapplicatie\- en productportfolio.
  
Je ziet mogelijkheden voor vereenvoudiging, hergebruik en kostenefficiëntie.
  
Je ondersteunt oplossingsarchitecten bij de afstemming van de oplevering op de domeinstrategie.
  
Je voert trade\-off\-analyses uit als leidraad voor strategische en investeringsbeslissingen.
  
Je ontwikkelt toekomstgerichte domeinroadmaps die afgestemd zijn op de evoluties in de sector.
  
Je zorgt voor naleving van de vereisten op het vlak van data, integratie, beveiliging en regelgeving
  
Jouw profiel
  
  

Masterdiploma in IT, computerwetenschappen of een aanverwante studierichting
  
Minimaal 10 jaar relevante ervaring in IT, waaronder minimaal 5 jaar in IT\-architectuur
  
Diepgaande kennis van TOGAF, ArchiMate, Gartner TIME, 6R framework en architectuurmodellering
  
Hands\-on ervaring met domain\-driven design en agile methodes
  
Ervaring met Sparx Enterprise Architect is een pluspunt
  
Sterke communicator met het vermogen om business\- en technische stakeholders te betrekken en te beïnvloeden
  
Strategisch denkvermogen met een nadruk op schaalbaarheid, veerkracht en waarde op lange termijn
  
Coöperatieve leider die kan werken met architectuur\- en opleveringsteams
  
Je voelt je thuis in het aansturen van beslissingen binnen governancekaders.
  
Sterke analytische mindset met ervaring in architectuurbeoordelingen
  
Achtergrond in energie, nutsbedrijven of assetintensieve omgevingen is een grote troef.
  
Je spreekt vloeiend Engels; kennis van Frans, Nederlands en/of Duits is een pluspunt.
  
Aanbod
  
**Salaris:** Competitief loonpakket, representatievergoeding, eindejaarspremie, dubbel vakantiegeld, maaltijdcheques (€10 per werkdag), ecocheques, sport \& cultuur cheques, bonussen op basis van individuele en collectieve resultaten.
  
**Verzekering:** Groepsverzekering, hospitalisatieverzekering, verzekering voor ambulante zorgen voor het gezin alsook een ongevallenverzekering privéleven.
  
**Vakantie:** Je hebt recht op 20 verlofdagen en 5 compensatieverlofdagen, 6 lokale dagen, 4 kaderdagen (na 1 jaar in dienst) en tot maximum 5 anciënniteitsdagen (1 dag per 3 jaar in dienst).
  
**Sociaal fonds:** Eindejaarcheques, premie voor geboorte of huwelijk, en bij de aanschaf van een bril, gebitsprothese of andere soortgelijke behoeften vergoeden we een deel van de kosten.
  
**Communicatie:** Je ontvangt een iPhone met abonnement (ook voor privégebruik), terugbetaling internet en laptop.
  
**Kortingen:** Je geniet 30% korting op je gas\- en elektriciteitsrekening.
  
**Mobiliteit:** We bieden je een bedrijfswagen en openbaar vervoer of mobiliteitsbudget
  
**Elia aandelen:** Elia biedt je de mogelijkheid om in te schrijven op aandelen met een korting van 16\.66% op de gemiddelde koers van het aandeel.
  
Locatie
  
  

Emperor, Brussel (vlakbij Brussel\-Centraal) \+ thuiswerk
  
  

Occasionele reizen naar Berlijn, Duitsland.
  
  

Met het volgende jobaanbod hangt er elektriciteit in de lucht!
  
  

In ruil voor je werk en toewijding geniet je van de volgende voordelen:
  
  

**Een job vol variatie bij een topwerkgever :** Elia moedigt innovatie en samenwerking aan. Binnen onze onderneming loop je voorop in de energietransitie en werk je mee aan baanbrekende technologieën om deze transitie te versnellen. Een unieke kans om jouw kennis en vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen.
  
**Focus op persoonlijke groei en welzijn op het werk :** ontdek een breed gamma van professionele opleidings\- en begeleidingsmogelijkheden waarmee je jouw persoonlijke groei een stevige boost geeft. Tegelijk zetten we als topwerkgever maximaal in op een positieve werkcultuur waarin jouw welzijn centraal staat.
  
**Ontwikkelingskansen voor een uitdagende loopbaan :** Bij Elia moedigen we jou aan om nieuwe professionele kansen te ontdekken en te grijpen. Je hebt de vrijheid om jouw loopbaan vorm te geven.
  
**Een divers team van gepassioneerde collega’s :** Elia hecht veel belang aan diversiteit en inclusie. Je komt terecht in een divers en gedreven team dat graag kennis deelt en samen de weg leidt naar een duurzamere toekomst.
  
  

Dit is slechts een greep uit het aanbod dat Elia tot een Top Employer maakt. We zijn ervan overtuigd dat jouw bijdrage aan ons team van goudwaarde zal zijn en kijken ernaar uit om je binnenkort te verwelkomen!
