jobs.title: Real Time EMS & SCADA Engineer
jobs.description:
Description de poste
  
  

Un travail énergisant chez un acteur belge majeur du paysage énergétique !
  
  

Le paysage énergétique belge et européen est en pleine transformation. Saviez\-vous qu’Elia en Belgique joue un rôle crucial dans ce processus ?
  
  

En tant que membre du groupe Elia, un gestionnaire de réseau de transport européen, Elia garantit la fiabilité et la durabilité de l’approvisionnement électrique dans notre pays.
  
  

Chez nous, vous contribuez avec d'autres collègues talentueux à construire une infrastructure énergétique durable, verte et fiable qui stimule la croissance économique et réduit notre empreinte écologique.
  
  

Ensemble, nous visons un impact maximal ! Nous croyons dans la force de la diversité : nous sommes convaincus qu’un environnement de travail inclusif et diversifié conduit à plus d’innovation et de créativité ainsi qu’à de meilleurs résultats.
  
  

Real Time EMS \& SCADA Engineer
  
**Identifiant de la demande:** 11251
  
**Date de début de publication:** 04/09/2026
  
  

Description de fonction
  
  

Le département IT Energy Market and Real Time Applications \& Projects est responsable du déploiement et de la maintenance à long terme des outils IT pour les processus opérationnels d’Elia. Cela comprend la gestion informatisée en temps réel du système de supervision et de contrôle du réseau électrique (EMS/SCADA), les outils garantissant la sécurité d’approvisionnement, ceux facilitant les transactions sur les différents marchés de l’énergie et les échanges de données avec les acteurs de marché.
  
  

Ce rôle s’inscrit également dans la stratégie de digitalisation d’Elia Group. Le/la Real Time EMS \& SCADA Engineer est impliqué·e dans divers projets de mise à jour et d’échange d’informations, en partenariat avec d’autres entités au sein d’Elia en Belgique et l’entité allemande 50Hertz.
  
  

Nous sommes à la recherche d’une perle rare pour rejoindre notre équipe dès que possible en tant que Real Time EMS \& SCADA Engineer , responsable du déploiement complet des projets IT et de leur support opérationnel au sein de ce département.
  
  

**Vos tâches principales seront les suivantes :**  

Faire office d’expert·e fonctionnel·le et technique pour nos solutions SCADA et EMS (y compris un support pour les composants).
  
Collaborer avec le business pour établir des priorités dans vos projets et activités opérationnelles.
  
Coopérer et vous synchroniser avec les projets IT en amont ou en aval des vôtres, en vue de gérer les contraintes de planning et de créer des synergies entre les projets.
  
Tester les exigences fournies par le business avant leur approbation.
  
Valider et vérifier les spécifications établies par le business et, en cas de logiciel développé au sein d’Elia, les traduire en design fonctionnel et technique basé sur les technologies Microsoft (.NET).
  
Interagir avec une équipe de Developers internes et/ou externes et avec le/la .NET Technical Manager, et surveiller de près les projets impliquant des logiciels achetés ou développés en externe.
  
Valider et tester la stratégie de gestion de la qualité, et la contrôler lors du déploiement.
  
Superviser les releases.
  
Offrir un support aux utilisateur·rice·s finaux·ales (deuxième ligne).
  
Organiser et prioriser la maintenance des solutions développées.
  
Votre profil
  
  

Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme de master avec une spécialisation en IT et/ou en électricité.
  
Vous avez au moins 3 années d’expérience pertinente.
  
Vous avez de l’expérience dans les contextes en temps réel du secteur de l’énergie (SCADA, EMS, contraintes en temps réel liées à la disponibilité, etc.).
  
Vous avez de l’expérience en protocoles et standards en temps réel comme ICCP, IEC104, CGMES, etc.
  
Vous êtes capable de communiquer facilement avec les Developers et équipes techniques (par ex. IT Infrastructure) sur des sujets techniques, mais aussi avec les Operators sur des sujets techniques et de design.
  
Vous avez de préférence des connaissances et une expérience dans le secteur de l’électricité et/ou de l’énergie.
  
Vous avez le sens de l’analyse et le souci du détail, conjugués à de solides compétences organisationnelles.
  
Vous êtes orienté·e client, et capable de travailler tant en autonomie qu’en équipe.
  
Vous parlez couramment l’ anglais , et vous avez une bonne connaissance du néerlandais et/ou du français .
  
Vous êtes disposé·e à voyager occasionnellement à l’étranger dans le cadre de projets.
  
Offre
  
  

**Salaire:** Package salarial compétitif, indemnité de représentation, prime de fin d'année, double pécule de vacances, chèques\-repas (€10 par jour de travail), écochèques, chèques sport et culture, bonus sur la base des résultats individuels et collectifs.
  
**Assurance :** Assurance groupe, hospitalisation, soins ambulatoires pour la famille ainsi qu'accidents vie privée.
  
**Vacances:** Vous avez droit à 20 jours de congé, 5 jours de repos compensatoires, 6 jours locaux, 4 jours cadres (après 1 année de service) et jusqu’à maximum 5 jours d’ancienneté (1 jour par 3 années de service).
  
**Fonds social:** Chèques de fin d’année, prime de naissance et de mariage, et intervention en partie dans les dépenses liées à des lunettes, une prothèse dentaire ou d’autres besoins similaires.
  
**Communication:** Vous recevez un iPhone avec abonnement (aussi pour usage privé) ainsi que le remboursement de votre abonnement internet et un ordinateur portable.
  
**Réductions:** Vous bénéficiez d’une réduction de 30 % sur votre facture de gaz et d'électricité.
  
**Mobilité:** Nous vous proposons une voiture de société et un abonnement aux transports en commun ou un budget mobilité.
  
**Actions Elia:** Elia vous offre la possibilité de souscrire à des actions avec une réduction de 16,66% sur le cours moyen de l’action.
  
Lieu de travail
  
  

Schaerbeek – Avenue de Vilvorde 126 (non loin de la gare de Schaerbeek)
  
Mode de travail hybride (présentiel et télétravail).
  
  

Avec l’offre d’emploi suivante, nous sommes sûrs que le courant va passer entre nous !
  
  

En échange de votre travail et de votre dévouement en tant, vous profitez des avantages suivants :
  
  

**Un job varié chez un Top Employer :** Elia encourage l’innovation et la collaboration. Au sein de notre entreprise, vous ouvrez la voie dans la transition énergétique et travaillez à des technologies novatrices en vue d'accélérer cette transition. Une chance unique de développer vos connaissances et vos compétences.
  
Focus sur la croissance personnelle et le bien\-être au travail : découvrez un vaste éventail de possibilités de formation et de coaching grâce auxquelles vous pouvez donner un sérieux coup de boost à votre croissance personnelle. De plus, en tant que Top Employer, nous misons pleinement sur une culture de travail positive centrée sur votre bien\-être.
  
**Possibilités de développement pour une carrière passionnante :** chez Elia, nous vous encourageons à découvrir et saisir de nouvelles opportunités professionnelles. Vous avez la liberté de donner forme à votre carrière.
  
**Une équipe diversifiée de collègues passionnés :** Elia accorde beaucoup d'importance à la diversité et à l’inclusion. Vous rejoignez une équipe diversifiée et motivée qui aime partager ses connaissances et ouvre la voie vers un futur plus durable.
  
  

Ce n’est qu’un aperçu de l’offre qui fait d’Elia un Top Employer. Nous sommes convaincus que votre apport à notre équipe vaudra son pesant d’or et avons hâte de vous accueillir prochainement !

En tu subdominio de tribu junto con la persona responsable del Área IT:


* Ejecutar la estrategia del CIO.
* Propiedad integral de producto: la persona Engineering Manager, dentro de su dominio y en colaboración con las principales personas interesadas, impulsa la entrega de producto.
* Eficiencia: centrarse en la evolución del producto y en la eficiencia operativa para lograr un entorno tecnológico más saludable y sostenible.
* Networking: colaborar estrechamente con otras personas líderes de capítulos dentro y fuera de la tribu e identificar sinergias con otras tribus.
* Garantizar un capítulo altamente cualificado y motivado que comparta conocimiento y lecciones aprendidas.
* Garantizar una cultura segura, abierta, experimental, colaborativa y de aprendizaje continuo.
* Ayudar a mejorar nuestras prácticas de ingeniería.
* Ser responsable de la agenda de transformación aplicable a los activos del subdominio.
* Ser responsable de mantener la alineación con los estándares del grupo.
* Ser responsable de garantizar los niveles de servicio requeridos en todos los entornos para los activos bajo su responsabilidad.

¿Qué estamos buscando?


Trayectoria demostrada y habilidades técnicas


Imprescindible:


* Titulación en Ingeniería y un mínimo de 10 años de experiencia.
* La proactividad es imprescindible; esperamos una persona LÍDER.
* Habilidades de arquitectura.
* Experiencia en proyectos de datos basados en tecnologías de nube pública.
* Sólidos conocimientos y experiencia de desarrollo en nube pública (Azure o GCP).
* Valorable experiencia en proyectos de migración de datos a la nube.
* Experiencia en procesos de adopción de IA.
* Experiencia en desarrollo de IA sobre nube pública.
* Pasión por la tecnología.
* Fuertes capacidades analíticas, de gestión de personas y de comunicación.
* Habilidades de negociación.
* Amplia red de contactos dentro del banco.
* Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma y tomar la iniciativa.
* Mentalidad de mejora continua, buscando mejores soluciones y cuestionando el propósito de las cosas que hacemos.
* Gusto por colaborar con diferentes personas.
* Capacidad de hacer que las cosas sucedan y actitud de “sí se puede”.
* Cultura DevOps y Agile.

Deseable:


* Preferiblemente experiencia de gestión dentro de una organización ágil y motivación para seguir desarrollándose en este ámbito.
* No tener reparos en escalar problemas dentro del Grupo Internacional.

¿Qué ofrecemos?


El tiempo que pasas en el trabajo, los retos a los que te enfrentas o los aprendizajes que adquieres son muy importantes, pero… ¿qué ocurre con tu vida personal? En ING queremos que tu trabajo te satisfaga en todos los sentidos y, por eso, cuidamos hasta el más mínimo detalle.


¡Descubre todo lo que te espera!


Sé flexible, amiga/o.


Nuestro modelo se basa en la flexibilidad y la responsabilidad. Teniendo en cuenta las necesidades tanto de nuestra clientela como de nuestras personas empleadas, decidirás conjuntamente qué días trabajas desde casa y qué días vienes a **ING MAD** para dar lo mejor de ti. Hazlo a tu manera.


Tarjeta restaurante.


Para que pensar qué comer no ocupe tu tiempo ni tus antojos.


Nuestra casa será tu casa.


En nuestras oficinas encontrarás soluciones de movilidad eléctrica, servicio médico, peluquería, gimnasio, The Good Service (para ayudarte con tus gestiones) y mucho más.


Seguro de salud.


Para ti y toda tu familia (cónyuge/pareja e hijos/as).


Seguro de vida.


Te ayudamos a proteger lo que más te importa.


Retribución flexible.


Además, disfrutarás de nuestro modelo de retribución flexible. De una manera fiscalmente más ventajosa, podrás acceder a otros servicios como guardería, tarjeta de transporte, ayudas para formación…


Servicio gratuito de lanzadera de empresa.


No importa dónde vivas. Disponemos de 6 rutas (Norte, Centro, Sur, A5, A42 y A6\) para llevarte cómodamente a nuestra oficina de ING en Madrid.


Beneficios bancarios.


* Préstamos especiales con condiciones más ventajosas.
* Condiciones especiales de hipoteca después de 6 meses trabajando en el banco.
* ¡Y podrás beneficiarte de nuestro plan de pensiones después de solo 1 mes con nosotras/os!

Más vitalidad y más sentimiento de pertenencia.


* Atención integral 360º a la persona empleada (bienestar físico, mental, conexión social y propósito).
* Servicio de fisioterapia en las instalaciones.
* Clínicas con deportistas profesionales de nivel mundial.
* Servicio Gympass.
* Redes de personas empleadas: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI\+), Leonas y RIÑG.
* Programa internacional de trabajo remoto.

Conócenos


Somos un equipo de más de 1\.700 personas que comparten una misma idea: aportar nuestro granito de arena para ayudar a nuestra clientela a construir un futuro mejor, proporcionándoles las herramientas necesarias para llegar donde quieren estar.


Un banco totalmente online donde la tecnología, la innovación, la simplicidad y la transparencia son los ingredientes principales, y el primero en trabajar con metodologías ágiles.


Y aunque estamos ubicadas/os en España, tenemos la suerte de formar parte de un banco internacional con presencia en más de 40 países.


Estamos orgullosas/os de contar con un equipo diverso y nos comprometemos a seguir desarrollando una cultura de Diversidad, Inclusión y Pertenencia que fomente la colaboración y la innovación, representando a todos los colectivos de la sociedad.


Y aunque por fuera parezcamos naranjas, por dentro somos verdes. Nuestra ambición en sostenibilidad es impulsar tu viaje y el nuestro hacia la sostenibilidad. Estamos recorriendo nuestro propio camino, pero también estaremos al lado de nuestra clientela cuando decida emprender el suyo.


Hacer que las cosas sucedan, ayudar a otras personas a tener éxito y estar siempre un paso por delante: ese es nuestro ADN. Si te miras al espejo y tu reflejo coincide con nuestra forma de ser y trabajar… ¡estamos deseando conocerte!

jobs.title: Product Manager - Integrations & API
jobs.description:
**Make a measurable and mission\-critical impact.**

  

**Join us** **on the**  

**Product Management** **team** **as a** **Product Manager – Integrations \&** **API’s**, and help shape the future of safer, more efficient, and more reliable operations across the globe.  

**Start your journey with Anova today****!**

 **Role Summary:**



The Product Manager owns a significant product domain within Anova Unify — from multi\-year strategy through to execution, adoption, and business outcomes. You set the vision for your area, build conviction through deep customer and market insight, and drive delivery in close partnership with engineering and design. You operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence roadmap direction across the broader product organization, and are a go\-to thought partner for senior leadership.



This role's center of gravity is outcomes — customer value realized, revenue retained and grown, and platform capability that compounds over time. You're as comfortable in a customer conversation as you are in a data model discussion or a board\-level briefing. You mentor more junior PMs and raise the bar for how the team thinks about product quality, discovery rigor, and measurable impact.

  

**Where you’ll work:**

  


This is a hybrid role based out of our Porto office. In practice, most of your work can be done remotely, with occasional in\-office time in Porto for team collaboration — a flexibility our team consistently tell us they value.

  

**Job Duties and Responsibilities:**


* Lead deep customer discovery. Design and run ongoing discovery programs — interviews, site visits, usage analysis, win/loss reviews. Develop a differentiated point of view on what customers need, what they'll pay for, and what will create durable competitive advantage.
* Own the go\-to\-market. Define pricing and positioning for your area in partnership with Marketing and Sales leadership. Enable the field with competitive intelligence, winning narratives, and objection handling.
* Set domain strategy. Define the multi\-year product vision for your area. Ground it in customer insight, competitive dynamics, and Anova's strategic priorities. Build and maintain the roadmap with clear outcome targets.
* Drive AI\-first product thinking. Identify where ML and AI (forecasting, anomaly detection, decision support, workflow automation) create meaningful customer value in your domain. Build a clear point of view on what to build, what to buy, and what to partner for — and move it from idea to shipped capability.
* Partner with engineering on architecture and trade\-offs. Engage credibly on system design, API contracts, data models, and integration architecture. Make principled trade\-offs between scope, speed, and technical quality — and document your reasoning.
* Reason across the full stack. Understand how Anova's physical devices, connectivity layer, and cloud platform interact — and make product decisions that account for hardware constraints, firmware cycles, and sensor data quality, not just software capabilities.
* Shape the customer success motion. Codify what success looks like for customers in your domain. Influence the playbooks, onboarding milestones, health scoring, and AI\-assisted scale programs that Customer Success runs.
* Mentor and develop PMs. Coach junior and mid\-level PMs on discovery methods, spec quality, prioritization discipline, and stakeholder communication. Model the standard for written PM artifacts across the team.
* Enable adoption. With each release, ensure the team is ready to help customers get value from what you've shipped.
  


**Outcomes you'll own:**

  


* Anova leads customer insight amongst the IoT market. Your work toward understanding customers, their processes, and how IoT transforms their business, will keep Anova the leading player that best understands how IoT leads to our customer's value in servicing their customers.
* Platform growth and customer value realization. Your domain drives measurable customer outcomes — reduced operating costs, faster time\-to\-value, or expanded use cases. You track and improve these metrics continuously.
* Greater than 90% customer device productivity. Through solving real value\-adding problems for customers, providing best in class reliable uptime, drive customers to maintain their device portfolio live and healthy.
* Net Revenue Retention. Customers in your area renew, expand, and advocate. You own the product\-side inputs to NRR — adoption, engagement, and satisfaction — and make disciplined trade\-offs to protect gross margin.
* Roadmap quality and conviction. A rigorous, evidence\-backed roadmap that the organization trusts. You can defend every priority with data, customer insight, and a clear strategic rationale.
* Cross\-functional alignment. Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing are aligned on what's being built and why. Ambiguity is resolved upstream, not during delivery.
* Team development. You raise the craft of product management around you — through direct mentorship of PMs, strong written artifacts others learn from, and a culture of honest, evidence\-based decision\-making.

  


**How you'll work at Anova:**


* You write to think. Specs, strategy memos, one\-pagers, and decision frameworks are how we align a global, distributed team. Your written artifacts are models others reference. AI can help; writing well remains your skill to own.
* You use AI as leverage. You're fluent with LLMs for research, synthesis, drafting, and analysis. You have a seasoned, nuanced point of view on where AI should — and shouldn't — show up in B2B industrial products, and you actively shape Anova's perspective on both.
* You reason from data. You define the metric before you ship the feature. You build the instrumentation plan alongside the spec. You know when data is sufficient to decide and when it isn't.

  


**What you’ll need to succeed:**  

**Minimum Requirements \-**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience with APIs, systems integration, and software deployment.
* 6\+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with direct ownership of product strategy and business outcomes.
* 10\+ years of total professional experience, spanning product management, software engineering, systems integration, or comparable technical roles.
* You've built from scratch more than once — new products, new markets, new internal capabilities — and you have the experience to prove it. The more times you've started from nothing and shipped something that mattered, the better.
* Demonstrated track record of shipping SaaS or enterprise software that drove material business results — measured in adoption, retention, or revenue.
* Experience owning multi\-year product strategy and translating it into a prioritized, evidence\-backed roadmap.
* Deep customer discovery practice — structured interview programs, synthesis frameworks, and the ability to build conviction from ambiguous signals.
* Demonstrated experience using AI and LLM tools in a product management context — for research, synthesis, spec drafting, competitive analysis, data work, or customer insight.
* A clear, developed point of view on how AI should show up in B2B industrial products — both in internal operations and in customer\-facing capability.
* Ability to write compelling, structured strategy documents, specs, and narratives for executive and cross\-functional audiences.
* Strong technical fluency — able to engage credibly on APIs, data models, integration architecture, and system trade\-offs with engineering leaders.
* Data fluency: design metrics frameworks, build instrumentation plans, analyze data in BI tools, and make evidence\-based roadmap calls.
* Experience influencing pricing and go\-to\-market decisions for a product area.

  


**Preferred Qualifications \-**


* Prior product management in IIoT, connected\-hardware, or industrial technology environments.
* Experience shipping ML or AI\-driven features — forecasting, anomaly detection, decision support, or workflow automation — in a SaaS environment.
* Background in venture or private\-equity\-backed high\-growth industrial technology companies.
* Experience mentoring or managing junior PMs or leading a product pod.
* Domain knowledge in industrial operations, field service, supply chain, or logistics.
* Experience with enterprise integration patterns — ERP, dispatch, routing, or billing system connectivity.
  


**Physical Requirements** **\-**


* Willingness and ability to travel up to 30–40% domestically and internationally.
* Travel won’t consistently be 30\-40%, however at times this individual must be able to travel up to that percentage monthly
* Ability to perform typical office tasks, including sitting or standing for extended periods, using a computer, communicating effectively, and occasionally lifting light items

  


**ABOUT ANOVA**



We are very proudly “one” Anova — built by integrating the best in IIoT technology and expertise. Anova monitors more than 1,250,000 assets across nearly 80 countries for over 2000 clients, from family businesses to the largest LPG, Industrial Gases, and chemicals companies in the world. Our scale is global. Our service is local. We partner directly with customers, taking a holistic approach and delivering tailored solutions that drive innovation and improvement and make our world safer, more efficient, and reliable.

  



We believe that rewarding work should reward you. As part of Anova, your work, integrity, and commitment are rewarded through competitive compensation and reward strategies, through sincere appreciation, and through opportunities for growth and advancement. We put people first by providing benefits that support your life and well\-being, from health and finance to recognition and reward, and so much more — we've got you covered.

 **If this sounds like a fit for you, apply to join Anova in connecting the industrial world — for better.**

  

For more information about how Anova is transforming the Industrial IOT industry, visit us at Anova.com.

**About Us**
Planet is a leading technology company transforming payments by putting customer experience first. We offer integrated solutions that include payment processing, VAT refunds, dynamic currency conversion, and management services for merchants in the Retail and Hospitality sectors worldwide.


In recent years, we have experienced significant growth, expanding our services and global presence.


With strong private equity investors, Advent International and Eurazeo, we have the financial capital and expertise to grow our capabilities and reach through acquisitions.


Our mission is to create a world of connected commerce where payments are simple, secure, and seamless, enabling our partners to deliver exceptional experiences to their customers.

 **Role overview:**


Planet is scaling AI\-first engineering across its technology organisation, and the AI Enablement team is helping turn that ambition into day\-to\-day reality.


We are looking for **Senior AI Developer Experience Engineers** to join the team and help drive adoption across Engineering. This is a hands\-on role focused on AI Fluency, developer experience, internal enablement tooling, and measurable improvement across the software delivery lifecycle.


You will work closely with teams across Engineering, partnering directly with developers, QAs, product owners, scrum masters, business analysts, and managers to help them adopt better ways of working with AI. This is not a role from the sidelines. You will spend time with teams, understand where they struggle, coach them in practical contexts, and help embed better habits into real delivery work.


We are looking for people with strong engineering foundations who also bring a strong human touch. You should be someone who communicates clearly, builds trust easily, works well with different personalities, and knows how to bring people with you. Success in this role depends as much on credibility with engineers as it does on your ability to explain, facilitate, coach, and create momentum across the organisation.


You will help enable more than 300 engineers, alongside a broader set of SDLC roles, through structured AI Fluency sessions, hands\-on pairing, internal agents and workflows, reusable guidance, and support for priority initiatives. Over time, the role will also help drive adoption of broader platform and toolchain capabilities that improve engineering effectiveness across Planet.

 **What You'll Do:**

* Deliver AI Fluency sessions across Engineering and SDLC roles, from prompt engineering fundamentals to more advanced agentic coding workflows and practical AI\-first ways of working
* Work closely with teams across Engineering, building strong relationships, understanding where they struggle, and helping them adopt AI and better workflows in a practical, team\-friendly way
* Pair directly with developers and teams to improve adoption in real delivery work, helping them use tools such as GitHub Copilot, Copilot CLI, internal AI agents, workflow automations, and related capabilities effectively and responsibly.
* Help maintain and improve internal enablement tooling, including AI agents, automations, templates, prompts, workflows, and supporting assets used across the organisation.
* Create high\-quality enablement content, including guides, templates, examples, recorded sessions, best practices, and role\-specific learning material that teams can actually use.
* Assess and track AI maturity across teams using Planet’s AI Fluency model, helping identify where support is needed and where stronger patterns can be scaled.
* Support priority initiatives with dedicated AI\-first coaching, helping delivery teams apply better workflows, better prompting, and more effective use of internal tools in live projects.
* Collaborate closely with Architecture and Platform teams so enablement stays aligned with engineering standards, platform capabilities, system landscape, and the way Planet builds software.
* Capture adoption signals, usage insights, and learning feedback, and feed these into the AI Centre of Excellence and broader leadership reporting.
* Over time, help expand enablement beyond AI tooling into broader developer experience and platform adoption across the engineering toolchain.

 **Who you are:**

* Strong software engineering background, with experience building or maintaining production systems and a solid understanding of the full SDLC.
* Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Cody, Claude Code, or similar.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly, run hands\-on workshops, and adapt your style to different audiences across Engineering.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a genuine human touch. You build trust, work well with different personalities, and enjoy helping teams improve in a practical and collaborative way.
* Credibility with engineers. You are comfortable pairing with developers, discussing implementation trade\-offs, and helping teams improve how they work in practice.
* Experience creating strong technical content such as guides, tutorials, documentation, or internal learning material.
* A genuine interest in developer experience, engineering productivity, and helping teams adopt better ways of working.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience in developer experience, developer enablement, developer advocacy, or internal technical coaching.
* Understanding of enterprise engineering environments, including APIs, system design patterns, CI/CD, observability, infrastructure, and engineering governance.
* Strong understanding of prompt design, LLM capabilities, agentic workflows, and practical AI usage patterns in software engineering.
* Experience defining or tracking adoption metrics, maturity models, developer productivity indicators, or ROI\-oriented enablement measures.
* Experience with workflow automation and internal tooling, including platforms such as N8N or similar.
* Familiarity with fintech, payments, or regulated engineering environments.

**Tech Environment**


AI and enablement tools: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Copilot CLI, internal AI agents, workflow automations


Engineering ecosystem: GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, Terraform


Languages and stacks: Java, .NET, TypeScript, Python, and others across Planet teams

 **Why Planet**


Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.


Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast\-paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel\-good connected commerce.


We would love to hear from you. Apply now.


At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office.

  

Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully.


  
### **About Us**

**Company Background**


Planet provides integrated software, payment and technology solutions for its customers in the Hospitality and Retail sectors and worldwide via a network of global Financial Services Partners.


Founded over 35 years ago, we have evolved our services, delivering an innovative digital commerce platform that puts customer experience first.


With headquarters in London and around 3,000 expert employees located across six continents we serve customers in over 120 markets.
